title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), QA - AI Systems
description:
**about nexxa**
===============

nexxa is building the best ai systems for heavy industries, enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments.

our mission is to translate deep technical breakthroughs into operational reality, solving some of the hardest systems-level problems in industry.

**role overview**
=================

we’re looking for a senior / staff sdet to own quality for nexxa’s ai agent systems, combining deep test automation with hands-on manual and exploratory testing. our agents plan, call tools, and take multi-step actions autonomously in industrial environments. you’ll write production-grade code to build evaluation harnesses, simulation environments, and ci/cd quality gates, and you’ll also get hands-on with the agents yourself: probing behavior, reviewing traces, and validating releases where automation alone can’t judge whether the agent did the right thing.

you’ll work closely with ml engineers, backend engineers, and forward deployed engineers to define what “good” looks like for an agent operating in high-stakes industrial settings, then build and run the systems and processes that measure it continuously.

**key responsibilities**
========================

**automation and infrastructure**

* design, build, and maintain test frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for llm-based agents, covering reasoning quality, tool-call correctness, task completion, and multi-turn coherence.
* build automated pipelines that run evals and test suites on every model, prompt, or tool-integration change, and integrate them into ci/cd as enforceable quality gates.
* develop simulators, mocks, and sandbox environments for industrial systems and tool apis so agents can be tested safely, repeatably, and at scale.
* implement api, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests for the services, tools, and orchestration layers that agents depend on.
* develop performance, load, and reliability tests for agent workflows, including failure injection and resilience testing.

**manual and exploratory testing**

* perform hands-on exploratory testing of agent behavior, including new capabilities, ambiguous or underspecified requests, long multi-turn sessions, and unusual operational scenarios that scripted tests don’t anticipate.
* manually review agent traces and outputs to judge reasoning quality, appropriateness of actions, and safety, and use those findings to improve automated checks.
* execute manual regression and release verification passes in staging and customer-like environments before new agent capabilities ship.
* conduct manual red-teaming sessions (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, unsafe actions) in partnership with security teams, then convert successful attacks into automated test cases.
* support user acceptance testing and pilot rollouts with forward deployed engineers, capturing real-world failures and feeding them back into test suites.
* write clear test plans, test charters, and bug reports, and maintain manual test documentation where automation isn’t yet practical or cost-effective.

**datasets, metrics, and quality strategy**

* create and manage golden datasets and labeled test sets, including edge cases, ambiguous inputs, and adversarial prompts specific to industrial and operational contexts, with tooling for versioning and drift detection.
* design rubrics and run human-in-the-loop evaluations where automated scoring isn’t reliable enough.
* define and instrument quality metrics beyond simple accuracy (groundedness, hallucination rate, task success rate, latency/cost tradeoffs, and safety violations) and build dashboards to track them over time.
* test agent behavior across the full action loop (planning, tool selection, tool execution, error recovery, and final output), not just the final response.
* investigate and triage failures where the root cause could be the model, the prompt, the tool/api, or the orchestration logic, and turn them into reproducible, actionable bug reports.
* establish quality bars, release criteria, and sign-off processes for new agent capabilities, blending automated gates with manual verification.
* decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and continually shift repeatable manual work into automation.
* mentor engineers on testing strategies and test-driven practices for probabilistic, llm-driven systems.
* advocate for testability, observability, and tracing in agent architecture from day one.

**qualifications**
==================

* 5+ years as an sdet, qa engineer, or software engineer with a strong testing focus, with demonstrated ownership of test strategy and automation for complex distributed systems.
* proven experience in both manual and automated testing, including exploratory testing, test planning, and writing high-quality bug reports.
* strong programming skills (python preferred) with a software engineering mindset: clean, maintainable, well-reviewed code for frameworks, data pipelines, and tooling.
* experience building test frameworks and infrastructure from the ground up, not just writing test cases within an existing framework.
* hands-on experience with ci/cd systems (e.g., github actions, gitlab ci, jenkins) and containerized test environments (docker, kubernetes).
* experience testing apis and microservices, including contract, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* hands-on experience testing llm-based products, chatbots, or ai agents, and an understanding of why traditional deterministic assertions break down for generative systems.
* practical experience with eval frameworks or tooling (e.g., promptfoo, deepeval, ragas, langsmith) or a track record of building your own.
* understanding of how llm agents work: prompting, tool/function calling, context management, rag, memory, and orchestration frameworks.
* experience designing test data and labeled datasets, including sourcing, sampling, and managing dataset drift over time.
* familiarity with llm-specific failure modes: hallucination, prompt injection, context poisoning, tool misuse, goal drift, and non-determinism.
* comfort operating in ambiguity, defining what “correct” means for a task when there’s no single right answer.
* strong written communication skills for turning fuzzy quality signals into clear, actionable findings for engineering and product stakeholders.

**preferred**
=============

* experience with human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows (labeling pipelines, inter-rater reliability, rubric design).
* experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6, locust) and chaos or fault-injection testing.
* background in ml/data science sufficient to read model evals and statistical significance.
* experience red-teaming or doing adversarial/security testing on ml systems.
* familiarity with observability and tracing tools for llm applications (e.g., langsmith, arize, langfuse, weights & biases) and general observability stacks (opentelemetry, grafana, datadog).
* experience testing systems in industrial, iot, or operational technology (ot) environments, including industrial protocols (opc ua, mqtt, modbus) or simulation and hardware-in-the-loop setups.
* experience supporting uat, pilots, or customer-facing validation of complex products.
* experience setting up test and eval infrastructure from scratch at a startup or fast-moving team.

**what we’re looking for**
==========================

* an engineer who is equally comfortable writing a test framework and sitting down to break an agent by hand.
* someone who can build rigorous evaluation systems for problems that don’t have a single right answer, and who knows when human judgment is the right tool.
* a systems thinker who enjoys turning ambiguous agent behavior into measurable, trustworthy signals.
* a strong collaborator who partners well with ml engineers, backend engineers, and forward deployed teams.

**why join** **nexxa.ai****?**
==============================

* **innovative environment:** play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking ai and automation technologies.
* **collaborative culture:** be part of a team that values innovation, discipline, and continuous improvement.
* **professional growth:** benefit from significant opportunities for career development and advancement.
* **competitive compensation:** enjoy a comprehensive salary and equity package reflective of your expertise and contributions.

if you’re passionate about ai quality and eager to help define what trustworthy autonomous systems look like in heavy industry, we’d love to connect.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Applications Engineer
description:
full-time

hybrid (average of 2-3 days in office per week)

mars hill, nc

$125,000 - $160,000 + benefits

about us

the ammortal chamber integrates five science-backed modalities into one immersive 25-minute session. our clients include wellness clinics and spas, sports teams and athletic departments, hotels, and individuals who bring the chamber into their homes.

we are a small team with a startup culture. hardware and software engineers, health professionals, and operators work side by side. since shipping our first product we have grown steadily, and the software that drives the chamber is now at the center of what comes next.

this role offers hands-on ownership, room to grow into technical leadership, and a direct hand in shaping how the chamber works for the people who use it.

what is this role and why does it exist?

this role centers on linux systems software for the chamber: building and owning the application-level software that runs on embedded linux and interfaces with hardware over common serial and bus protocols — the software layer that sits above the firmware and drives the product. you'll occasionally reach up the stack into frontend work as well, giving you end-to-end understanding of the system.

at the senior level, you are a technical owner in this layer. you help make the architectural calls, set the standard for code quality and testing, and serve as a go-to person when a hardware-software problem needs solving. you'll work closely with the hardware team, ot partners, and the rest of the software team, and you'll help level up teammates who are earlier in their careers.

responsibilities

* own the design and development of chamber application software on embedded linux, including hardware communication over serial and bus protocols
* lead architectural decisions for our microservices-based platform and drive them through to implementation
* define and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, and deployment
* act as the technical escalation point for complex customer and field issues
* maintain and occasionally extend early-gen chamber software
* contribute to frontend work as needed to ship complete features
* collaborate with hardware, operations, and customer experience teammates to deliver end-to-end solutions

skills to excel

* **systems thinking:** deep understanding of how software, operating system, and hardware interact, and where problems tend to hide
* **technical judgment:** makes sound architectural tradeoffs and can explain them clearly
* **ownership:** takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; follows problems through to resolution
* **attention to detail:** organized and methodical in development, testing, and debugging
* **continuous learning:** stays current and curious across languages, tools, and patterns
* **customer focus:** understands how technical decisions affect the people using the product
* **communication:** works well across disciplines and translates between hardware, software, and business needs
* **comfortable multitasking:** manages multiple priorities and shifts context without losing the thread
* **team collaboration:** works effectively in a small, cross-disciplinary team; enjoys helping others grow and gives clear, constructive feedback

  
  
**requirements**  
  
what technical knowledge do you need to perform in your role?

**required**

* strong proficiency in go, c, or c++, and at least one high-level language (python, javascript, or similar)
* hands-on experience interfacing software with hardware over serial or bus protocols (for example modbus, i2c, spi, rs-485, or similar)
* deep familiarity with linux environments, the command line, and system-level debugging
* experience designing and shipping production software in a microservice or distributed architecture
* experience with git and modern ci/cd practices
* understanding of software development lifecycle and testing practices

**preferred**

* experience with mqtt or other iot communication protocols
* experience with docker and containerized deployments on embedded or edge hardware
* familiarity with debian-based linux systems
* experience with next.js, react, and typescript
* familiarity with shell scripting (bash)
* familiarity with a project tracking tool (asana, linear, jira, or similar)
* familiarity with ai-collaboration tools and agents

qualifications

**must haves**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on linux-based systems

**nice to haves**

* previous experience in an embedded linux, iot, robotics, industrial automation, or connected hardware role
* previous experience with real-time or safety-conscious systems
* contributions to open-source or personal projects demonstrating depth in systems software

  
**benefits**  
  
pay, location, hours

* pay range: $125,000 - $160,000
* benefits: 80% health, dental, and vision covered.
* flexible paid time off.
* location: hybrid in the asheville, nc area. onsite at least 2 days per week, can be more some weeks depending on current assignments.
* relocation assistance available if you do not currently live in the greater asheville area or within commuting distance to mars hill, nc.

title: Senior Developer Engineer
description:
omninode is building an ai governance infrastructure. it lets ai coding agents like claude code hand work off to the right model for the job. routine tasks go to cheaper or local models, a quality gate checks every answer, and developers see exactly which model answered, what it cost, and why it was routed there. our mvp is in the hands of our first testers now. we’re a small team building infrastructure that has to be correct, observable and fast.

**the role**

you’ll be one of the senior engineers shaping how omninode works: the delegation pipeline, routing and escalation logic, the event backbone, and the multi-tenant cloud runtime. you’ll work directly with our technical co-founder and ceo, own large parts of the system end to end, and set the engineering bar as the team grows.

**what you’ll do**

* own core parts of the delegation pipeline: routing decisions, provider calls, quality gates, escalation, and run receipts
* make delegation work in a correct and efficient manner before it’s clever.
* build the multi-tenant runtime: tenant isolation, row-level security, credentials, and per-tenant event streams
* integrate and benchmark model providers (openai, gemini, openrouter, local models via ollama) and keep cost and token data accurate
* ui support and iterating.
* harden the developer experience: the onex cli, one-command onboarding, and the local dashboard
* review code, mentor engineers and contractors, and help set architecture direction

**what you bring**

* 6+ years building production backend or distributed systems, with real ownership of systems people depend on
* strong python. comfort reading and shipping in a multi-repo codebase.
* experience with event-driven architecture (kafka, redpanda or similar), including delivery guarantees, idempotency and replay
* production experience with postgres, including schema migrations and multi-tenant data isolation
* experience shipping on aws with containers (docker), ci/cd, and infrastructure you can reason about
* hands-on experience building with llm apis. you know where they fail: rate limits, timeouts, token accounting, nondeterminism.
* you use ai coding agents in your own daily work and have opinions about where they waste money
* you write clearly, in prs, design docs and slack, not just ai slop with zero review or guidance

**bonus**

* you’ve built llm routing, evaluation or observability tooling
* experience running local or open-weight models
* open source contributions or maintainer experience
* early-stage startup experience where you shipped across the whole stack

**how to apply**

send:

* your github handle or links to work you’ve shipped
* a few sentences on the hardest correctness or reliability bug you’ve owned, and how you fixed it

sign up to take a look at our product and git repos https://omninode.ai/signup

pay: $75,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

work location: remote

title: Manufacturing System Integration Engineer
description:
**about samsung austin semiconductor**  
samsung is a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, founded on the belief that the pursuit of excellence creates a better world. at samsung austin semiconductor, we are innovating today to power the devices of tomorrow.

title: Scientist III – AI Scientist for Quantitative Neuropathy and ML Scalable Infrastructure
description:
***scientist iii – ai scientist for quantitative neuropathy and ml scalable infrastructure***

the **allen institute** accelerates science for a healthier world through large-scale research designed to answer some of the most complex questions in biology. our multi-disciplinary teams generate foundational knowledge, tools, and data to understand how our brain, cells, and immune system work. we share our work openly so others can build on it, move faster, and ask bigger questions. we drive discovery forward and create new possibilities for improving human health.

**brain health** is a new global collaborative research initiative designed to accelerate understanding of human brain diseases through large-scale human tissue analysis, open science, ai-enabled disease modeling, and translational platform technologies. building on foundational advances in human brain cell atlases, quantitative neuropathology, single-cell and spatial biology, multimodal molecular profiling, and ai-enabled analysis, brain health is developing a scalable framework for understanding disease progression directly in the human brain and identifying new opportunities for therapeutic development.

we are searching for a **scientist iii in scalable ai/ml for neuropathology** who will develop, scale, and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning methods, along with the infrastructure that supports them, to integrate multimodal neuropathological data, model disease progression, and drive the mechanistic understanding of brain disease at cellular resolution. this role sits at the intersection of computational biology, neuropathology, and ml engineering, working within the brain health accelerator and collaborating with experimental neuropathologists and software engineers. ai/ml focus areas could include multimodal foundation models, diffusion models, and computer vision architectures, together with the distributed training, data pipelines, and model serving needed to run them at scale.

at the allen institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. we are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to stem careers more broadly.

we also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices. we strive to make the allen institute a place where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to do their best work in a supportive environment.

we are an equal-opportunity employer and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our open positions.

**essential functions**

* develop and deploy large-scale ml models integrating multimodal neuropathological data, including digital histology, spatial transcriptomics, mri, and clinical metadata, to characterize brain disease progression at cellular resolution
* design and apply computer vision architectures (vit and related models) and foundation models to quantitative neuropathology image analysis
* design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that render diverse biological and neuropathological datasets, including gigapixel whole-slide images and spatial omics, ml-ready across cloud and on-premises gpu infrastructure
* implement and optimize distributed training and inference workflows for foundation models, including multi-gpu and multi-node training, experiment tracking, and reproducible model versioning
* apply bayesian statistical and causal modeling approaches to describe and predict neurodegenerative disease trajectories
* collaborate with scientists, computational biologists, neuropathologists, and software engineers within the allen institute and with external partners to advance model development from research to scientific impact
* promote open science through publication of peer-reviewed papers and release of open-source code, models, and reusable ml tooling

* *note: reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. this description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.*

**required education and experience**

* ph.d. in computer science, applied mathematics, computational biology, computational neuroscience, statistics, or related field; or equivalent combination of degree and experience
* minimum of 5 years of postdoctoral or industry research experience
* demonstrated ability to design, implement, and apply deep learning models to large-scale biological or medical image data
* experience with bayesian modeling and probabilistic inference
* experience building and maintaining scalable data or training pipelines for large-scale ml workloads
* proficiency in python and ml frameworks including pytorch or jax, with strong software engineering practices (version control, testing, code review)

**preferred education and experience**

* 3-5 years of experience developing and applying ml methods to biomedical or neuropathological data
* experience with digital pathology workflows, quantitative neuropathology, or computational histology
* familiarity with multimodal data fusion approaches, including integration of imaging, omics, and clinical data
* experience with score-based diffusion models, multimodal transformer architectures, or state-space models
* experience developing or applying causal models of disease or biological processes
* proficiency with cloud computing platforms and on-premises gpu clusters for large-scale model training, including distributed training frameworks (e.g., pytorch ddp/fsdp, deepspeed, or ray)
* experience with containerization and workflow orchestration (e.g., docker, kubernetes, slurm, nextflow, or airflow) and with large-scale image formats such as ome-zarr
* strong publication record of innovative individual and team scientific contributions
* excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

**physical demands**

* fine motor movements in fingers/hands to operate computers and other office equipment; repetitive motion with lab equipment

title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
description:
**about us**  
visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

at visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

join visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. progress starts with you.

**job description**

every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay- visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200+ countries. as a software development engineer on the product reliability engineering (pre) team, you won’t just watch those systems run- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them.

pre is not a traditional ops team. we are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. you’ll write python, build agentic ai tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real-time transactions. from day one, you are an engineer- and from day one, your work matters.

if you are endlessly curious about how large-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of ai, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you.

**build automation that scales**

* design and ship end-to-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves.
* write clean, production-grade python (and go or bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self-managing.
* develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle.

**manage & evolve data platforms**

* support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure.
* gain exposure to real-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale
* perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier-1 production databases.
* optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, cpu usage, and replication latency.
* automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like ansible and liquibase, and contribute to ci/cd pipelines that govern schema changes through test and prod environments safely.
* build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents.

**ship agentic ai & ml-powered tools**

* build genai-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management.
* integrate llms into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, ai-driven intelligence.
* contribute to prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position pre as one of the most ai-forward reliability organizations in financial technology.

**own observability & platform health**

* build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using prometheus, grafana, splunk, or elk that give engineers real-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems.
* analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur.
* contribute to self-healing and auto-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention.

**engineer for reliability & security**

* ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale.
* support zero-downtime deployment strategies and high-availability architectures that visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock.
* participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first-class engineering concern.

**collaborate, learn & grow fast**

* embed within agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global pre peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions.
* document runbooks, sops, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time.
* participate in on-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers.

visa will accept applications for this role until at least october 23, 2026.

**visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.**

**visa is not supporting immigration support for this role.**

**qualifications**

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of relevant work experience

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; december 2025 graduates welcome).
* solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design -you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
* proficiency in python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (go, java, or bash).
* foundational understanding of relational databases (rdbms): sql, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting.
* familiarity with linux/unix environments and meaningful command-line fluency.
* exposure to cloud platforms (aws, gcp, or azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (docker, kubernetes).
* understanding of ci/cd principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained.
* genuine curiosity about genai platforms and agentic systems (openai, anthropic claude, langchain, or similar)- hands-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must.

**bonus points:**

* hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools: terraform, ansible, or pulumi -even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship.
* experience with database ci/cd tooling, particularly liquibase for schema change management across environments.
* experience with observability tooling: prometheus, grafana, splunk, elk, or datadog.
* database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring.
* familiarity with git workflows and modern devops toolchains (jenkins, github actions, argocd).
* academic or project experience with ml frameworks: scikit-learn, pytorch, or langchain / langgraph.
* understanding of networking fundamentals: dns, load balancing, service mesh, or tcp/ip.
* a github profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open-source contribution that shows us how you think and build.

visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), fsa/hsa, life insurance, paid time off, and wellness program.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Digital
description:
**purpose:**

this position is responsible for building, deploying, and maintaining the ml models that power floor & decor's digital customer experience across flooranddecor.com, fnd apps, and omni-channel digital shopping tools. areas of work will include product search and discovery, personalization and recommendations, product data enrichment, and ai-assisted shopping. working cross-functionally with ecommerce product, engineering & analytics, data engineering, merchandising, and digital marketing, this role owns models end to end, from problem definition through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. in partnership with the lead data scientist, ai/ml, this role helps set the standard for how digital machine learning is built and measured, with success defined by measurable improvement in how customers find, evaluate, and choose products.

**minimum eligibility requirements:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field (master's or phd a plus); relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education.
* 5+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company.
* experience building machine learning for live, customer-facing digital products such as search, recommendations, ranking, personalization, or ads, in ecommerce, marketplaces, media, or similar environments.
* track record of taking multiple models into production and owning them after launch, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and retraining.
* depth in search and ranking or in recommendations and personalization, with the breadth to contribute across both.
* applied experience with natural language processing, embeddings, and large language models, including retrieval and reranking, and evaluating their output.
* expert proficiency in python and sql, with production-quality coding practices.
* hands-on experience with ml lifecycle practices and tooling, including automated training and scoring pipelines, model deployment, and monitoring.
* rigor in model evaluation and online experimentation (a/b testing) on digital products.
* proficiency with ai-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, cursor) to accelerate exploration, modeling, and engineering.
* comfortable working while the roadmap and platforms take shape: frames ambiguous problems, starts simple, and adds complexity only when it pays off.
* strong communication skills, with the ability to explain model behavior, tradeoffs, and expected impact to product, engineering, and business leaders.

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience helping build an emerging ml function: establishing the practices, tooling, and production patterns a growing team builds on.
* databricks on azure, pyspark, and ci/cd for ml, including mlflow, model registry, model serving, and feature stores.
* experience extending, evaluating, or migrating commercial search or personalization platforms (e.g., bloomreach, constructor, algolia, dynamic yield, salesforce personalization, salesforce commerce cloud).
* semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), or computer vision applied to product discovery.
* ecommerce or omnichannel retail experience, ideally in high-consideration, project-based categories (home improvement, furniture, home décor).
* experience with llm-based agents or tool-using workflows.
* experience with clickstream and customer behavioral data at scale.
* experience with causal inference methods for measuring impact.
* experience mentoring other data scientists or serving as technical lead on a multi-person ml effort.

**essential job functions:**

* build and improve ml models for product search and discovery, using floor & decor's proprietary signals (customer behavior, store-level availability, local demand) to help customers find the right products faster.
* develop personalization and recommendation models across site and app, including "complete the project" recommendations and session-based models for anonymous and infrequent shoppers.
* apply llms and computer vision to enrich product attributes at catalog scale, improving search, filtering, recommendations, and product feeds, with quality controls appropriate for technical product specifications.
* partner with the lead data scientist, ai/ml on conversational shopping and ai-assisted project guidance, owning retrieval quality and evaluation, including offline evaluation sets, and monitoring of quality, cost, latency, and safety.
* build durable ml assets (enriched product data, embeddings, evaluation sets) that carry across ecommerce platform and vendor changes.
* lead quantitative evaluation of search and personalization vendors using floor & decor's own data; recommend where platform configuration is sufficient and where proprietary models create defensible value.
* own models in production on databricks, delivering documented outputs that ecommerce and it engineering integrate into the site, app, and vendor platforms; monitor performance and own retraining and troubleshooting.
* help build out ml capabilities on databricks as needs expand, and, with the lead data scientist, ai/ml, define team ml engineering standards built to scale as the team grows.
* partner with data engineering, product, and engineering on the data and event tracking needed to train and measure models.
* design and analyze a/b tests for model-driven features, measure incremental impact on conversion, average order value, and engagement, and confirm that offline model gains translate into online results. standard digital performance reporting is owned by ecommerce analytics.
* inform the digital data science roadmap, set jointly by ecommerce product and data science leadership, by sizing opportunities, assessing feasibility, and communicating what a model will and won't do.
* serve as technical lead for digital ml: guide the work of the data scientist, digital, raise the team's technical bar through design and code reviews, and support recruiting and hiring.
* maintain clear documentation of methodologies, model assumptions, and limitations to ensure reproducibility and continuity.
* stay abreast of developments in search, recommender systems, and applied generative ai, and bring relevant advances into floor & decor's practice.
* be compliant with all appropriate privacy preferences, responsible ai, and security protocols, including guardrails for customer-facing generative ai.

**working conditions (travel & environment)**

* travel may be required including air and car travel (typically less than 10%).
* the noise level in the work environment is typically quiet to moderate.

**note:** *floor & decor considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or familial status, veteran status, or based on any other class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. floor & decor also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the americans with disabilities act and applicable state and local law.*

*this job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and the employee and is subject to change by the employer at its sole discretion.*

**benefits & rewards**

bonus opportunities & career advancement opportunities at every level

programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, employee stock purchase plan, and referral bonus program

medical, dental, vision, life, and other insurance plans (subject to eligibility criteria)

work-life balance, including:

* paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates
* paid holidays plus a personal holiday
* paid volunteer time off that starts on day 1

**equal employment opportunity**

floor & decor provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other category protected by law.

this policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, testing, screening, hiring, selection for training, upgrading, transfer, demotion, layoff, discipline, termination, compensation, benefits and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. this policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any associate or applicant on the basis of any legally protected status outlined above.

title: Engineer II
description:
**our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**

bring your talents to ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. all while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

as part of our team, you will experience:

* **success**. our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **career growth**. we develop industry leading talent because ross grows when our people grow<
* **teamwork**. we work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **our commitment to diversity, equality & inclusion, and our community.** we celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. we strive to be a positive force in our community.

our corporate headquarters are in dublin, ca, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in new york city, los angeles, and boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. with 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **general purpose**

we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced engineer ii – artificial intelligence (ai) to join our enterprise architecture and artificial intelligence team. this role is responsible for the hands-on design, development, and delivery of intelligent digital assistants, ai agents, and agentic solutions leveraging the microsoft ai ecosystem, including azure ai foundry, azure services, copilot studio, and the power platform, alongside pro-code development using python and other programming languages.

the ai engineer ii will contribute across the full software development lifecycle (sdlc), encompassing prototyping, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational support. the primary objective of this role is to deliver scalable, ai-driven solutions that enhance productivity, improve customer experience, and drive operational efficiencies within a retail environment. the position will involve participation in a diverse range of ai initiatives, including generative ai applications, autonomous agents, computer vision solutions, and intelligent process automation.

this role requires close collaboration with enterprise architects, data engineers, business analysts, and external technology partners to translate architectural designs and business requirements into robust, production-grade solutions. a strong understanding of integration platforms, apis, ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and modern ai frameworks is essential to ensure solutions are scalable, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.

the ideal candidate is a proactive and results-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic and rapidly evolving technology landscape. they should demonstrate proficiency in both low-code and pro-code development environments and possess a strong commitment to continuous learning, with the ability to effectively apply emerging ai technologies to address complex, real-world challenges in the retail domain.

**the base salary range for this role is $114,300 – $195,000. the base salary range is dependent on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, relevant education, certifications, seniority, and location. the range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. other rewards vary by position and location.**

### **essential functions**

* develop and deliver ai assistants and agent-based solutions

o design, build, test, and deploy intelligent digital assistants and ai agents using microsoft copilot studio, azure ai foundry, azure ai search, and other azure services.  
o implement agentic workflows and multi-agent orchestration patterns using both low-code platforms (copilot studio, power platform) and pro-code approaches (python, sdks, apis).  
o develop and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines, including data ingestion, vector indexing, prompt engineering, and grounded responses leveraging enterprise data sources.  

* participate in the full software development lifecycle (sdlc)

o contribute to all phases of solution delivery, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.  
o write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code in accordance with engineering best practices and enterprise standards.  
o support ci/cd pipelines and implement llmops practices for effective management of models, prompts, and agent lifecycles.  

* integrate ai solutions with enterprise systems and platforms

o develop and consume apis, connectors, and integration workflows to connect ai solutions with enterprise data sources (e.g., sql databases, file systems, saas platforms) and business applications.  
o work with enterprise integration platforms (e.g., mulesoft, azure api management, azure integration services) and microsoft graph connectors to enable seamless and secure data access.  
o leverage ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and emerging interoperability frameworks to enable secure, governed, and extensible communication between agents and enterprise systems.  

* contribute to broader ai initiatives

o collaborate with third-party partners to design and deploy video analytics and computer vision solutions (e.g., in-store customer experience, safety monitoring, and compliance use cases).  
o support the development and operationalization of additional ai/ml use cases such as demand forecasting, personalization, and intelligent process automation.  

* support ai governance, security, and responsible ai practices

o implement responsible ai controls, including guardrails, content filtering, and security measures, in alignment with enterprise architecture and ai center of excellence (coe) guidelines.  
o ensure compliance with data privacy, security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.  
o contributes to the development and documentation of reusable ai patterns, frameworks, and reference architectures.  

* collaborate and communicate across teams

o partner with solution architects, data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into high-impact ai solutions.  
o provide technical input for estimation, planning, and delivery of project milestones.  
o participate in architecture reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of ai engineering standards and practices.  

* drive continuous learning and ai innovation

o stay current with emerging ai tools, frameworks, models, and industry trends, particularly within the retail domain.  
o promote knowledge sharing through technical demos, workshops, and documentation to strengthen ai capabilities across the organization.

### **competencies**

building effective teams

developing talent

collaboration

leading by example

communicates effectively

ensures accountability & execution

manages conflict

business acumen

plans, aligns & prioritizes

organizational agility

dealing with ambiguity

problem solving

drives results

### **qualifications & special skills required**

* minimum of 7 years of experience in software engineering, ai/ml development, or a related technical field.
* hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying ai/ml or intelligent automation solutions in production or near-production environments.
* demonstrated experience with microsoft azure ai services, including azure ai foundry, azure openai, and azure ai search.
* hands-on experience with microsoft copilot studio and/or the power platform (power automate, power apps) for low-code ai solution development.
* solid understanding of generative ai concepts, including retrieval-augmented generation (rag), prompt engineering, vector databases, and orchestration patterns.
* experience developing and integrating apis and rest services, along with familiarity with enterprise integration platforms such as mulesoft, azure api management, and microsoft graph connectors.
* strong proficiency in python, with demonstrated experience leveraging generative ai libraries and modules (ex - langchain, semantic kernel, openai/azure openai sdks), and vector database integrations to build and integrate llm-powered solutions.
* working knowledge of ai gateways, the model context protocol (mcp), and emerging standards for agent interoperability and tool orchestration.
* strong understanding of software development lifecycle (sdlc) methodologies, including agile/scrum practices.
* experience with ci/cd pipelines, version control systems (e.g., git), and modern devops practices.
* understanding of ai security, data privacy, responsible ai principles, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* understanding of ai finops concepts to be able to develop cost efficient ai solutions
* strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to navigate ambiguity and complex challenges.
* excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications:**  

* microsoft certifications such as azure ai engineer associate, power platform developer associate, or azure developer associate.

* familiarity with agentic ai frameworks and multi-agent orchestration tools (e.g., autogen, semantic kernel agents).

by applying ai and data science, we help leading companies to prototype, refine, validate, and scale their ai and analytics products and delivery model

we are seeking a senior data scientist with strong expertise in exploratory data analysis (eda), machine learning, generative ai, and large language models (llms). this role will focus on designing, tuning, evaluating, optimizing, and deploying enterprise-scale ai/ml solutions while contributing to the broader ai architecture roadmap. the ideal candidate will combine strong statistical and machine learning foundations with hands-on experience in rag, llm tuning, ai agents, model evaluation, and production ai platforms.

* evaluate ai/ml frameworks, foundation models, vector databases, and emerging technologies based on business and technical requirements.

* ensure ai solutions follow enterprise security, data governance, responsible ai, and production-readiness standards.

**what you need to have to be considered**

* 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, ai engineering, or advanced analytics roles.
* expert knowledge of exploratory data analysis, statistical methods, feature engineering, machine learning algorithms, and model evaluation techniques.
* 3+ years of strong hands-on machine learning experience developing and deploying production-grade models.
* hands-on experience with generative ai and llms, including prompt engineering, rag, embeddings, vector databases, model tuning, evaluation, and performance optimization.
* strong proficiency in python and ml/ai frameworks such as pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, pytorch, tensorflow, or equivalent technologies.

* experience with major cloud ai/ml platforms such as azure, aws, or gcp and production deployment practices.
* strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills with the ability to translate technical results into business outcomes.

title: Engineer Sr, Applied Research Science
description:
overview:

**join shure’s signal processing and applied research team and help explore the future of intelligent audio.**

as a **senior engineer in applied research science**, you’ll research and develop innovative ai/ml and advanced algorithmic solutions aimed at solving complex, real-world customer challenges.

you'll be working alongside software, signal processing, data, and test engineers, where you will investigate emerging technologies, develop and demonstrate new approaches, and help bridge the gap between research, experimentation, and product innovation. this is an opportunity for someone who enjoys tackling difficult technical problems and seeing ideas move from concept and prototype toward real-world application.

**this hybrid position is based at our niles, il headquarters.**

responsibilities:

* **collaborate:** partner with cross-functional teams to research, design, and implement cutting-edge audio features and products.
* **ideate:** collaborate with colleagues, stakeholders, and engineering partners to identify high-value ai/ml use cases for customers, while exploring opportunities to optimize, scale, and platform solutions.
* **conduct research:** review relevant academic and industry literature and conduct original research and experimentation to solve complex technical problems. share findings, insights, and prototypes with colleagues, senior leaders, and executives.
* **define model & algorithm requirements:** work closely with engineers and product managers to establish and document performance metrics, system constraints, technical requirements, and architectural options.
* **develop & train models:** design and train custom machine learning models and algorithms for audio applications, including single- and multi-channel audio processing, speech enhancement, and related functionality. optimize models for latency, computational efficiency, and deployment requirements, partnering with software engineers to improve overall performance.

* **annotate data:** support the creation of high-quality datasets through internal annotation tools and third-party annotation partners.
* **advance engineering practices:** apply and strengthen machine learning software engineering practices, including shared toolkits, code repositories, experiment tracking, and other approaches that support repeatable and scalable research.
* **stay current:** monitor advancements across industry and academia, participate in relevant training and conferences, and identify opportunities to incorporate emerging research, technologies, and techniques into your work.
* **participate in working groups:** contribute to collaborative technical working groups focused on solving problems across specific areas, including topics that may extend beyond your primary area of expertise.
* **document research:** clearly document research methods, experiments, findings, results, and technical insights using collaborative documentation tools, both independently and in partnership with the broader team.
* **innovate & invent:** contribute to intellectual property development, participate in technical brainstorming, and help foster a culture of experimentation and innovation across the organization.

qualifications:

* master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistic, physics, data science, machine learning or field related to research science; with minimum 3 years of related experience
* phd in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistic, physics, data science, machine learning or field related to research science; without work experience
* proficiency in programming languages: python required; c/c++ or matlab also preferred
* proficiency in leveraging frameworks and libraries including: pytorch, tensorflow, scikit-learn, numpy, matplotlib, etc.
* proficiency in tools and technologies including: git/github, docker, jupyter, aws, onprem gpu training tools
* experience with any of the following highly desirable:
* experience in audio classification and scaling audio classification frameworks for efficient development and maintenance
* experience using ai-assisted software development and research tools (e.g., github copilot, agentic ai systems, large language models, code generation and analysis tools) to improve engineering productivity and solution development.
* independently deploying, validating, and demonstrating early proof of concept machine learning
* knowledge or experience with classical digital signal processing
* proficiency in developing low latency, embedded-friendly solutions
* audio engineering, recording, or other audio production (daws).

title: Data analyst/Data Engineer
description:

the **lead product development data engineer** owns key data processes and analytics applications within the broader product development process (pdp). in this cross-functional role, you will bridge the gap between engineering and enterprise organizations—including it, manufacturing, finance, purchasing, and supply chain—to establish standardized, high-performing data workflows, modern cloud architectures, and scalable analytics solutions.

#### **3. cross-functional leadership & ai/ml support**

* **stakeholder alignment:** collaborate across it, manufacturing, finance, purchasing, and program management to capture technical requirements and align business goals.
* **ai/ml workflows:** support the integration of machine learning models and predictive analytics into existing engineering data pipelines.
* **executive communication:** translate complex data technicalities and process trade-offs into clear decision packages, business cases, and leadership presentations.

#### **basic requirements**

* **education:** bachelor of science degree in engineering from an accredited program.
* **big data ecosystems:** hands-on experience with **snowflake** or **databricks**.
* **programming languages:** proficiency in **sql**, **python**, and/or **pyspark**.
* **data modeling & bi tools:** proven expertise in data modeling and tools such as **power bi**, **sharepoint**, **powerapps**, **power automate**, **azure**, or **palantir foundry**.
* **cloud stack proficiency:** hands-on experience with modern cloud architectures, including microsoft fabric (lakehouse, directlake, dax, dataflows) and/or aws cloud services.
* **leadership & soft skills:** demonstrated leadership, self-starter mindset, organizational skills, and fluent english communication skills with the ability to present to all levels of management.

#### **preferred qualifications**

* **advanced degree:** master's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* **domain experience:** experience supporting core engineering processes (e.g., sourcing, quality, validation, manufacturing, logistics, program management).
* **ai/ml integration:** experience integrating predictive models or ai capabilities into production data pipelines.
* **business analysis:** proven ability in business process mapping, writing business requirements documents (brds), and technical process documentation.
* **big data frameworks:** familiarity with open-source frameworks like apache spark or hadoop.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, MarTech (Remote)
description:
as a global leader in cybersecurity, crowdstrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced ai-native platform. we work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. our customers span all industries, and they count on crowdstrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. we're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging ai to transform the way we work. crowdstrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible ai adoption, experimentation, and innovation. we use an ai-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. we’re always looking to add talented crowdstrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. ready to join a mission that matters? the future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**about the role**

crowdstrike is looking for a sr. software engineer - martech to join our fast-growing marketing it team. you will apply ai to transform how marketing and sales work, building llm-based agents and machine learning solutions across digital, revenue, partner, and event marketing. your focus will be turning high-impact initiatives, such as event invitations, prospecting, lead and contact data quality, site search, and partner experiences, into reliable, measurable, production-grade solutions.

this role also entails platform engineering work. you will also train and enable marketing and it team members to adopt ai effectively and responsibly.

**what you'll do**
------------------

ai & applied ml use case discovery: partner with marketing teams to identify, prioritize, and scope ai opportunities, with success metrics tied to business outcomes.

* **agent development:** build and deploy llm-based agents for event invitations, account and contact prospecting, and partner workflows, with orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls.
* **lead & contact quality:** build ml and llm-assisted pipelines to clean, deduplicate, enrich, validate, and score leads and contacts across salesforce, marketo, and related systems, including bot and fraud detection.
* **search & retrieval:** modernize site search and partner locator using semantic and hybrid retrieval, embeddings, and rag grounded in approved content.
* **analytics**: use ai-assisted analysis to improve partner lead roi reporting and adobe analytics adoption.
* **evaluation & guardrails**: define evaluation metrics and regression tests, monitor accuracy, latency, and cost, and implement pii handling, consent enforcement, and audit logging in partnership with security, privacy, and legal.
* **build vs. buy:** evaluate ai tools, llm platforms, and adobe-native ai capabilities, and recommend a direction.
* **training & enablement**: train and mentor engineers, marketing operations, and sales stakeholders on ai tools, prompt design, and responsible use. run workshops and maintain playbooks and reusable templates.

* **integration**: integrate ai solutions with adobe experience cloud, salesforce, marketo, and other systems via apis and event-driven patterns.
* **devops & operations:** monitoring, and alerting for ai services, and support incident response and runbooks.
* **collaboration**: work with the aep and platform engineers on data access, environments, and releases.

**what you'll need**
--------------------

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 2+ years taking llm or ml solutions to production.
* hands-on experience with llm apis, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, tool calling, and orchestration.
* familiarity with marketing business domain in hi-tech industry.
* experience with rag, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and ml-based entity resolution, classification, or scoring.
* experience with evaluation methods, prompt and model versioning, and production monitoring.
* strong python and sql, plus typescript/javascript or java, and experience building restful apis.
* working knowledge of crm and marketing automation data models (leads, contacts, accounts) in platforms such as salesforce and marketo.
* experience with a major cloud platform (aws or azure), ci/cd tools (jenkins, gitlab ci/cd), and github.
* understanding of data governance, privacy (gdpr, ccpa), and responsible ai practices.
* demonstrated ability to train and mentor technical and non-technical colleagues.
* ability to balance project work with operational tasks and to work pacific time (pt) business hours.

**nice to haves**

* experience with adobe experience platform, adobe analytics, target, journey optimizer, aem, firefly, or genstudio.
* experience with search platforms (elasticsearch, opensearch, algolia).
* experience with snowflake, databricks, or kafka.
* experience with sales technology (engagement, intent, or enrichment tools) or bot and fraud mitigation.
* experience leading internal ai training programs. -

title: Software Engineering III - AWS, GCP, Terraform
description:
**job description**  
  
  

we have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
as a software engineer iii at jpmorganchase within the corporate technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. you are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**job responsibilities**

* implementation of key components of a public cloud platform, primarily on aws.
* develop secure, high-quality production code and infrastructure automation (primarily in python and terraform), and review and debug code written by others to ensure correctness, performance, and maintainability.

* define and reinforce safe team usage patterns for ai-assisted development, including verification expectations (correctness, security implications, licensing/ip considerations, and compliance) and adherence to firm controls (for example, avoiding sensitive data in prompts and ensuring reviews and approvals occur before merge and release).

**required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 4+ years applied experience
* hands-on practical experience in developing and designing software on aws and gcp, with meaningful hands-on experience delivering solutions involving aws database services and the infrastructure that supports them.
* strong, practical proficiency in python and terraform, including building and maintaining production-grade automation and infrastructure as code.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**our human capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. as converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. we leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.**  
  
**this role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will design, build, and implement reusable analytics products and assets that meet client needs and extend our human capital service offerings.**  
  
**recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.**  
  
**work you'll do**  
  
**the data engineer consultant will support data architecture and engineering delivery that enables artificial intelligence (ai), machine learning (ml), and generative ai (genai) solutions, ensuring data is trusted, secure, observable, and scalable from ingestion through consumption. you will design and operationalize modern data and retrieval foundations to support large language model (llm)-powered applications (e.g., claude, gpt/codex, gemini) including patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (rag), embeddings, vector search, and governed access to structured and unstructured data and work directly with human capital product managers and clients to design and deliver data-driven workforce and human capital analytics solutions, owning end-to-end solutions from data modeling to stakeholder presentations. you will build dashboards, reports, and reusable analytics products, turning complex human capital data into clear, actionable insights. you will be part of a blended onshore/offshore delivery team, partnering with data science, ml engineering, and product stakeholders to translate use cases into production-ready pipelines and platforms with strong data governance, lineage, quality controls, and monitoring.**  

* **lead the design, development, and delivery of analytics solutions that address complex workforce and human capital challenges for clients across industries.**
* **build and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks using structured query language (sql) and tableau (or equivalent visualization platforms).**
* **translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches, communicating findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.**
* **collaborate across service lines to embed ai-enabled capabilities and emerging data methodologies into client solutions.**
* **support business development efforts including proposals, client presentations, and thought leadership content.**
* **design and deliver intuitive, executive-ready reports and dashboards that make complex workforce data accessible and actionable.**

  
**a successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **ability to meet deadlines**
* **ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**the team**  
  
**hc forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of human capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply ai, data, and engineering to modernize hr experiences and outcomes.**  
  
**qualifications**  
  
**required:**  

* **bachelor's degree in a science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (stem) field (e.g., computer science, engineering, statistics, data science)**
* **2+ years of experience in data science, data engineering, or analytics.**
* **2+ years of modern data & ai engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals.**
* **1+ years of experience with machine learning concepts, large language model applications, or ai-augmented analytics workflows.**
* **2+ years of experience using python or r for statistical modeling and data wrangling, including proficiency in databricks or snowflake.**
* **ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.**

  
**preferred:**  

* **advanced degree, including a master of science (ms) or doctor of philosophy (phd), and/or relevant certifications.**
* **direct experience in client-facing or consulting environments, with human capital platforms and integrations (e.g., workday, sap successfactors, oracle human capital management (hcm), salesforce), or in human resources (hr) data domains.**
* **experience operationalizing large language model operations (llmops) and machine learning operations (mlops) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management.**
* **cloud experience on one or more of amazon web services (aws), microsoft azure, or google cloud platform (gcp), including managed data platforms and scalable compute patterns.**
* **experience explaining complex data and technology concepts, articulating risks and trade-offs, documenting decisions, and collaborating across product, data science/ml, data engineering, platform, and security teams.**
* **experience in analytics product development-building repeatable tools, models, or platforms rather than one-off deliverables-and ethics and privacy practices, including recognizing consent, personally identifiable information (pii), and bias boundaries and escalating appropriately.**

  
**the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.**  
  
**you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**join atlas air worldwide. move the world with us!**

at atlas air worldwide, we're not just an airline, we're a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. as a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we're built on a foundation of **safety**, **service excellence**, **integrity**, **innovation**, **teamwork**, and **responsibility**. with over 30 years of history, a modern all-boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we're driven by purpose.

**if you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.**

**position summary:** atlas air is seeking a data engineer to join our data platform and engineering team. this is an early-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work.

as we continue to build our data environment on databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. you will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production-quality code that supports analytics, data science, ai/ml, and operational decision-making.

**major accountabilities:**

**data pipeline development**

* build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks.
* develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets.
* implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs.
* use databricks, spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members.
* participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance.

**data quality & operations**

* create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop.
* investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately.
* produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes.
* participate in the team's on-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support.
* follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements.

**collaboration & growth**

* work with data analytics, data science, software engineering, it, security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines.
* contribute to team standards for source control, testing, ci/cd, documentation, and operational readiness.
* learn the atlas air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products.
* seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less-defined problems.

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.
* minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., python, typescript, rust, java, c++, etc.).
* experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting.
* familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including etl/elt, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration.
* experience with git-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows.
* ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

**desired qualifications:**

* hands-on exposure to databricks, apache spark, or another distributed data-processing platform.
* experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as airflow, prefect, or dagster.
* familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: aws, azure, or gcp.
* exposure to streaming or event-driven technologies such as kafka, kinesis, spark structured streaming, or flink.
* familiarity with bi, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them.
* experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

at **atlas air worldwide**, we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.
