title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**ally and your career**  
ally financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. we love this stuff! we see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. from generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. we want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. you’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?
  
  
**work schedule** **:** ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. all work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.

  

**the opportunity**

smartcash is ally financial's dealer money movement and wholesale settlement platform, responsible for processing approximately $500 million per day in ach transactions across ally's national auto dealer network. the platform serves a critical operational function and operates under strict daily processing windows with no tolerance for failure.
  
  
the platform is currently undergoing a full migration to aws. architecture design and proof of concept work has been completed across all major workstreams, and the team is moving into execution. the senior software engineer joining this team will contribute to a well-defined migration program while maintaining a production platform that runs seven days a week. the role carries technical depth across cloud infrastructure, java application development, database migration, and batch processing — supported by modern tooling including enterprise access to generative ai development tools.

**the work itself**

cloud migration:

migrate smartcash's application and data tiers to aws. this includes re-platforming spring batch jobs from openshift to aws batch on ecs fargate, migrating weblogic and jboss online applications to ecs fargate containers, moving the oracle 19c database to aurora postgresql, archiving to s3 glacier, and deploying the react spa to s3 with cloudfront distribution. infrastructure is managed via terraform through the ally pce gitlab pipeline.

  

database migration:

convert oracle pl/sql packages, procedures, and sequences to postgresql compatible equivalents. this work requires applied knowledge of both oracle and aurora postgresql behavior under financial transaction load.

  

batch processing:

maintain and extend the spring batch processing chain that runs nightly monday through friday, generating ach files, gl extracts, retail and wholesale feeds, and cba reports. own incident response within this chain and eventually re-platform these jobs to aws batch without interrupting production operations.

  

feature development:

contribute to high impact, innovative capabilities that advance the platform alongside migration work. smartcash is an active product — new features ship regularly and engineers are expected to contribute meaningfully to both the modernization effort and the ongoing business roadmap.

  

ai assisted development:

utilize generative ai tooling as a standard development instrument

  
  

**minimum qualifications**

  

* 3+ years of relevant experience
* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent
  

  

**the qualifications we’re looking for**
----------------------------------------

  

* 3+ years of experience preferred.
* java and backend development - 3+ or more years of production java development; java 17 or 21
* spring boot and spring batch, including job partitioning, restart ability, step chaining, and failure handling
* familiarity with java ee patterns — ejb, container managed transactions, jndi — and experience migrating away from legacy jee frameworks

title: Data Scientist, Digital
description:
**purpose:**

the data scientist, digital machine learning (ml), develops, deploys, and maintains ml models that support floor & decor's digital customer experience across flooranddecor.com, fnd apps, and omnichannel digital shopping tools. areas of responsibility include personalization and recommendations, product search and discovery, product data enrichment, and customer intent signals. working cross-functionally with ecommerce product, engineering & analytics, data engineering, merchandising, and digital marketing, this role advances models from development through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. the position adheres to the team's technical standards and partners closely with the senior data scientist, digital, to deliver measurable improvements in how customers find, evaluate, and select products.

**minimum qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field (advanced degree a plus); relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education.
* 3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, including hands-on contribution to at least one model deployed into a production system, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company.
* experience building machine learning for live, customer-facing digital products such as search, recommendations, ranking, personalization, or ads, in e-commerce, marketplaces, media, or similar environments.
* strong proficiency in python and sql, writing clean, tested, production-ready code.
* solid foundation in machine learning, including classification, ranking, and recommendation approaches.
* familiarity with ml lifecycle practices, including automated training and scoring pipelines, deployment, and monitoring.
* experience designing and analyzing a/b tests and interpreting results for business partners.
* proficiency with ai-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, cursor) to accelerate exploration, modeling, and engineering.

**preferred:**

* databricks on azure, pyspark, and ci/cd for ml.
* experience extending, evaluating, or migrating commercial search or personalization platforms (e.g., bloomreach, constructor, algolia, dynamic yield, salesforce).
* experience with deep learning recommenders, embeddings, or llms applied to product, content, or customer data.
* experience with clickstream and customer behavioral data.
* ecommerce or omnichannel retail experience, ideally in high-consideration, project-based categories.

**competencies:**

* analytical problem-solving
* technical communication
* organization & adaptability
* collaboration across product teams

* integrity, humility & teamwork

**essential functions / key responsibilities:**

* build and maintain recommendation models across site and app, including similar products, "complete the project" recommendations (e.g., tile with the setting materials, tools, and underlayment the project requires), and continue-your-project experiences.
* develop session-based models that infer shopper intent (project type, style, diy vs. pro, stage in the purchase journey) for anonymous and infrequent visitors.
* rank content, offers, and modules across the home page, category and product pages, and app.
* contribute to product search improvements, including query classification, synonyms, and relevance evaluation.
* apply llms and embeddings to enrich product attributes that improve search, filtering, and recommendations, with quality checks on technical specifications, and support evaluation of llm-powered features by building evaluation sets and reviewing output quality.
* produce digital propensity and intent scores (e.g., sample-to-purchase conversion, pro identification) for the site, app, and marketing systems, leveraging enterprise customer segments from customer analytics & insights rather than building parallel segmentation.
* contribute to shared ml assets that carry across ecommerce platform and vendor changes, and support vendor evaluations with analysis on floor & decor data.
* bring personalization, search, and recommendations to floor & decor's upcoming pro app, using pro purchase history, project patterns, and loyalty data to drive app adoption, engagement, and share of wallet with pro customers.
* deploy and operate models on databricks following team standards; monitor performance, data quality, and drift, and retrain as needed.
* partner with data engineering, product, and engineering on the data and event tracking needed to train and measure models.
* design and analyze a/b tests for model-driven features and measure incremental impact on conversion, average order value, and engagement. standard digital performance reporting is owned by ecommerce analytics.
* communicate results, tradeoffs, and recommendations to product teams and business stakeholders in a clear, actionable way.
* maintain clear documentation of methodologies, model assumptions, and limitations, and participate in code and design reviews.
* stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in personalization, search, recommender systems, and applied data science.
* be compliant with all appropriate privacy preferences, responsible ai, and security protocols, including customer consent and preference requirements for personalization.

the role is based in the store support center in atlanta, ga. work is primarily sedentary, involving extended periods of sitting at a computer, with occasional walking or standing. the work environment is typically quiet to moderate.

sedentary work – ability to exert up to 10–20 lbs. occasionally and negligible force frequently to lift, carry, push, or pull objects.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Healthcare Platform - Remote
description:
**role summary**
----------------

we are seeking a senior ai engineer to help build and operate a production-grade healthcare genai platform for patient-facing and enterprise conversational experiences. this role will focus on backend ai services, agentic workflows, mcp tool servers, secure clinical data integrations, and ai platform tooling.

the ideal candidate is a strong python/backend engineer with hands-on genai experience who can build reliable agent systems using **google adk**, llm tool calling, structured outputs, rag, guardrails, and healthcare-safe integration patterns. this is not a prompt-only role; it requires production engineering judgment across security, observability, testing, deployment, phi protection, and operational ownership.

**primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* design, implement, and maintain backend ai services using **python 3.12+**, async service patterns, and frameworks such as **fastapi**, **google adk**, and **fastmcp**.
* develop and operate agentic genai workflows using **google adk 2.x** as a primary orchestration framework.
* build mcp tool servers and domain-specific tools for healthcare workflows such as care tasks, medications, scheduling, patient profile lookup, clinical record retrieval, and ehr/fhir-backed experiences.
* integrate llm providers and genai toolkits including **google gemini/vertex ai**, openai, anthropic, and related orchestration frameworks where appropriate.
* implement prompt engineering, rag, structured output validation, tool selection patterns, memory strategies, and ai guardrails to support safe and reliable model behavior.
* design secure clinical integration boundaries for fhir, ehr, user profile, scheduling, and other healthcare systems.
* protect phi and sensitive credentials through secure jwt/oauth flows, delegated authorization, token forwarding, encryption, redaction, and audit-safe logging.
* leverage cloud services such as **azure app configuration, key vault, cosmos db, event hubs, application insights**, and google cloud services such as **vertex ai/gemini and cloud run**.
* build observability, telemetry, evaluation, and impact-reporting capabilities for ai systems and ai-assisted engineering workflows.
* author and maintain automated tests using **pytest** and support linting, type-checking, ci/cd, and containerized deployments.
* collaborate with product, architecture, security, clinical, platform, devops, and application teams to deliver safe ai capabilities through well-defined http/mcp contracts.
* participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, production support, operational readiness, and incident response.

  
**benefits**  
  
our competitive benefits package includes the following  

* immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
* 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
* tuition reimbursement
* pto accrual beginning day 1

note: benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of professional software development experience.
* strong production experience with **python**, asynchronous programming, backend apis, and service-oriented architecture.
* hands-on experience building genai applications with **google adk 2.x** or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
* demonstrated understanding of llm tool calling, multi-agent workflows, structured outputs, rag, prompt engineering, and ai safety/guardrail patterns.
* experience integrating with llm providers such as **google gemini/vertex ai**, openai, anthropic, or equivalent platforms.
* experience with **fastapi**, **pytest**, docker, ci/cd workflows, and containerized production deployments.
* strong understanding of api security, **jwt/oauth**, delegated authorization, secrets management, and secure service-to-service communication.
* ability to design safe integration patterns for healthcare data, clinical systems, or other sensitive regulated environments.
* experience with cloud-native services in azure and/or google cloud.
* strong debugging, testing, and operational problem-solving skills.
* ability to work with high ownership in a small, fast-moving engineering team.
* strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, security, product, and clinical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* healthcare domain experience, especially with **hipaa**, **hl7/fhir**, epic integrations, patient portals, scheduling, medication, claims, or clinical workflow systems.
* experience with **mcp**, **fastmcp v3**, model-tool integration, or agent tool-server architecture.
* experience with langgraph, langchain, pydanticai, semantic kernel, or other orchestration and structured-output frameworks.
* familiarity with **opentelemetry**, application insights, kusto, ai evaluation pipelines, or production observability tooling.
* experience building ai platform tooling, internal developer enablement tools, ai governance automation, code review automation, or ai impact reporting.
* experience with **uv**, ruff, pyright, python packaging, dependency isolation, and multi-container service deployment.
* exposure to react and typescript for occasional full-stack collaboration, while remaining primarily backend/platform focused.

**ai-augmented development expectations**
-----------------------------------------

this role requires disciplined use of ai tools as part of daily engineering work. the engineer should be able to use ai coding agents and genai systems to accelerate implementation, research, validation, and documentation while remaining fully accountable for correctness and safety.

the successful candidate will know how to:

* give ai agents clear, scoped engineering tasks.
* require agents to inspect existing code, contracts, tests, and architecture before proposing changes.
* validate ai-generated code with tests, type checks, linting, runtime review, and security judgment.
* identify when generated code is unsafe, incorrect, over-engineered, noncompliant, or inconsistent with platform boundaries.
* use ai tools to improve delivery speed without compromising phi protection, reliability, auditability, maintainability, or user trust.
* contribute to ai governance patterns, reusable agent instructions, tool ergonomics, and platform standards.

**ideal candidate profile**
---------------------------

the ideal candidate is a senior backend/platform engineer with practical genai experience and strong healthcare-grade judgment. they can design agent workflows, but they also understand authentication, deployment, observability, testing, failure modes, phi handling, and operational ownership.

they are pragmatic, security-minded, collaborative, and comfortable building early platform foundations that will later support production patient-facing ai experiences.

title: AI Engineer III
description:
**our deloitte human capital team transforms technology platforms, drives innovation, and helps make a significant impact on our clients' success. we are hiring an ai engineer to build and operate the data, features, and genai foundations that power human capital ai products and analytics. you will work with an ai data engineer (data ingestion, curation, governance, platform foundations) and a lead ai solutions architect (end-to-end solution architecture, integration patterns, non-functional requirements), partnering closely with product, data science/ml, security, and platform engineering to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable ai solutions.**

**recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.**  
  
**work you'll do**  
  
**as an ai engineer iii on the hc forward team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and running the trusted, governed data, feature, and retrieval layer used by ai/ml and genai solutions. you will deliver reproducible datasets and features, operationalize quality and lineage, and enable secure consumption patterns for both predictive ml and llm-based experiences.**  

* **partner with the lead ai solutions architect and ai data engineer to translate human capital product needs into secure, scalable technical designs and delivered solutions (apis, services, pipelines, containers/serverless) meeting availability, performance, and security expectations.**

* **implement llm application patterns including rag, document ingestion/chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and retrieval/evaluation telemetry.**
* **deliver governed datasets and feature engineering/serving for ml training and real-time inference (online/offline consistency, caching, latency slos, backfills).**
* **implement safety, privacy, and access controls (pii handling, prompt-injection defenses, content filtering, policy-based access) with security and risk stakeholders.**
* **establish data/model reliability and cost-performance discipline (data quality, schema evolution, lineage/metadata, monitoring; right-sizing, query tuning, llm token/cost telemetry), and contribute to mlops/llmops and production operations (versioning, reproducibility, ci/cd, automated testing, observability, incident response); support design reviews, deployment readiness, and runbooks.**

  
**a successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **ability to meet deadlines**
* **ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**the team**  
  
**hc forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of human capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply ai, data, and engineering to modernize hr experiences and outcomes.**  
  
**qualifications**

title: Sr Credit Data Scientist
description:
**the global risk solutions and strategy group is a fast-growing team optimizing risk solutions and models, and we are a key function to help enable wex’s strategic objectives. the risk solutions team employs data science methodologies (machine learning and statistical frameworks), a wide suite of data types, and modern technologies to develop solutions to inform decision making. our team helps the firm identify and measure credit and fraud risk to proactively manage the risk throughout the client’s life-cycle. as such, you will not only be working with the latest data and machine learning technologies and algorithms, you will be working in a dynamic environment alongside our stakeholders and domain experts to build models and drive better decision-making.**

  
  

**about the team/role**

* **partner with stakeholders to understand fraud risk management requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions to measure and monitor fraud risk across the firm’s products and services.**
* **proactively identify and communicate challenges, opportunities, and risks associated with end-to-end model development and deployment life-cycle to ensure timely completion of the entire product.**
* **leverage advanced machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical methods and technologies to design flexible, scalable, and automated risk modeling solutions.**
* **develop and review code and automated processes to extract fraud risk patterns from large scale application and transaction data, behavioral patterns, and other risk indicators.**
* **keep abreast with emerging trends in machine learning and identify opportunities to leverage new tools to solve problems and improve processes.**

* **mentor and support junior data scientists, sharing knowledge and best practices to elevate the data science practice at wex.**
  

  

**how you'll make an impact**

* ***insights driven:*** **clear hypothesis and objective driven analytics that help drive our business decisions and ongoing metrics**
* ***stakeholder aligned:*** **understand the needs and audience for deliverables with a succinct and tailored message to maximize impact**
* ***results focused:*** **rigorous focus on how analytics drive the end to end experiences with clear path to production and measurable impact**
* ***dynamic collaboration:*** **drive continual improvement of our team best practices and processes to power collaboration**
* ***quality mindset:*** **trust in our findings is critical so data and analytic quality is understood and accounted for from the beginning**
* ***curiosity and learnin*****g: learn new technologies and collaborate and teach others how to use them as necessary.**

**experience you’ll bring:**
----------------------------

  
  

* **4 or more years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, with a focus on fraud risk management in underwriting, behavioral surveillance, and loss prevention in the financial services industry.**
* **master’s or ph.d. degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, data science, operations research, computer science.**
* **strong knowledge of fraud risk-drivers in small and medium sized businesses, public firms, and private firms, including data typically used in fraud risk management from external credit bureaus and internal risk management processes**
* **advanced knowledge of sql and experience creating and managing large datasets to organize and extract useful information**
* **advanced knowledge of python or r and experience with common data science libraries such as lightgbm, scikit-learn, pandas, etc..**
* **deep understanding of model deployment requirements for scalable solutions and real-time feature stores**
* **deep expertise in statistical and machine learning techniques, including modeling, testing and inference, sampling methods, supervised and unsupervised learning.**
* **strong communication and presentation skills with an ability to relate complex analytics findings to business outcomes**
* **adaptable and comfortable working collaboratively and independently in a self-starting manner**
* **evidence of creative problem solving, critical thinking and a continual learning mindset in credit risk management.**
  

  

**how you will stand out:**
---------------------------

  
  

* **prior experience mentoring experience of data scientists**
* **prior roles responsible for building underwriting and behavioral models.**
* **knowledge of external intelligence sources, including third-party data providers e.g. lexisnexis, socure, dun and bradstreet**
* **experience using cloud environments to develop advanced models, such as aws sagemaker**
* **experience with end–to-end machine learning systems and mlops framework**
* **ai tool experience preferred - gemini, chatgpt, similar**

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**about the team**

the ai accelerator team sits at the center of morningstar’s generative ai strategy for the direct platform. we build and scale core systems such as the morningstar mcp server, mcp gateway, and morningstar agent.

our team is responsible not only for delivering genai capabilities, but also for solving the underlying challenges that make them production-ready—document vectorization, caching strategies, system scalability, security, and reliability. we work closely with the morningstar responsible ai council to ensure our systems meet strict standards around guardrails, pii filtering, moderation, and anonymized evaluation pipelines.

we operate with a strong engineering culture: we question assumptions, prioritize impact over process, and focus on solving meaningful problems rather than executing predefined tasks. collaboration, shared ownership, and continuous learning are central to how we work.

  

**about the role**

as an associate software engineer on the ai accelerator team, you will help design, build, and scale the core services powering morningstar directs’ genai capabilities. you will work across the full development lifecycle—from ideation and design to implementation, deployment, and iteration.

you’ll leverage modern ai-assisted development tools (e.g., github copilot, claude code) to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, and documentation. you will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to build systems that are both technically robust and highly valuable to users.

this role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys exploring new technologies, and takes initiative in learning beyond immediate requirements.

  

**location:** chicago, illinois (hybrid policy, 4 days onsite required)

  

**responsibilities:**

* design, build, and enhance scalable services powering the mcp server, mcp gateway, and ai agent.

* own features end-to-end, from concept through production deployment and monitoring.

* collaborate with product and design partners to deeply understand user needs and deliver meaningful solutions.

* contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve system design and engineering practices.

* write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with a focus on performance and scalability.

* use logging, monitoring, and debugging tools to maintain high system reliability.

* evaluate new tools and technologies pragmatically, balancing innovation with real product value.

* create and maintain clear technical documentation and user-facing guides.

contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.  

  

**qualifications:**

* bachelor of science in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

* experience with at least one modern object-oriented programming language.

* strong collaboration and communication skills; direct, thoughtful, and transparent in discussions.

* solid understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, rest apis, design patterns).

interest in building production grade services using genai/agent frameworks (e.g., langchain, aws bedrock, copilot studio).  

  

**preferred skills:**

* experience with python and the postgresql ecosystem.

* familiarity with vector databases and mcp-based architectures.

* basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure like aws/azure

interest in financial markets, investing, or fund research.  



**compensation and benefits**

at morningstar we believe people are at their best when they are at their healthiest. that’s why we champion your wellness through a wide range of programs that support all stages of your personal and professional life. here are some examples of the offerings we provide:

* financial health

  + 100% 401k match up to 6% of salary
  + stock ownership potential
  + company provided life insurance - 1x salary + commission
* physical health

  + comprehensive health benefits (medical/dental/vision) including potential premium discounts and company-provided hsa contributions (up to $500-$2,000 annually) for specific plans and coverages
  + additional medical wellness incentives - up to $300-$600 annual
  + company-provided long- and short-term disability insurance
* emotional health

  + trust-based time off
  + 6-week paid sabbatical program
  + 6-week paid family caregiving leave
  + competitive 8-24 week paid parental leave
  + adoption assistance
  + leadership coaching & formal mentorship opportunities
  + annual flex stipend - $1000 annually to cover personal education & well-being expenses
  + tuition reimbursement
* social health

  + charitable matching gifts program
  + dollars for doers volunteer program
  + paid volunteering days
  + 15+ employee resource & affinity groups

**total cash compensation range**

$72,950.00-107,000.00

**inclusive of annual base salary and target incentive**

morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. in most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. a range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. no matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

design, build, secure, and operate enterprise integrations that connect applications, data, and ai agents. develop rest, soap, and event-driven integrations using mulesoft anypoint platform as the preferred integration platform, along with microsoft azure integration services. connect ai agents to enterprise apis, data, and workflows using standards such as model context protocol (mcp) and agent2agent (a2a).
  
  
**who we are:**  
at aaa washington, we equip our members with trusted service and expertise to confidently travel through life. we provide our members with best-in-class roadside assistance, discounts and rewards, travel services and insurance. for over 120 years, we’ve served our members, not shareholders, so our growth supports innovation for the club today and for the future. seeking to reflect the communities we serve and create an inclusive culture, we encourage employees to bring their full self to work and support applicants from all backgrounds, abilities and walks of life to apply.

you’ll play an important role in bringing aaa washington’s spirit of service and peace of mind to our membership. consistently ranked as one of the best places to work by puget sound business journal, we aim for work-life balance across the organization. we support hybrid and remote work options for many positions based in our corporate office (bellevue, washington) along with some of the best benefits in the region!

* proficiency in python, java, or c#.
* experience with infrastructure as code and ci/cd practices.
* experience supporting applications and integrations in production.

title: AI Engineer II
description:
**our deloitte human capital team transforms technology platforms, drives innovation, and helps make a significant impact on our clients' success. we are hiring an ai engineer to build and operate the data, features, and genai foundations that power human capital ai products and analytics. you will work with an ai data engineer (data ingestion, curation, governance, platform foundations) and a lead ai solutions architect (end-to-end solution architecture, integration patterns, non-functional requirements), partnering closely with product, data science/ml, security, and platform engineering to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable ai solutions.**  
  
**this role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will ship production pipelines and services that support model training, real-time inference, and llm applications using claude-, gpt/codex-, gemini-class, and other models, with strong governance, observability, and cost/performance discipline.**  
  
**recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.**  
  
**work you'll do**  
  
**as an ai and data science engineer ii on the hc forward team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and running the trusted, governed data, feature, and retrieval layer used by artificial intelligence/machine learning (ai/ml) and generative artificial intelligence (genai) solutions. you will deliver reproducible datasets and features, operationalize quality and lineage, and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive machine learning (ml) and large language model (llm)-based experiences.**  

* **partner with the lead ai solutions architect and ai data engineer to translate human capital product needs into secure, scalable technical designs and delivered solutions, including application programming interfaces (apis), services, pipelines, and containers/serverless solutions that meet availability, performance, and security expectations.**
* **build and operationalize llm-enabled capabilities, including copilots, human resources (hr) knowledge assistants, summarization, and policy question-and-answer experiences, using claude/gpt(codex)/gemini, including secure endpoints, tool/function calling, and reusable prompt/context patterns.**
* **implement llm application patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (rag), document ingestion/chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and retrieval/evaluation telemetry.**
* **deliver governed datasets and feature engineering/serving for ml training and real-time inference, including online/offline consistency, caching, latency service-level objectives (slos), and backfills.**
* **operationalize data quality and lineage and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive ml and llm-based experiences.**

  
**a successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* **ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team**
* **effective written and verbal communication skills**
* **meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product**
* **ability to build and sustain professional relationships**
* **ability to lead projects or workstreams**
* **ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment**
* **strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor**
* **ability to meet deadlines**
* **ability to provide clear guidance to others**

  
**the team**  
  
**hc forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of human capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply ai, data, and engineering to modernize hr experiences and outcomes.**  
  
**qualifications**  
  
**required:**  

* **bachelor's degree in a stem field (e.g., computer science, engineering, statistics, data science)**
* **2+ years building and delivering large language model (llm) and generative artificial intelligence (genai) solutions with claude/gpt(codex)/gemini-class models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration; and 2+ years implementing retrieval-augmented generation (rag)/retrieval, including document processing, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and enterprise governance controls.**
* **2+ years of data and artificial intelligence engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals; and 2+ years building production, real-time inference services, including application programming interface (api) design, latency/performance, and reliability patterns.**
* **2+ years leading platform/integration engineering across enterprise systems, including api/integration experience with representational state transfer (rest), graphql, event-driven capabilities, microservices, and middleware; and 2+ years of development operations (devops) and development, security, and operations (devsecops) experience, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (ci/cd), infrastructure as code (iac) using terraform/cloudformation, docker/kubernetes, observability, and monitoring.**
* **2+ years leading security/compliance efforts, including enterprise security controls-identity and access management (iam), encryption, secrets, and audit logging-and data/privacy controls-personally identifiable information (pii), retention, and access controls.**
* **ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.**
* **must be legally authorized to work in the united states without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.**

  
**preferred:**  

* **master's or doctoral degree and/or cloud and artificial intelligence/machine learning (ai/ml) certifications.**
* **2+ years of experience with human capital platforms and integrations, including workday, sap successfactors, oracle hcm, salesforce, and human resources (hr) data domains.**
* **2+ years of experience operationalizing large language model operations (llmops) and machine learning operations (mlops) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management; and 2+ years of cloud experience with one or more of amazon web services (aws), microsoft azure, or google cloud platform (gcp), including managed data platforms and compute patterns.**
* **2+ years translating business needs into documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and shippable increments using structured problem solving; and 2+ years documenting and communicating ai/genai trade-offs involving quality, latency, cost, and risk to stakeholders.**
* **2+ years collaborating across product, data science/machine learning, data engineering, platform, and security functions; and 2+ years performing threat testing, monitoring, and operational-readiness responsibilities.**
* **2+ years applying ethics and privacy practices to recognize consent, personally identifiable information (pii), and bias boundaries and escalate concerns; and experience with system and organization controls (soc) 2, the general data protection regulation (gdpr), or the health insurance portability and accountability act (hipaa).**

  
**the wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. at deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. a reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.**  
  
**you may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.**

title: Business Applications & AI Engineer
description:
**company description**

integrated dermatology is a leading national dermatology practice that acquires and partners with dermatology practices across the united states. the culture at id is a reflection of its people. our environment is filled with hard-working, dynamic individuals who come together to ensure the success of our partner dermatologists.

**position summary:**

the **business applications & ai engineer** is responsible for the strategy, design, customization, integration, administration, and continuous improvement of integrated dermatology's business application ecosystem. this position serves as the primary technical resource for dynamics 365, power platform, hubspot, microsoft copilot, ai solutions, workflow automation, and application integration initiatives across the organization.

the business applications & ai engineer works closely with business stakeholders, operational leadership, and technical teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, automate manual tasks, improve data quality, and deliver scalable business solutions. this role is responsible for gathering requirements, documenting business processes, developing technical solutions, managing application enhancements, and ensuring solutions align with organizational goals and governance standards.

the ideal candidate combines strong technical development skills with business analysis capabilities and can effectively translate business requirements into practical, maintainable technology solutions.

 **job description**  

* serve as the primary technical owner and subject matter expert for business applications including dynamics 365, power apps, dataverse, hubspot, microsoft copilot, and other enterprise business systems.
* design, develop, customize, configure, and maintain business applications, workflows, forms, automations, integrations, and data models to support business objectives.
* conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement-gathering sessions to identify business needs and document detailed functional and technical requirements.
* create business requirements documents, solution designs, scope documents, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* design, develop, and maintain integrations between enterprise applications utilizing apis, power automate, azure integration services, microsoft graph, web services, and other approved integration platforms.
* develop and support ai-enabled solutions leveraging microsoft copilot, copilot studio, power platform ai capabilities, azure ai services, and approved generative ai technologies.
* participate in agile development processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, effort estimation, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release management.
* collaborate with business leaders, department stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams to ensure successful delivery of business application solutions.
* develop and maintain operational and executive reporting solutions using microsoft power bi, including data preparation, semantic models, dashboards, reports, visualizations, and appropriate data-access controls.
* create and maintain application documentation, training materials, governance standards, support documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for workflow optimization, automation, system consolidation, and data standardization.
* establish and maintain application governance standards, security models, change control processes, development standards, testing procedures, and lifecycle management practices for business applications.
* coordinate with software vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, manage application enhancements, and evaluate new platform capabilities.
* develop and deliver user training, documentation, adoption strategies, and change-management activities for new business application solutions and ai initiatives.
* evaluate emerging ai technologies and identify opportunities to leverage microsoft copilot, copilot studio, azure ai services, and automation technologies to improve business outcomes and operational efficiency.

  
**qualifications**  

* advanced experience administering and customizing microsoft power platform, including power apps, power automate, and dataverse, with additional experience in dynamics 365, hubspot, or comparable business application platforms.
* experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations using apis, power automate, microsoft graph, rest services, webhooks, and related integration technologies.
* experience conducting requirements gathering, business process analysis, stakeholder interviews, and solution design activities.
* experience working in agile, scrum, kanban, or sprint-based application development environments.
* experience implementing and supporting microsoft copilot, copilot studio, ai-assisted workflows, automation solutions, or comparable ai technologies.
* strong understanding of relational databases, data modeling, application security, business process design, and platform governance.
* moderate hands-on experience with microsoft power bi, including power query, data modeling, report and dashboard development, basic dax, workspace management, scheduled refresh, and report security.
* strong communication, documentation, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* experience customizing crm, erp, workflow, business intelligence, or operational platforms within multi-location organizations.
* experience creating technical specifications, solution architecture documentation, user stories, process maps, and scope-of-work documentation.

**preferred qualifications**:

* databricks experience.
* power platform developer certification.
* dynamics 365 certification.
* hubspot sales hub or marketing hub certification.
* microsoft copilot certification.
* azure ai experience.
* business systems experience within healthcare organizations.

  
**additional information**

**job type:**

* full-time
* #li-hybrid

**experience:**

* 5+ years designing, customizing, developing, integrating, and supporting enterprise business applications, workflow automation solutions, and business process platforms.

**education:**

* bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, business technology, or related field preferred. equivalent professional experience may be considered.

**certifications/licenses:**

* microsoft power platform developer associate, dynamics 365 certification, microsoft copilot certification, azure ai certification, or comparable application-development certifications preferred.

this policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Network Site Reliability Engineer, AI Solutions Lab
description:
**about marvell**

marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. across enterprise, cloud and ai, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

at marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. for those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**your team, your impact**

the solutions architecture team sits within marvell's platform organization, which turns advanced silicon into deployable, customer-ready ai and cloud infrastructure. this team — the ai solutions lab — owns the validation layer that proves our platforms perform as promised, across compute, networking, and memory fabrics. without it, marvell could design great silicon but could never prove, at rack scale, that it performs the way customers expect — and hyperscalers don't buy chips on paper, they buy validated systems.  
  
day to day, the team runs ai benchmarking experiments that mirror real customer workloads, operates gpu/hpc lab clusters, validates marvell's teralynx switching and ai fabrics under production-like conditions, and builds live demos for trade shows — carrying platform programs from concept to production.  
  
what sets this team apart is breadth of ownership: engineers here aren't limited to validating a single switch chip — they work across the full breadth of marvell's ai platform portfolio, from teralynx network fabrics to integrated optical platforms like co-packaged optics (cpo) and near-packaged optics (npo), as well as emerging memory fabric products such as cxl and photonic fabric memory appliances. this cross-domain ownership — networking, optics, and memory, together — is work that's often siloed across separate teams elsewhere, and the results feed directly into customer proof points and executive reviews.

**what you can expect**

the nre/sre engineer owns the compute and software foundation of the ai solutions lab. this role is responsible for building, standardizing, and operating the environments required to validate marvell solutions across customer-relevant workloads, including scale-up, scale-out, memory acceleration, and dpu-enabled use cases.

**key responsibilities**

* own compute provisioning, cluster bring-up, os images, rocm and nic driver stacks, and environment standardization for lab systems.
* build and maintain mlperf-style harnesses, workload libraries, test plans, result pipelines, and dashboards to support repeatable validation.
* establish baseline observability for cluster health, job execution, failures, utilization, and regression tracking.
* deploy and manage workload scheduling and orchestration (kubernetes and/or slurm) as the primary means of running validation and benchmark jobs across the lab.
* own incident response for lab infrastructure, driving root-cause analysis and reliability improvements after cluster or job failures.
* partner with architects, network engineers, and performance engineers to ensure lab environments accurately reflect target customer deployments.
* improve repeatability and operational efficiency through automation, infrastructure, code, and standardized workflows.
* support cross-functional validation efforts and help convert lab output into reusable internal and external assets.

**what we're looking for**

**education and certifications**

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field; a phd is a plus.
* linux certifications, cka certification, or similar kubernetes certifications are preferred.

**required qualifications**

* ms in electrical/computer engineering, computer science, or related field; 6+ years of experience as a software/systems engineer, with at least 4+ years of linux/infrastructure experience.
* strong linux systems experience at scale, including solid data center and cluster operations fundamentals; development experience across both windows and linux environments.
* proficient in python/tcl scripting and automation, with familiarity in c/c++ api development; proficiency in python specifically for metrics, observability, and pipeline automation.
* experience with automation tools such as ansible and terraform.
* experience building and maintaining test harnesses, workload libraries, test plans, result pipelines, and dashboards to support repeatable validation.
* experience establishing baseline observability for cluster/system health, job execution, failures, utilization, and regression tracking.
* hands-on experience with workload scheduling and orchestration (kubernetes and/or slurm) in a lab or production environment.
* excellent understanding of sw development flows, methodology, and production sw test policies and practices.
* excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills; customer-facing experience required.
* ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced lab environment

**preferred qualifications**

* experience operating ai or hpc clusters in a lab or production environment.
* working familiarity with a distributed training framework (pytorch ddp/fsdp, nemo, or similar) sufficient to interpret job failures, not just infrastructure symptoms.
* working knowledge of at least one distributed-storage or parallel filesystem technology (e.g., lustre, gpfs, beegfs, ceph), since cluster performance is frequently storage-bound.
* basic experience with model tuning and workload optimization.

**expected base pay range (usd)**

131,010 - 196,300, $ per annum

the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. the expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

this role is eligible to participate in marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**additional compensation and benefit elements**

marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. we look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact marvell hr helpdesk at taops@marvell.com.

**interview integrity**

to support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use ai tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like chatgpt or copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

these tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. use of ai tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**this position may require access to technology and/or software subject to u.s. export control laws and regulations, including the export administration regulations (ear). as such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the u.s. department of commerce and/or the u.s. department of state. except for u.s. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 u.s.c. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
the ai solutions engineer will be embedded within mirion’s medical business units and partners directly with manufacturing, quality, service, and business teams to identify opportunities for improvement and deliver ai-driven solutions that produce measurable operational results. the ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with hands-on ai expertise and thrives in fast-paced environments where business impact is the primary measure of success.
  
reporting directly to the chief ai & digital officer, this position offers direct exposure to enterprise ai strategy while providing the autonomy to build and deploy solutions that improve how the business operates.
  
  
**key areas of responsibility:**  
identify and prioritize business opportunities
  

* embed within medical business units to develop a deep understanding of operational workflows, challenges, and priorities.
* participate in leadership meetings, observe manufacturing operations, and collaborate closely with quality, service, engineering, and product teams.
* identify manual, repetitive, error-prone, or inefficient processes that may benefit from automation or ai-driven improvements.

* experience working with cloud platforms such as microsoft azure, amazon web services (aws), or google cloud platform (gcp).

* demonstrated ability to independently identify opportunities, define solutions, and successfully execute complex projects with minimal supervision.
* excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

preferred qualifications
  

* experience developing computer vision solutions using technologies such as opencv, pytorch, tensorflow, or equivalent frameworks.
* experience with azure ai, aws bedrock, databricks, openai, claude, or similar ai platforms and services.
* experience within regulated industries such as medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* familiarity with quality management systems and regulatory frameworks, including iso 13485, fda qsr, or qmsr requirements.
* experience serving as an embedded, customer-facing, forward-deployed, or solutions-focused engineer.
* knowledge of radiation therapy, nuclear medicine, dosimetry, diagnostic imaging, or related healthcare technologies.

title: Cyber Security Cloud Engineer
description:
company overview

ncs is a leading industrial products, services and technology company whose primary end-market is car wash operators. ncs provides a full suite of manufactured equipment, installation project services, aftermarket parts and services, chemicals (detergents, protectants, etc.), and software. more specifically with equipment, ncs provides tunnel equipment, iba (in bay automatic), vacuums, dryers, water systems, doors, signage, arches, and related components. ncs also sells a range of brands – on both equipment, chemicals and software today – including armor all, rain-x, blue coral, tss, vacutech, ncs, amp, etc. the company sells primarily in n. america, operates 6 manufacturing plants across n. america, and has ~1600+ employees. the company operates numerous distribution centers and has sales/hq offices across n. america, with its primary corporate offices in des moines, iowa and dallas, tx. ncs is currently owned by berkshire partners, a leading boston-based pe firm

**we are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the united states. however, we are not currently able to sponsor work visas.**

**position summary**

the cyber security cloud engineer is the hands-on engineer responsible for implementing, operating, and maturing security controls across ncs's cloud environment, including microsoft azure, amazon web services, and the enterprise saas platforms that run the business. ncs operates within an established set of nist-based enterprise security requirements that define the controls, reporting cadences, and audit expectations for the business. this role implements the security controls that protect our cloud, saas, identity, workload, and data environments, and serves as the security lead for integrating newly acquired companies into the ncs security framework. as ncs invests in ai to transform how we serve customers and run the business, this engineer ensures those initiatives are deployed with the required safeguards in place. the engineer also partners with product engineering and devops teams to put required security controls into practice across the software development lifecycle for ncs products, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms. the role works closely with infrastructure, networking, data, application development, and business stakeholders, and provides security leadership with clear visibility into control status, gaps, and remediation progress. success in this role means delivering required controls on schedule, demonstrating their effectiveness, and reducing enterprise risk without slowing the business.

**key responsibilities**

**cloud security implementation & operations**

* implement and maintain security controls across azure and aws in accordance with ncs security requirements and the enterprise security framework, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* deploy and operate cloud security posture management (cspm/cnapp), infrastructure-as-code guardrails, policy-as-code, and automated compliance checks that enforce required baselines and provide continuous evidence of control effectiveness.

* operate and tune cloud-native security services (e.g., microsoft defender for cloud, microsoft sentinel, entra id protection, aws guardduty, security hub, cloudtrail, iam access analyzer) and integrate cloud telemetry into enterprise siem detection and response workflows.

* execute detection engineering and incident response for cloud-hosted and identity-centric threats, including alert triage, investigation, root cause analysis, containment, and remediation coordination with managed security providers, following established playbooks and escalation paths; track emerging cloud attack techniques and recommend updates to detections, hardening, and response procedures.

**acquisition integration & migration**

* support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions by executing technical assessments of target environments and documenting gaps against ncs security requirements to inform prioritized integration plans.

* execute the secure integration and migration of acquired companies onto ncs platforms, including identity consolidation into microsoft entra id, tenant-to-tenant microsoft 365 migrations, workload migrations to azure and aws, network and endpoint onboarding, and decommissioning of legacy infrastructure.

* maintain and follow repeatable, documented integration playbooks and security baselines that bring acquired entities to the required security standard within defined integration timelines, with status reporting throughout.

**devops & product security**

* implement and operate required security controls across the ci/cd pipeline in partnership with product engineering and devops teams, including static and dynamic application security testing (sast/dast), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container image scanning, and software bill of materials (sbom) generation, with risk-based gates that protect release velocity.

* support secure product development for ncs software, connected equipment, and customer-facing platforms through threat modeling, secure design reviews, application of secure coding standards, api security, and vulnerability management, with particular attention to payment-enabled and field-deployed systems.

* track product security metrics, maintain developer-facing documentation, and uphold remediation slas that give engineering teams clear, actionable ownership of security findings.

**compliance, reporting & leadership**

* implement the data protection, dlp, identity governance, and access controls required to securely enable approved ai initiatives, including microsoft 365 copilot, azure openai, aws bedrock, and enterprise ai tooling, in partnership with data, it, and business teams.

* maintain security controls across microsoft 365, identity, endpoint (windows and apple), and cloud platforms in line with ncs security requirements; produce the evidence, metrics, and documentation needed for pci-dss compliance, nist csf alignment, internal and external audits, executive security reviews, and customer security assessments.

* mentor engineers, serve as the escalation point for complex cloud and identity security issues, and report clearly on control status, gaps, risk, and remediation progress to technical and executive audiences.

**required qualifications**

* 5 or more years of progressive experience in it, with broad exposure to infrastructure, networking, identity, and enterprise systems.

* 3 or more years of hands-on experience in a dedicated cybersecurity role, including securing production workloads in microsoft azure and/or aws.

* demonstrated experience implementing security controls within an established enterprise security framework, including translating defined control requirements, audit findings, and assessment results into deployed, documented, and measurable controls.

* hands-on implementation experience with cloud security services and patterns on at least one major platform (azure or aws) and solid familiarity with the other, including iam, network security, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection.

* experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform, bicep, cloudformation), ci/cd platforms (e.g., azure devops, github, gitlab), and application security tooling (sast/dast, sca, secrets and container scanning), with a track record of partnering with development teams to embed security into the sdlc.

* working knowledge of the nist cybersecurity framework and experience supporting pci-dss compliance and audit or assessment processes, including evidence collection and remediation tracking.

* clear, professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to report control status, gaps, and remediation progress to technical and non-technical audiences.

**preferred qualifications**

* one or more current, industry-recognized security certifications such as cissp, ccsp, aws certified security – specialty, or microsoft certified: azure security engineer associate (az-500); equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.

* direct experience executing security workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures, including tenant-to-tenant migrations and identity consolidation.

* experience securing ai/ml platforms and services (azure openai, aws bedrock, microsoft 365 copilot, enterprise data platforms) and familiarity with the nist ai rmf, owasp top 10 for llm applications, or similar frameworks.

* experience with cspm/cnapp platforms, container and kubernetes security, and secrets management.

* experience implementing or maturing a product or application security program, including familiarity with owasp asvs and samm, nist ssdf, or similar secure development frameworks, and tooling such as github advanced security or equivalent integrated devsecops platforms.

* experience securing embedded, iot, or payment-enabled products, including pci-dss considerations for software and device design.

* scripting and automation proficiency (powershell, python, etc.) for detection engineering and security tooling.

* experience in manufacturing, distribution, or field service environments, including connected equipment and payment systems.

**core competencies & leadership expectations**

* takes ownership of assigned controls and initiatives and follows through to measurable, documented completion.

* executes with discipline against established standards while exercising sound judgment on how to implement them with minimal business friction.

* demonstrates calm, decisive leadership during incidents and high-pressure situations.

* provides clear, pragmatic implementation guidance to peers and leadership on cloud, product, and ai risk.

**physical requirements & work environment**

* primarily office-based or remote-office work using a computer and standard office equipment for extended periods.

* ability to communicate effectively through phone, video, and in-person meetings.

* periodic participation in after-hours incident response or maintenance windows.

* occasional travel to ncs facilities and acquired-company locations to support integration activities.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Vulnerability Management
description:
about github: github is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the fortune 100 companies, use github to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted github copilot.  
locations: in this role you can work from remote, united states  
overview:

securing the home for all developers starts with securing github itself. as a senior software engineer on the vulnerability management engineering team, you’ll build and run the systems that find vulnerabilities across github’s services and infrastructure, get each one to the team that owns it, and control how our code, packages, and container images are sourced and built. it’s backend and distributed systems work where the users are other engineers, and you’ll build deep expertise in vulnerability management and software supply chain security along the way.

we are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. we believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. great products reflect the teams that build them.

responsibilities:

* design, develop, test and ship high-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple github services.

* build the platform that collects security findings from container image, cloud, host, and code scanning, matches each finding to the team that owns it, and tracks remediation through risk scoring, slas, and exceptions.

* design and roll out software supply chain controls, such as authenticated package and container proxies that enforce policy, across github actions, docker builds, and dependabot, in a way teams can adopt without slowing down.

* build systems that meet compliance requirements such as fedramp, and evolve production services without breaking the apis other teams rely on.

* collaborate with cross-functional teams, including service owners, platform engineering, cloud security, and compliance, to define and implement innovative solutions.

* provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others.

* own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on-call and first responder rotations.

* write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to learn how we can achieve planetary scale with our systems.

* become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code.

  
qualifications:

**required qualifications**

* 6+ years experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, c, c++, c#, java, javascript, go, ruby, rust, or python

  + or associate’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field and 5+ years experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, c, c++, c#, java, javascript, go, ruby, rust, or python
  + or bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field and 4+ years experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, c, c++, c#, java, javascript, go, ruby, rust, or python
  + or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field and 2+ years experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, c, c++, c#, java, javascript, go, ruby, rust, or python
  + or doctorate in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, math, physics, computer engineering, computer science, or related field.
  + or equivalent experience.

**preferred qualifications**

* 2+ years experience using general purpose and scripting languages (e.g., go, python, or a similar language).
* 3+ years experience with cloud environments and/or cloud native computing foundation (cncf) concepts.

compensation range: the base salary range for this job is usd $124,000.00 - usd $329,200.00 /yr.  
  
these pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the united states. an individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. at github certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. these rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. in addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.  
  
this position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in ai, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to mars (and beyond!). at github, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. we’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
