title: Product Support Solutions Developer
description:
with 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, recorded future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

the **product support solutions developer** designs, builds, and maintains the technical infrastructure, tools, and automated workflows that power the customer support function. combining technical development expertise with support operations and enablement, this role is responsible for architecting scalable internal tooling, engineering custom integrations, and leveraging ai agents/automations to drive operational efficiency, reduce resolution times, and elevate customer satisfaction.

### **what you'll do:**

#### **1. custom tooling & integration development**

* design, build, and maintain custom applications, scripts, and webhook integrations across core support systems (e.g., zendesk, jira, salesforce service cloud, domo, statuspage).
* architect and optimize api connections, custom middleware, and automated workflows to streamline ticket routing, data syncs, and escalations.
* build custom ui components, apps, and macros within support platforms to enhance agent efficiency and desktop experience.
* determines methods and procedures for new or undefined assignments, considering company objectives—not only functional needs—to shape solutions

#### **2. ai agent & automation implementation**

* lead the evaluation, development, and deployment of ai agents, llm-powered assistants, and chatbots to automate tier-1 support interactions and internal agent assistance.
* fine-tune ai agent prompt workflows, knowledge ingestion pipelines, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) models to improve self-service resolution rates.
* monitor and continuously optimize ai agent performance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

#### **3. support operations & tool management**

* administer, configure, and optimize support systems, maintaining slas, routing rules, triggers, and automated workflows.
* conduct regular quality, tag, and compliance audits across systems to ensure high data integrity and adherence to support processes.
* assist platform operations and support leadership with outage communication tooling, incident escalation paths, and client updates.

#### **4. data engineering, analytics & reporting**

* build and maintain complex analytics dashboards and data pipelines (e.g., zendesk explore, domo, sql) to track kpis like ticket volume, mttr, csat, and backlog trends.
* partner with product analytics to build unified data reporting layers across disparate platforms.
* perform root-cause analysis on platform trends and negative csat ratings to identify automation opportunities and systemic fixes.

#### **5. technical enablement & process improvement**

* collaborate with support leadership to design and deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for support staff.
* digest complex product handoffs from product and engineering teams, translating them into technical documentation, live training modules, and internal knowledge base resources.
* partner with documentation and training teams to create client-facing self-service e-learnings and articles that reduce inbound ticket volume.
* continuously audit support workflows to identify operational bottlenecks, create documented procedures to improve them, and develop automated solutions as necessary to eliminate them.
* maintains key relationships outside their area of expertise to bolster unified process improvement where necessary

### **what you'll bring:**

#### **required:**

* **experience:** 3+ years of experience in product support engineering, support operations, technical support, or developer relations.
* **development & scripting:** hands-on programming experience (e.g., python, javascript/node.js, rest apis, webhooks, json) to build custom tooling and integrations.
* **platform expertise:** deep administrator/developer experience with customer support ecosystems (e.g., zendesk api/apps framework, jira service management, salesforce, freshdesk).
* **data & analytics:** strong sql skills and experience building dashboards in bi tools (e.g., domo, tableau, looker) or native reporting engines (zendesk explore).
* **operations & enablement:** proven ability to document sops, lead technical training, and optimize operational support workflows.
* **communication:** strong cross-functional collaboration skills to liaise effectively between engineering, product, and support teams.

#### **preferred:**

* **ai & automation experience:** hands-on experience developing or implementing ai agents, llm apis (e.g., openai, anthropic), conversational ai frameworks, or agentic frameworks (e.g., langchain, autogen).
* **knowledge management for ai:** experience with vector databases, prompt engineering, or managing knowledge bases optimized for ai search/rag architectures.
* **best practices:** familiarity with itil framework, agile methodology, or devops deployment practices.

  

*the base salary range for this full-time position is $**127,500 - 191,500**. our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. the salary displayed reflects the range for new hire salaries for the position across all us locations. within the range, individual pay is determined by state, work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. this position may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401k. your recruiter can share more about the specific details of the compensation and benefit package during the hiring process.*

title: Cloud Developer
description:
**position summary:**  
the cloud developer performs critical infrastructure and development functions for vanderbilt’s
  
growing initiatives in digital scholarship, cloud-based research computing, and generative ai
  
(genai) deployment. working closely with technologists across the heard libraries and other
  
campus units, the cloud developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the
  
scalable cloud infrastructure required to make research data scalable and accessible. given the
  
agile, collaborative nature of the work unit, this role demands a blend of deep technical
  
execution, nimble project management, and mentorship capabilities. the cloud developer will
  
serve as a "principal engineer" within our experiential learning programs, helping to manage
  
student developers, architect "fail-fast" innovations, and scale computational solutions for wide
  
impact.

**about the work unit:**  
the jean and alexander heard libraries at vanderbilt university comprise nine libraries and
  
multiple specialized service departments. the libraries are fundamental to the university’s goal
  
of advancing scholarship and learning by collecting, preserving, and making accessible a wide
  
variety of resources,and partnering with faculty and students to shape research. the digital lab
  
advances the creation, development, and sustainability of faculty and student-driven digital
  
projects. as an applied research and learning center, the lab transforms unstructured library
  
collections into machine-readable computational assets and builds cutting-edge software
  
solutions leveraging generative ai. the aws-sponsored vanderbilt cloud innovation lab
  
(vcil), which provides immersive, hands-on software development experiences for student
  
fellows, is a core focus of this work. by embedding students directly into professional
  
engineering workflows as junior developers, the digital lab bridges advanced faculty research, technical mentorship, and scalable cloud infrastructure to broaden computational innovation across campus.

**key functions and expected performance:**

cloud architecture & software development
  
design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily aws) to
  
host digital scholarship platforms and process massive library archives.

implement and scale generative ai pipelines and machine-learning models to automate metadata enrichment and text extraction.
  
ensure faculty and institutional projects are built on modern, sustainable, and well-documented technical stacks that integrate efficiently with broader university infrastructure.

**position description**  
project management & operational delivery
  
manage the full lifecycle of assigned digital projects, tracking timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation across partner units.
  
serve as an agile project manager for select faculty-driven r&d initiatives, ensuring transparent communication and consistent progress.
  
coordinate technical requirements and scope with key campus partners, including research it, the advanced computing center for research & education (accre), and the data science institute.

student mentorship & team leadership
  
recruit, interview, and hire undergraduate and graduate student fellows and research assistants.
  
act as a "principal engineer" by embedding students into professional software development workflows, conducting code reviews, and providing technical mentorship.
  
guide student teams through real-world deployment challenges, balancing structured learning with hands-on software delivery.

sustained innovation & grant support
  
in coordination with digital lab leadership, write staff technical expertise and infrastructure costs into external grant applications.
  
explore and implement "fail-fast" innovations using emerging technologies to maintain
  
the lab's best-in-class standing in genai and research computing.

**education and certifications**  
undergraduate degree in computer science, cloud computing, data science, or a related
  
technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience and industry certifications is
  
required. postgraduate degree preferred.

aws certified solutions architect, sysops administrator, or developer certification is
  
highly preferred.

**experience and skills:**  
two to four years of relevant experience is necessary.
  
technical skills & experience
  
cloud infrastructure: proven experience provisioning and managing cloud
  
environments, preferably aws (including ec2, s3, lambda, and iam infrastructure), is required.
  
development & frameworks: proficiency in programming languages common to data
  
processing and cloud back-ends (e.g., python, node.js) is required. experience with
  
modern web frameworks and frontend development is preferred.
  
ai & data pipelines: familiarity with deploying generative ai models, vector databases,
  
or orchestration frameworks, as well as handling distributed data storage is required.
  
tooling: experience with version control (git), ci/cd pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code
  
(iac) is required.

**core competencies**  
leadership & collaboration: evidence of strong interpersonal skills and translating
  
complex technical requirements for non-technical faculty or students is required.
  
experience with mentoring novice developers is highly preferred.
  
organization: demonstrated ability to manage multiple small-to-medium digital projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, collaborative environment is required.

title: Sr Scientist, Tech - Science
description:
**about the role**  
  
the rider team is the centerpiece of the uber consumer experience, owning the flagship app used by over 100m monthly active users.  
the personalization team builds the ranking, recommendation and agentic systems that shape what millions of riders see and do in the app. we are looking for a senior scientist to bring scientific rigor to this work and to help set its direction. you will be an experimentation and causal inference expert with strong ml fluency who will own how we measure whether our ai/ml systems are working, and you will use deep-dive analysis to show the team where the biggest opportunities are. you will partner closely with applied scientists and ml engineers to ensure we can trust our results, understand why a model wins or loses, and focus the roadmap on what moves rider outcomes.  
  
**what you'll do**

* own experimentation for personalization. design, run and analyze experiments for ranking, recommendation and agentic features. this includes interleaving, holdouts, switchbacks, and variance reduction (e.g., cuped/regression adjustment). use difference-in-differences, synthetic control, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, or propensity methods, and be clear about the identifying assumptions.
* close the gap between offline and online evaluation. build offline evaluation and simulation frameworks (e.g., ndcg/mrr, counterfactual and off-policy evaluation). diagnose why offline gains don't show up online, including novelty effects, distribution shift and training-serving skew.
* go deep on the data. run deep-dive analyses of rider behavior, funnels, and ranking and recommendation outcomes. include heterogeneous treatment effects and long-term versus short-term tradeoffs. surface proactive insights that change what the team builds next.
* define success, guardrail and long-term metrics for personalization surfaces. make results easy to find and use through dashboards, query templates and debugging tools.
* shape the roadmap. turn analysis into clear recommendations for pms, engineers and applied scientists, and help the team decide which bets to prioritize and which to stop.
* raise the scientific bar. review experiment designs and model evaluations, mentor junior scientists, and share best practices across the team. partner with applied scientists on experiment design for new ml approaches (e.g., listwise ranking, reinforcement learning, evidential deep learning, llm-based/agentic applications).
* stay current on advances in causal inference, experimentation and personalization ai/ml.

**basic qualifications**

* m.s. or bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, operations research, or another quantitative field.
* 5+ years of industry experience as a data scientist, applied scientist, research scientist, or equivalent, with a track record of owning experimentation and/or causal inference end to end.
* deep expertise in experiment design and analysis (power, variance reduction, multiple testing, interference/network effects) and in observational causal inference methods.
* working knowledge of machine learning. you can critique and debug models, understand ranking/recommender approaches and common failure modes, and use ml as an analytical tool.
* proficiency in python and sql, plus pyspark or similar big-data tools. you can build production-quality analysis pipelines.
* strong business and product sense. you can frame ambiguous problems, take them end to end, and communicate recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners

**preferred qualifications**

* ph.d. or m.s. in statistics, economics, or a related field with a causal inference or econometrics focus.
* experience evaluating ranking, recommender, search or feed systems (offline vs. online evaluation, interleaving, counterfactual evaluation).
* experience with heterogeneous treatment effects, uplift modeling, or long-term effect estimation/surrogate metrics.
* experience measuring or evaluating llm-based or agentic applications.
* hands-on experience with ml frameworks (scikit-learn, pytorch or tensorflow), and with good practices such as design documentation, testing and git.
* history of mentoring and raising the technical bar for a team.

  
for new york city, ny-based roles: the base salary range for this role is usd $190,000 per year - usd $211,000 per year.  
  
you will be eligible to participate in uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. all full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. you will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**ready to ride?**  
  
this isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. if you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
you may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. explore our benefits.  
  
offices remain key to collaboration and uber's culture. unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. ask your recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Rust / C++
description:
**job description:**

  

thomson reuters is hiring senior software engineers to build the core of the document-processing platform behind our ai products. the platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue-driven pipeline. it powers flagship products like westlaw and cocounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. the work is mostly rust in du core, with regular work in the c#/.net services (du apps) that sit in front of it. as a senior software engineer ii, you’ll lead high-impact projects across core and apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team.

  

**key responsibilities:**

* turn asks into requirements. take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and how we’ll know it worked
* design with explicit trade-offs. write design docs and adrs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path.
* define the architecture. shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong.
* find and fix bottlenecks. use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show.
* build and run the processing pipeline end to end. it’s a queue-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. that means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput.
* work across core and apps. you’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend rust services, but be willing to pivot to c#/.net to support the customer-facing services that sit in front of them.
* evolve contracts safely. change message schemas, api surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on.
* keep a strong engineering mindset. prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it.
* work agentically. write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. evaluate ai tools for specific use cases. you own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it.
* improve how humans and agents work here. evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. write code, docs and prs clear enough that a new teammate and an ai agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants.
* own it in production. instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes.
* lead high-impact work. own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break
* them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed.
* raise the team’s bar. mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review.
influence direction. translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership  

  

**required qualifications:**

* 7+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in rust or c++. if your background is c++, you should be keen to work in rust day to day.
* experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi-region or highly available systems.
* experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
founded in richmond, virginia in 1997, capcenter exists to help individuals and families achieve one of life's most meaningful milestones—homeownership. by bringing mortgage, realty, and insurance services together under one roof, we provide a simpler, more transparent experience designed to save clients time and money. our commitment to innovation, including our zero closing cost mortgage, has earned the trust of thousands of clients and fueled our growth through repeat business and referrals.

at capcenter, our mission extends beyond serving clients. we foster a collaborative, high-impact environment where employees are empowered to do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make a real difference in the lives of the people we serve.

**job overview:**

we are seeking an innovative **ai software engineer** to design, build, and deploy advanced software solutions that transform both internal mortgage operations and external customer experiences. this role combines software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud-native infrastructure, and mortgage-industry problem-solving to deliver tools that increase efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

**key responsibilities:**

***ai-driven software development***

* architect, develop, and deploy ai-powered applications for internal operations (e.g., loan processing tools, underwriting automation, compliance checks, workflow optimization).
* build customer-facing and marketing-facing software such as intelligent chat assistants, personalized loan recommendation engines, automated prequalification tools, and interactive calculators.
* integrate ai models (llms, predictive models, generative ai) into new or existing products using modern development frameworks and apis.

***cloud infrastructure & deployment***

* design, deploy, and operate applications on microsoft azure, using services such as azure kubernetes service (aks), app service, azure functions, azure sql, storage, key vault, and azure openai / ai foundry.
* containerize applications with docker and run them on kubernetes. this includes writing and maintaining manifests and helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits.
* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines (azure devops or github actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably.
* manage cloud resources with infrastructure-as-code (terraform, bicep, or arm templates).
* implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (azure monitor, application insights, log analytics) to keep production ai services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up.
* apply cloud security best practices, including entra id (azure ad) identity and role-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. all of this should meet the data-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information.
* optimize cloud cost and performance for ai workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and gpu/compute usage.

***collaborative product engineering***

* partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high-impact use cases for ai and translate them into scalable products.
* work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation.
* develop secure, compliant, and well-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements.

***model development & optimization***

* train, fine-tune, or customize ai models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows.
* implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for ai models in production.
* evaluate emerging ai technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization.

***technical leadership & best practices***

* establish development standards for ai-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance.
* provide guidance on responsible ai usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments.
* contribute to long-term ai strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience.

**qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications.
* hands-on experience with machine learning or generative ai tools (openai, anthropic, huggingface, langchain, vector databases, etc.).
* proficiency in languages such as python, typescript/javascript, or c#.
* strong working knowledge of microsoft azure, including hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and key vault).
* solid experience with containers and kubernetes (preferably aks), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl.
* experience building and maintaining ci/cd pipelines for containerized applications.
* understanding of apis, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns.

**preferred:**

* experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems.
* familiarity with mortgage workflows: los, pos, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations.
* microsoft azure certifications (e.g., az-204 developer, az-104 administrator, az-305 solutions architect, or ai-102 ai engineer) and/or kubernetes certifications (cka or ckad).
* experience with infrastructure-as-code (terraform or bicep) and gitops or helm-based deployment workflows.
* experience deploying and scaling ai/llm workloads on azure (azure openai, ai foundry, or self-hosted models on aks).
* knowledge of mlops tools and frameworks for model deployment.
* experience building customer-facing digital experiences.

**key competencies:**

* strong problem-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions.
* ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non-technical teams.
* ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
* curiosity and eagerness to explore new ai capabilities.
* commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible ai use.

**compensation:**

the estimated range of $90,000 – $115,000 reflects the budgeted amount for this position. individual compensation will be determined based on job-related business considerations, such as relevant qualifications, experience, location, education, certifications, skills, and other job-related reasons. where applicable, this position is eligible for incentive compensation and/or discretionary bonus opportunities.

**benefits:**

capcenter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, and other programs designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees.

**physical requirements and work environment:**

work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may involve extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, and telephone or virtual communication. the position may require managing competing priorities, responding to time-sensitive matters, maintaining accuracy and attention to detail, and working effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**reasonable accommodation:**

as required by law, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**equal opportunity employer:**

capcenter is an equal opportunity employer (veteran/disability). all qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Data Platform Architect (Data 360)
description:
**data platform architect (d360)**  
  
we are looking for a data platform architect to help us support our continued growth. the data platform architect is responsible for owning the overall design of the technical solution as well as recommending best practice solutions based on client needs. they provide technical guidance to the development of salesforce.com and other saas applications to support business and product strategies, with a heavy emphasis on maximizing the salesforce data 360 (d360) ecosystem.  
  
a data platform architect facilitates discovery sessions to understand client processes and challenges and translates findings into technical requirements supported by a documented solution design. they provide thoughtful leadership and communication to project and client team members in order to build the foundation as a trusted partner.  
  
**role responsibilities:**

* data architecture design:
  + enterprise d360 harmonization: develop and implement data architectures that align with business needs and leverage salesforce data 360 (d360) capabilities for unified profile management, data democratization, and real-time activation.
  + modern cloud integration: design and implement data solutions that bridge enterprise cloud data platforms (data lakes/warehouses) with the salesforce ecosystem to address specific business needs, such as business intelligence (bi), etl/elt, and ai/ml.
  + legacy migration: assist with the migration, ingestion, and mapping of customer data from legacy systems and siloed databases into the salesforce d360 platform.
  + governance & trust: ensure data accessibility, data privacy, granular security controls, and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., gdpr, ccpa) and industry standards within the customer data ecosystem.
* data modeling & pipeline design:
  + ingestion & streaming pipelines: design and implement real-time streaming and batch data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading high-volume enterprise data into salesforce d360 from various cloud sources and apis.
  + d360 identity resolution: design and implement scalable data models and metadata architectures within salesforce d360, expertly defining identity resolution rules, reconciliation rules, and unified data graphs.
  + performance optimization: monitor and optimize query performance, calculated insights, identity resolution runs, and data transformation processes within the salesforce d360 and underlying lakehouse environment.
* technical leadership and collaboration:
  + cross-functional collaboration: collaborate with key stakeholders—including business users, data engineers, data scientists, and crm it teams—to understand requirements and deliver unified data solutions.
  + ecosystem evaluation: evaluate and select appropriate tools, connectors, and zero-copy/zero-data-movement technologies for seamless data integration, transformation, and activation within the salesforce d360 ecosystem.
  + technical guidance: provide technical leadership, architectural oversight, and best-practice guidance to data engineering and crm development teams.

**experience/skills required:**

* 5+ years of experience in solutions architecture or technical consulting for cloud data platforms with multiple enterprise workstreams.
* deep understanding of salesforce d360 (data cloud) architecture & capabilities: expert knowledge of the data model (dmos, dsos), identity resolution, data spaces, calculated insights, and activation targets.
* data modernization advocate: passionate about modern data architecture methods, including lakehouse architecture, zero-copy data sharing, and real-time data activation.
* broad data ecosystem experience: comprehensive range of experience in enterprise database technology, cloud data warehouses (e.g., snowflake, databricks), etl/elt tools, data engineering pipelines, and data science principles.
* elite communication: strong verbal and presentation abilities, capable of effectively communicating complex data architecture concepts to stakeholders and prospective clients at all levels of an organization.
* strategic roadmap leadership: demonstrable experience leading strategy and digital roadmap projects in a complex business environment. proven ability to guide clients toward optimal standard solutions when initial custom designs are not a fit.
* technical tooling & development: experience with data-centric programming languages (such as sql and python) as well as salesforce application development components (apex, flow, lwcs, mulesoft).
* advanced architecture patterns: deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns, api management, and real-time data streaming technologies (e.g., kafka, amazon kinesis).
* structured data modeling: mastery of data modeling methodologies (such as kimball dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, or medallion bronze/silver/gold structures) and how they map into a canonical customer 360 model.
* us authorization: must have full-time permanent us work authorization.

**additional preferred experience/skills:**

* bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* salesforce certified data cloud consultant or accredited professional designations.
* hands-on experience with core salesforce crm technology like sales cloud, service cloud, or industry clouds (e.g., financial services cloud, health cloud).
* hands-on experience deploying ai/ml solutions like salesforce einstein, aws sagemaker, or google vertex ai, alongside a solid understanding of generative ai patterns (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation / rag).
* experience designing data architectures on cloud platforms like amazon web services, microsoft azure, or google cloud platform.
* hands-on expertise with analytics and visualization tools like tableau, crm analytics, powerbi, or looker.
* open to travel based on client and business demands.

**why coastal, and what we offer:**

* flexible working hours with an emphasis on a life-work balance (in that order!)
* remote flexible work; plus company office locations in palm coast, fl; atlanta, ga; tysons, va & lexington, ky; travel as required to client locations
* unlimited paid time off (rto), 401k with company match, and medical, vision, & dental coverage
* competitive quarterly bonus opportunities
* continuing education and certification reimbursements, specifically within the salesforce and snowflake ecosystems; plus occasional in-house competitions with spot bonuses
* a flexible and fun team culture! we value transparency, support, flexibility, growth, teamwork, fun, and so much more
* frequent team and culture activities, virtual & in-person, including lunch and learns, happy hours, team-building events
* monthly all-hands calls to bring the company together, and an open-door leadership policy with access to mentorship and guidance
* opportunities for accelerated growth, networking, and career guidance and support
* trust, transparency and respect across all levels of the company

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
who are we?

prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. we are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

this is precision cardiology, and we know it's within reach.

what will you do?

**the overview**

as a senior data engineer, you will design, build, and run that pipeline in a regulated environment. you will work closely with the data science/clinical teams, which owns the medical and research questions. you will also work with the data architect on platform standards, data models, and governance.

**the specifics**

**build and evolve the data platform (prolaio data ecosystem)**

* + design, build, and maintain batch, streaming, and hybrid pipelines orchestrated with dagster. these cover ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, and publishing of the data.
  + develop and maintain dbt models in bigquery, including staging, intermediate, and mart layers, with tests, documentation, and clear ownership.
  + ingest and normalize heterogeneous sources (both structured and unstructured data), including cardiology wearables and device signals, ehr, claims, medication, and patient-reported data.
  + make well-reasoned decisions about storage, compute, partitioning, cost, and apis, and contribute to the target-state architecture and the reference patterns.

**data quality, lineage, and compliance**

* + contribute to data lifecycle controls into pipelines: retention, access control, lineage, provenance, reproducibility, and auditability.
  + use dagster assets and dbt lineage to keep data traceable from source to output.
  + support validated operation in a regulated setting by documenting pipelines, keeping traceability, and working with quality and security teams.
  + back every pipeline change with thorough automated tests and data quality checks.

**enable data science and ml**

* + treat data scientists as your customers, and give them the tools and processes to experiment and iterate efficiently.
  + contribute to the ml workflows that support feature generation, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  + contribute to internal applications and python libraries

**operate and monitor**

* + own ci/cd for the data platform using gitlab ci, including dbt and dagster deployments.
  + help monitoring pipeline health, performance, and bigquery cost with datadog, and take part in incident response.
  + help mentoring other engineers and setting engineering standards for the data team.

**why prolaio?**

* **impactful work:** you will join in the fight against heart failure (hf) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
* **innovative environment****:** you will be part of an organization doing something that's never been done before.
* **professional growth****:** you will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
* **collaborative team****:** you will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

**who you are?**

* 6+ years in data engineering
* expert python and sql
* experience with gcp (or aws/azure)
* production experience with dbt, including modeling, testing, macros, and incremental models.
* experience with bigquery or a comparable cloud data warehouse (databricks, redshift).
* experience with dagster or a comparable orchestrator (airflow, prefect).
* experience with docker and large-scale data processing.
* experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including time-series data.
* understanding of mlops concepts and production ml workflows.
* experience collaborating with data scientists, product, and clinical or quality stakeholders.
* experience with docker and kubernetes.

**additional qualifications (nice to haves)**

* hands-on gcp experience (iam, cloud storage, cloud run, pub/sub, networking).
* infrastructure as code with terraform
* experience with datadog
* metadata, lineage, and catalog tools, plus retrieval or vector tooling for ai use cases.
* experience with databricks
* experience working with healthcare, life sciences, medtech, or other patient data.
* experience in regulated or validated environments (samd, fda, gxp, hipaa).
* streaming tools such as pub/sub or kafka.

**why you'll love working here**

* **meaningful compensation**: competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
* **great health coverage:** medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
* **flexible spending perks:** hsa, fsa, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual lifestyle spending account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
* **time to recharge:** generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
* **family-first benefits**: paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
* **security & peace of mind**: company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
* **plan for the future**: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
* **care when you need it:** easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life's unexpected moments.

starting salary is at $150,000.00 (exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**company description**

**about abbvie**

abbvie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. we strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our allergan aesthetics portfolio. for more information about abbvie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. follow @abbvie on linkedin, facebook, instagram, x and youtube.

 **job description**

abbvie is seeking an experienced senior data scientist to join our analytics & ai organization and help advance the next generation of copay intelligence capabilities.

this role will focus on developing innovative machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that help identify complex reimbursement and affordability program dynamics, improve patient access insights, and drive more proactive decision-making across patient support programs.

the successful candidate will play a key role in building predictive intelligence products that leverage healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data to identify emerging opportunities, uncover hidden patterns, and generate actionable recommendations. these capabilities support a long-term strategy to enhance copay program intelligence, improve affordability insights, and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.

working closely with data engineering, business stakeholders, technology teams, and analytics partners, this individual will help transform large-scale healthcare data into scalable ai-powered solutions that create measurable business impact.

**what you'll be doing**

the senior data scientist will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of advanced analytics and ai solutions supporting abbvie's copay intelligence initiatives. this individual will work on highly visible strategic programs focused on predictive intelligence, healthcare affordability analytics, patient access insights, and advanced machine learning applications. the role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into practical solutions. the ideal candidate is passionate about solving challenging problems with data and enjoys working across the full lifecycle of ai and machine learning product development.

**core responsibilities**

**ai & machine learning development**

* develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.
* build predictive models that identify patterns, risks, and opportunities from healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data.
* design scoring frameworks, recommendation engines, and decision-support systems that enable proactive business actions.
* evaluate and implement modern ai methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, graph analytics, and generative ai approaches.
* continuously improve model performance through experimentation, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.

**advanced analytics**

* analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to uncover actionable business insights.
* perform feature engineering, predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, and statistical analyses.
* assess and monitor model performance using both statistical and business outcome metrics.
* translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.

**ai product development & operationalization**

* partner with data engineering and technology teams to deploy machine learning solutions into production environments.
* design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
* implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
* support development of enterprise ai products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
* ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.

**collaboration & leadership**

* partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where ai and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
* serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
* present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
* mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.
* stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in ai, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.

  
**qualifications**

**education & experience**

* bachelor's degree in statistics, computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, economics, operations research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* advanced degree (master's or phd) is preferred but not required.
* equivalent combinations of education, specialized training, and relevant professional experience will be considered.
* 6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.

**technical skills**

* strong proficiency in python and sql.
* hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, xgboost, lightgbm, tensorflow, or pytorch.
* experience building predictive, classification, forecasting, recommendation, or optimization models.
* strong knowledge of statistics, experimentation, predictive modeling, and model evaluation techniques.
* experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud-based environments.
* familiarity with mlops, model deployment, model monitoring, and production ai practices.
* experience using modern software development and version control practices.

**business & leadership skills**

* strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
* demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* strong organizational and project management skills.
* passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of ai technologies.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, payer, patient support, or market access data.
* experience developing ai-powered decision support systems.
* experience with cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or google cloud.
* experience with snowflake, databricks, spark, or other large-scale data environments.
* experience deploying generative ai or large language model solutions.
* experience operating in regulated industries where data quality, governance, and validation are critical.

description:

### **company description**

it started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **intuitive**. as a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da vinci surgical system** and **ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

we’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

the problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. the work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

if you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **job description**

**primary function of position**

as a **senior software engineer – simulation & ml platform**, you will build software platforms supporting simulation-based data generation and machine-learning development for robotic motion ai. you will work closely with simulation data scientists and ml teams responsible for simulation strategy, synthetic-data design, action-model development, sim-to-real evaluation, and machine-learning experimentation. the senior software engineer will translate those research and data-science requirements into reliable, scalable, and extendible software systems.

**responsibilities**

* build and maintain software infrastructure for robotic simulations & ml using nvidia isaac sim, isaac lab, mujoco or custom simulation environments.
* architect scalable pipelines for generating synthetic and procedurally varied robotic interaction data including development of apis, configuration systems, command-line tools, and sdks for defining and launching simulation workloads.
* build automated integration and validation pipelines for evolving simulation platforms, physics engines, and the nvidia ai ecosystem, enabling rapid adoption of new releases while maintaining compatibility, reproducibility, and stability across the robotics simulation software stack.
* develop ai-assisted engineering workflows for automated code refactoring, maintainability analysis, architectural consistency, and ci/cd optimization, enabling readable, modular, and sustainable codebases while improving engineering productivity across large-scale software projects.
* create reusable abstractions for robot configurations, tasks, sensors, scene assets, domain randomization, failure injection, data capture, episode termination, and evaluation.
* build tools that allow data scientists to define experiments without modifying low-level platform code. support headless, interactive, local, cluster, and cloud-based execution.
* develop secure, gpu-enabled containerized environments for simulation, data processing, model inference, and experimentation. develop common interfaces for robot state, coordinate frames, actions, trajectories, control commands, sensor observations, timing, and safety status.
* build tools for importing physical robot logs into analysis and simulation environments. enable software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and controlled trajectory replay where appropriate.
* collaborate with controls, embedded, systems, and robotics engineers to manage differences between simulated and physical interfaces.
* establish standards for software development, testing, documentation, code review, release management, and operational ownership.

### **qualifications**

**required qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of industry experience developing software for simulation, machine learning, robotics, computer vision, or autonomous-systems. experience with high-volume image, video, time-series, or scientific data and formats such as parquet, zarr, or hdf5.
* strong proficiency in python and at least one additional language such as c++, java, or typescript.

* experience building data-intensive applications or data-processing pipelines. experience designing and operating production-quality backend or platform systems. experience with asynchronous processing, distributed workers, message queues, or event-driven architectures.

* strong understanding of api design, data modeling, concurrency, failure handling, and distributed-system fundamentals.
* experience with docker, linux, testing, observability, and production deployment.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with nvidia isaac sim, isaac lab, mujoco, gazebo, physx, or another robotics simulation platform. familiarity with usd assets and scene composition.
* experience with coordinate transforms, robot kinematics, joint states, trajectory representations, sensor synchronization, or closed-loop control.
* experience with ros or ros 2 and gpu-enabled applications or infrastructure.
* experience with redis, rabbitmq, kafka, ray, celery, kubernetes, slurm, or cloud batch systems.
* experience building scientific, engineering, ml, or internal developer tools.
* experience with pytorch, jax, tensorflow, mlflow, or weights & biases.

description:

lantern is a specialty care navigation company connecting more than 10 million members with the highest-quality surgery, oncology, and infusion therapy providers. our curated network of excellence delivers 55%+ cost savings versus average health plan rates while maintaining a surgical complication rate below 1%. we were ranked #3 on fast company's most innovative companies 2026 in healthcare.  
  
we are transforming from a technology-enabled health services company into a health ai company, where technology and ai sit at the forefront of everything we build. engineering is a strategy maker, not an order taker. if you want your code to change how specialty care is delivered at scale, this is the team.  
  
as a software engineer on the full stack, you will own features end-to-end, from the react interfaces our members and provider partners use to the python or .net services and data models behind them. you will ship ai-first experiences on azure, backed by our data platform, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you.

**location:** hybrid - at least 3 days/wk in our dallas, tx or vancouver, bc canada offices

**what you will own**

* design, build, and operate full-stack features end-to-end across react front ends and python or .net back-end services.
* model and query relational data in postgresql or sql server, with a focus on correctness, performance, and data quality.

* embed ai into the products you build, integrating llm and ai capabilities into member and provider experiences and internal tooling.

* lead technical design and code reviews, and raise the quality bar through testing, observability, and ci/cd automation.
* break large problems into incremental deliverables, shipping a first useful increment within four weeks.
* partner directly with product, design, and clinical stakeholders as an equal owner of product decisions.
* uphold security and hipaa/phi obligations by design, building safe-by-default systems rather than treating security as a gate.

**what you bring**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications.
* strong front-end skills with react and modern javascript/typescript.
* strong back-end skills in python or .net (c#), including designing and consuming rest and event-driven apis.
* solid relational database experience with postgresql or sql server, including schema design and query optimization.
* hands-on experience deploying and operating workloads on azure.
* infrastructure-as-code experience with terraform.
* experience with ci/cd, automated testing, and containerized deployment (docker, kubernetes/aks).
* demonstrated ai curiosity and fluency: you use ai tools in your daily work and are eager to build ai-powered features.
* a track record of owning work end-to-end and delivering incrementally in a fast-moving environment.

**strong candidates will also have**

* experience building ai or llm-powered product features in production.
* experience with data platforms such as databricks, and with data pipelines feeding analytics or ml.
* experience in healthcare, or another regulated domain, handling sensitive data such as phi under hipaa.
* full comfort across both python and .net, and both postgresql and sql server.
* a habit of mentoring peers and elevating team standards without formal authority.

**benefits**:

* medical insurance
* dental insurance
* vision insurance
* short & long term disability
* life insurance
* 401k with company match
* flexible paid time off
* paid parental leave

**about you:**

* you use **logic** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. you focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
* **inclusion** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. a diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. you understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
* you have the **grit**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.

title: Data Scientist-Load & Renewable energy forecasting
description:
**key responsibilities**

**forecasting & model development**

* **develop and enhance wind, solar, and load forecasting models from research and backtesting through production implementation.**
* **build forecasting approaches using combinations of:**
* **weather and nwp forecasts**
* **historical generation and load**
* **scada and operational telemetry**
* **persistence and statistical baselines**
* **physical relationships**
* **gradient boosting and other machine-learning techniques**
* **ensemble and probabilistic forecasting methods**
* **perform feature engineering, model selection, optimization, and validation.**
* **develop backtesting and benchmarking processes to evaluate forecast performance across sites, horizons, seasons, and operating conditions.**
* **investigate forecast errors and determine whether they originate from weather, model behavior, data quality, or operational conditions.**
* **improve existing and legacy forecasting models while identifying opportunities to simplify and modernize model architecture.**

**weather provider analytics & optimization**

* **analyze multiple weather and nwp providers for accuracy, reliability, coverage, latency, available variables, forecast horizon, and operational value.**
* **compare provider performance by:**
* **location/site**
* **forecast horizon**
* **weather variable**
* **season**
* **weather regime or event type**
* **identify the relative strengths and weaknesses of individual weather providers and determine where specific providers or variables may provide superior forecasting value.**
* **assess redundancy and overlap across weather services and support recommendations for an efficient core set of providers.**
* **develop and evaluate approaches for:**
* **weather-provider blending and ensembles**
* **provider weighting and selection**
* **bias correction**
* **feature selection**
* **provider fallback and substitution**
* **ensure correct alignment of weather forecast issue times, valid times, time zones, spatial resolution, measurement units, and forecast horizons.**
* **monitor weather-data quality and identify provider anomalies or degradation that could impact production forecasts.**

**energy forecasting domain knowledge**

**apply relevant physical, meteorological, and operational knowledge across forecasting applications.**

**wind**

* **wind speed and direction**
* **hub-height adjustments**
* **vertical wind shear**
* **temperature, pressure, humidity, and air density**
* **turbine power curves**
* **cut-in, rated, and cut-out behavior**
* **wake and site effects**
* **scada and generation telemetry**
* **curtailment, derates, outages, maintenance, and equipment availability**

**solar**

* **irradiance and cloud conditions**
* **ambient and module temperature**
* **inverter performance and availability**
* **tracker position and stowing**
* **ppc/plant-controller impacts**
* **curtailment**
* **equipment outages**
* **soiling and degradation**
* **maintenance**
* **site capability versus nameplate capacity**
* **scada and plant telemetry**

**load**

* **temperature, humidity, heat index, and other weather drivers**
* **calendar and seasonal patterns**
* **lagged demand and weather relationships**
* **extreme-weather behavior**
* **regional and customer-segment differences**
* **peak-demand forecasting**

**the candidate should understand that observed generation and demand can be influenced by operational conditions in addition to weather and account for these factors when developing, training, and evaluating forecasting models.**

**required skills & experience**

* **advanced proficiency in python and common data-science libraries such as pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, lightgbm, xgboost, or equivalent tools.**
* **demonstrated experience developing and deploying forecasting, time-series, or predictive models.**
* **strong knowledge of:**
* **feature engineering**
* **regression and time-series methods**
* **gradient boosting**
* **ensemble forecasting**
* **probabilistic or quantile forecasting**
* **model validation and backtesting**
* **experience integrating and analyzing weather apis, nwp forecasts, scada/telemetry, databases, and external data feeds.**
* **ability to evaluate weather-provider performance and determine its impact on forecast accuracy.**
* **strong sql and data-analysis skills.**
* **experience transitioning models from research and development into reliable production workflows.**
* **working knowledge of aws services such as ec2, s3, lambda, ecs, step functions, cloudwatch, and sagemaker, or comparable cloud technologies.**
* **experience with git, version control, testing, and reproducible software-development practices.**
* **strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.**
* **ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with data scientists, data engineers, devops, operations, trading, and business stakeholders.**

**model performance & production support**

* **monitor forecast performance using metrics such as mae, rmse, normalized error, bias, forecast skill, and probabilistic metrics where appropriate.**
* **benchmark internal forecasts against persistence, existing models, alternative weather providers, and third-party forecasts.**
* **develop monitoring and diagnostics for:**
* **forecast degradation**
* **data-quality issues**
* **weather-provider outages or anomalies**
* **model drift**
* **operational impacts**
* **implement appropriate logging, alerts, error handling, and recovery procedures.**
* **support forecasting solutions designed to continue operating when individual data feeds or weather services become unavailable.**
* **perform root-cause analysis of significant forecast misses and recommend corrective actions.**

**production & data integration**

* **develop data connectors and pipelines supporting weather, telemetry, historical generation, load, and operational data.**
* **support scalable batch and near-real-time forecasting workflows.**
* **maintain clear model configuration, versioning, dependencies, and documentation.**
* **collaborate with data engineering and devops teams to deploy and maintain forecasting applications.**
* **build dashboards and analytical tools using streamlit, plotly, or similar technologies to communicate forecast performance, model behavior, and operational impacts.**

**preferred experience**

* **experience with utility-scale wind forecasting or renewable generation modeling.**
* **experience with multiple commercial or public weather/nwp providers.**
* **experience working directly with wind-turbine, solar-plant, or scada telemetry.**

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**src, inc.** is currently seeking an ai/ml engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative ai capabilities for defense and national security missions. this is a hands-on, early-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. you will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. the work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative ai toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in isr, ew, and advanced sensing. this is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ml on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny.

**what you'll do**

* build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels
* train, fine-tune, and benchmark models using standard open-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly
* develop and run evaluation pipelines — task-specific metrics, held-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results
* support generative ai efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open-weight and commercial language models
* assist with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (lora/qlora) and supervised fine-tuning of open-weight models for domain-specific tasks
* implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement
* maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others
* contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations
* collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with

**what you'll bring**

* bachelor’s in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0+ years of experience (internships, co-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count)
* working proficiency in python and the core scientific stack (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib)
* familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably pytorch
* exposure to the hugging face ecosystem (transformers, datasets, tokenizers) or equivalent open-source model tooling
* understanding of ml fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks
* comfort with git-based collaborative development
* clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up

**ways to stand out**

* experience fine-tuning open-weight language models using peft methods (lora, qlora) or the trl/axolotl/unsloth toolchain
* hands-on work with rag systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation
* familiarity with llm evaluation practice — llm-as-judge, rubric-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each
* experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (weights & biases, mlflow, dvc)
* exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (gymnasium, stable-baselines3, cleanrl) or to preference-based post-training methods (dpo, grpo)
* experience with agentic workflows, tool-calling, or the model context protocol (mcp)
* work with non-natural-image modalities: rf, radar, sar, audio, time series, or multimodal data
* containerization (docker) and experience running jobs on gpu clusters or cloud compute
* master's degree in a related technical discipline

**what sets us apart?**  
src, inc., a not-for-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. when you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep america and its allies safe and strong. you’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. you’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support.

total compensation for this role is market competitive. the anticipated salary range for this position based out of dayton, oh is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. src offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**src, inc.** is currently seeking an ai/ml engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative ai capabilities for defense and national security missions. this is a hands-on, early-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. you will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. the work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative ai toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in isr, ew, and advanced sensing. this is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ml on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny.

**what you'll do**

* build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels
* train, fine-tune, and benchmark models using standard open-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly
* develop and run evaluation pipelines — task-specific metrics, held-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results
* support generative ai efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open-weight and commercial language models
* assist with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (lora/qlora) and supervised fine-tuning of open-weight models for domain-specific tasks
* implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement
* maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others
* contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations
* collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with

**what you'll bring**

* bachelor’s in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0+ years of experience (internships, co-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count)
* working proficiency in python and the core scientific stack (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib)
* familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably pytorch
* exposure to the hugging face ecosystem (transformers, datasets, tokenizers) or equivalent open-source model tooling
* understanding of ml fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks
* comfort with git-based collaborative development
* clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up

**ways to stand out**

* experience fine-tuning open-weight language models using peft methods (lora, qlora) or the trl/axolotl/unsloth toolchain
* hands-on work with rag systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation
* familiarity with llm evaluation practice — llm-as-judge, rubric-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each
* experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (weights & biases, mlflow, dvc)
* exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (gymnasium, stable-baselines3, cleanrl) or to preference-based post-training methods (dpo, grpo)
* experience with agentic workflows, tool-calling, or the model context protocol (mcp)
* work with non-natural-image modalities: rf, radar, sar, audio, time series, or multimodal data
* containerization (docker) and experience running jobs on gpu clusters or cloud compute
* master's degree in a related technical discipline

**what sets us apart?**  
src, inc., a not-for-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. when you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep america and its allies safe and strong. you’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. you’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support.

total compensation for this role is market competitive. the anticipated salary range for this position based out of dayton, oh is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. src offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.
