title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**department**

globus systems operations

**about the department**

globus (www.globus.org) is a sustainable, non-profit unit within the university of chicago delivering solutions to the research community worldwide. globus develops and provides critical services that support scientific research for governmental, academic, and commercial organizations in a wide range of disciplines including life sciences, physics, and astronomy. we develop and operate commercial-quality, cloud-based software application and platform services used by 10s of thousands of researchers to manage their large–and growing–data management challenges. we have offices located at the nbc tower in the heart of downtown chicago and remote employees who work-from-home. globus, together with globus labs, a research group within the university of chicago, and part of the data science and learning division at argonne national labs, develop and deploy cutting edge technologies to solve new challenges facing the scientific community and enable break-through scientific discoveries.

**job summary**

the globus operations team is a 4-5 person group that designs, builds, and operates the cloud infrastructure behind a research-computing platform used by hundreds of institutions worldwide. globus is a hybrid solution combining aws-hosted orchestration services with installable applications, delivering identity and access management, data transfer and sharing, and task automation as both software-as-a-service (saas) and platform-as-a-service (paas). as a senior member of this small, high-autonomy team, you will ensure software development and operational best practices are effectively integrated across our services and aws infrastructure. the team owns an unusually broad estate — an aws organization of roughly thirty production accounts, a golden-image pipeline producing around thirty machine images, a self-hosted monitoring platform, a centralized security-logging pipeline, and in-house compliance and security automation — all managed as code in python, bash, terraform, cloudformation, and ansible. you will work both collaboratively and independently on complex issues and projects, in some cases making progress under minimal guidance. you will also embed with select software engineering teams to provide operational and infrastructure guidance on best practices.  
  
we are looking for a senior engineer equally comfortable improving a build pipeline and debugging a production incident, and who will be a leader and educator both within and across teams.

**responsibilities**

* architecture and design: participate in the definition and documentation of cloud infrastructure architecture — networking, monitoring, logging, security, backup, and deployment — across production and development environments. design new systems and tools, identify opportunities for technical improvement, and review and test solutions to ensure standards are met.
* software development: develop, test, document, and maintain high-quality software and infrastructure as code for deploying and operating globus cloud services, in python, bash, terraform, and cloudformation. contribute to shared internal libraries and expand automated test coverage of operational tooling.
* build and release automation: maintain and evolve the machine-image and deployment supply chain — packer-built amis produced through aws codebuild, published via ssm parameter store, kms-encrypted and shared cross-account.
* monitoring and observability: maintain the current monitoring and alerting systems (self-hosted nagios/nrpe with configuration generated from live aws inventory, cloudwatch alarms, pagerduty routing) and help in the migration to prometheus.
* security operations and compliance: contribute to globus's security plan, controls, monitoring, and reporting. extend in-house continuous-compliance automation, operate intrusion detection and endpoint protection tooling, maintain hardened machine images.
* identity, access, and trust: administer iam roles, policies, and cross-account trust across the aws organization.
* sre/operations: deploy, operate, and monitor production globus services for high availability. participate in an on-call rotation, lead incident response, and author root-cause analyses. identify recurring operational toil and eliminate it through automation and better defaults.
* support: act as a technical consultant and resource for other team members, including the engineering and user-support teams, assisting with operational issues and troubleshooting.
* designs new systems, features, and tools. solves complex problems and identifies opportunities for technical improvement and performance optimization. reviews and tests code to ensure appropriate standards are met.
* utilizes technical knowledge of existing and emerging technologies, including public cloud offerings from amazon web services, microsoft azure, and google cloud.
* performs other related work as needed.

**minimum qualifications**

**education:**

minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field.

**work experience:**

minimum requirements include knowledge and skills developed through 5-7 years of work experience in a related job discipline.

**certifications:**

**-**

**preferred qualifications**

**experience:**

  

* strong experience operating aws at scale — iam, vpc (peering, endpoints, security groups), ec2 and auto scaling groups, ecs (ec2 and fargate), s3, rds, route 53, lambda, systems manager, cloudwatch — including cross-account work in a multi-account aws organization.
* strong experience building infrastructure as code with terraform (modules, remote state, provider upgrades, reconciling drift against live environments), the ability to maintain and incrementally retire legacy cloudformation is a plus.
* experience automating infrastructure in python — maintainable, reusable libraries rather than only scripts, using boto3 — and in bash.

* building amazon machine images and the instances they run on, plus docker containers, and ci/cd tooling (aws codebuild, github actions).
* linux administration and troubleshooting across ubuntu and rpm-based distributions, including systemd, syslog/rsyslog, storage, and ssh/sudo configuration.
* networking, firewalls, routing, and dns; web servers and tls.

title: Distinguished Engineer - Systems Architecture
description:
### **when you join verizon**

you want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.

**what you’ll be doing …**

as a distinguished engineer in network & technology it, you will serve as the domain expert in network service assurance. your primary objective is driving autonomous, intent-driven network operations for global management teams. key responsibilities include building ai-driven agentic workflows, integrating wireless and wireline surveillance, correlation, and ticketing systems, and incorporating 3rd party tools. you will lead end-to-end program delivery across network engineering and provisioning using legacy and modern solutions, providing thought leadership in ideation and requirements sessions.

you will lead design and development for alarm/event processing, correlation, and automation. your role encompasses devsecops leadership and technology modernization—specifically refactoring legacy workflow, correlation, and automation systems to modern, cloud-native standard operating environment (soe) standards.

in collaboration with centralized and enterprise architecture teams, you will align on solutions, domain boundaries, and high-level architectural principles. you will partner with development teams in planning, engineering, inventory, and workflow/orchestration to align hlds and api definitions, ensuring timely delivery with cross-functional partners. key responsibilities include:

* **end-to-end core architecture:** architecting end-to-end functionality across core modules (**ufm, uwa, sa360/utp**) for key wireline and wireless initiatives (**ano360, frontier integration, ien, sesame**).
* **workflow modernization:** leading the modernization of legacy alarm processing, ticketing, and jbpm workflows into scalable, **event-driven microservices architectures**.
* **api & resiliency standards:** defining blueprint patterns and standards to refactor legacy automations into **api-driven workflows** with high resiliency, observability, and self-healing.
* **development execution & code quality:** leading development teams to ensure solid code implementation, data integrity, traceability, performance, and resiliency in workflow execution.
* **executive leadership & facilitation:** partnering with **director and vp-level leadership** to drive decision-making velocity, facilitate working sessions, and align cross-functional technical teams.
* **organizational change management:** acting as an effective change agent using stakeholder analysis and structured change management techniques.
* **directional architecture & governance:** creating architectural enablers and conducting design reviews to align systems with the **directional architecture**, **standard operating environment (soe)**, and domain boundaries.
* **talent mentorship:** mentoring upcoming architects and development leads in the **service assurance** space.
* **cross-functional technical guidance:** providing technical guidance to cross-functional teams in crafting solutions and detailing system and process impacts.
* **mission-critical domain support:** supporting mission- and business-critical applications in **network systems** across provisioning and service qualification domains.
* **continuous delivery & vendor alignment:** aligning teams to a shared technical direction and partnering with vendors and internal teams to validate assumptions, evaluate options, and build the **continuous delivery pipeline**.
* **agile planning & solution definition:** participating in **development cycle (dc) planning**, system/solution demos, inspect & adapt events, and exploring high-level solution trade-offs.
* **program execution & process optimization:** creating, leading, and executing programs focused on process optimization and technology adoption to maximize business value.
* **full-lifecycle solution architecture:** delivering end-to-end solution architecture from definition through go-live across **logical, technical, and physical views** for new and existing problem spaces.
* **frameworks & schema standardization:** defining reusable components, common schemas, standards, and tools to bootstrap the **service qualification** team.
* **advanced engineering & ai innovation:** driving adoption of best software engineering practices and modern technologies (**ai, llm, arg**) to impact the broader product architecture ecosystem.

**what we are looking for …**

we are seeking an inquisitive, strategic, and data-driven leader with exceptional influencing skills across multi-level organizations and deep expertise in software engineering and architecture concepts.

**you'll need to have:**

* bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
* eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* experience in architecting scalable network fault management solutions for alarm processing, correlation, ticketing, and automated workflows across legacy and cutting-edge systems.
* proven success modernizing legacy core network automations and high-volume workflow engines into event-driven architectures without disrupting operations.
* experience in core network domain architecture and software engineering, specializing in high-volume process flow modeling and end-to-end product design for complex business environments.

**even better if you have:**

* master’s degree in computer science or related field.
* experience in conducting technical workshops on defining inter system communications.
* leading a team.
* skill in translating business requirements in the core network domain into technical design documents.
* experience designing and building complex, enterprise-grade java-based architectural solutions.
* experience in providing solutions / architecture for modernization / migration projects.
* experience developing and optimizing server architectures.
* experience with java/ j2ee technologies, springboot microservices.
* experience in sql/nosql databases like oracle, postgresql.
* knowledge on cloud technologies - aws cloud or docker containers - kubernetes (k8s).
* experience in conversing/presenting to the executives with it and non-it backgrounds.
* experience in using ai tools including claude code, copilot, etc.
* experience with enterprise orchestration, bpm engines, and multi-system task management.
* experience in legacy-to-modern migrations using strangler fig pattern, domain-driven design, and workflow engines (e.g., camunda, temporal).
* worked in a large cross-functional team structure.
* experience working in the telecom industry.
* working with vendors and vendor management.

if verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **where you’ll be working**

in this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

### **scheduled weekly hours**

40

verizon is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of verizon. from health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, ad&d insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. we also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. for part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
the ai solutions engineer is a key role within the ai team that partners with business teams to turn real operational challenges into practical ai-enabled solutions. this person combines strong business curiosity, consultative problem-solving, and hands-on ai capability in designing, building, testing, and improving sophisticated ai agents and workflows.

they will help teams identify where ai can create meaningful value, translate needs into clear solution designs, and build usable prototypes and production-ready solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical partners.

**key responsibilities**

**partner with the business**

* partner with business units to understand their goals, processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* participate in discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined ai solution requirements.
* collaborate with the broader ai team to shape solution designs, provide practical feedback on feasibility and user needs, and help prioritize the ai opportunity pipeline based on business value, complexity, risk, and strategic alignment.
* work with data, technology, security, legal, and risk partners to ensure solutions are reliable, responsible, and appropriate for the business context.

**build and integrate**

* design, build, and iterate ai agents, copilots, automations, and workflow integrations using modern ai platforms and tools.
* develop agent instructions, tools, knowledge sources, guardrails, and human-review workflows.
* create prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, then help evolve successful concepts into durable solutions.

**test and improve**

* define success metrics and evaluation approaches before build, so each solution has a clear bar for what good looks like.
* test ai solutions for accuracy, usefulness, safety, consistency, and user experience; continuously improve them based on feedback and performance data.
* monitor solutions in production for adoption and accuracy drift; retire or rework anything that no longer meets its success bar.

**enable and share**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**join atlas air worldwide. move the world with us!**

at atlas air worldwide, we're not just an airline, we're a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. as a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we're built on a foundation of **safety**, **service excellence**, **integrity**, **innovation**, **teamwork**, and **responsibility**. with over 30 years of history, a modern all-boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we're driven by purpose.

**if you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.**

**position summary:** atlas air is seeking a data engineer to join our data platform and engineering team. this is an early-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work.

as we continue to build our data environment on databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. you will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production-quality code that supports analytics, data science, ai/ml, and operational decision-making.

**major accountabilities:**

**data pipeline development**

* build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks.
* develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets.
* implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs.
* use databricks, spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members.
* participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance.

**data quality & operations**

* create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop.
* investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately.
* produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes.
* participate in the team's on-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support.
* follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements.

**collaboration & growth**

* work with data analytics, data science, software engineering, it, security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines.
* contribute to team standards for source control, testing, ci/cd, documentation, and operational readiness.
* learn the atlas air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products.
* seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less-defined problems.

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.
* minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., python, typescript, rust, java, c++, etc.).
* experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting.
* familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including etl/elt, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration.
* experience with git-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows.
* ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

**desired qualifications:**

* hands-on exposure to databricks, apache spark, or another distributed data-processing platform.
* experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as airflow, prefect, or dagster.
* familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: aws, azure, or gcp.
* exposure to streaming or event-driven technologies such as kafka, kinesis, spark structured streaming, or flink.
* familiarity with bi, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them.
* experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

at **atlas air worldwide**, we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.

title: AI Engineer
description:
at worthington enterprises, we are not just experimenting with ai—we are embedding it into how we operate, make decisions, and create value for our customers.

we are looking for a hands-on, forward-thinking ai engineer to transform governed enterprise data into impactful business solutions. you will build and deploy ai-powered applications, agents, predictive models, and intelligent workflows that help people work more efficiently, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. this is an opportunity to shape reusable enterprise ai patterns, tackle meaningful manufacturing and business challenges, and see your solutions progress from idea to measurable impact.

**this hybrid role is based in columbus, ohio, and requires at 2 to 3 days per week on-site**. occasional travel—approximately 10%—to corporate and manufacturing locations may be required. **this position is not eligible for relocation assistance or u.s. work sponsorship.**

**what you'll do**

* design, build, deploy, and improve ai applications including enterprise agents, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), natural-language analytics, predictive models, and workflow automations.
* build snowflake-native ai and ml solutions using capabilities such as cortex agents, cortex search, semantic views and structured-data tools, cortex ai functions, snowpark, model registry, and feature store where appropriate.
* engineer retrieval and context pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including ingestion, chunking, metadata, hybrid search, citations, permissions, and freshness.
* create reliable agentic workflows in n8n or comparable orchestration platforms, incorporating tool calling, human approval, retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and exception handling.
* develop secure integrations with microsoft 365, sharepoint, teams, enterprise apis, databases, file sources, and model context protocol (mcp) tools.
* establish evaluation and monitoring practices for answer quality, task completion, drift, safety, latency, cost, adoption, and business value.
* apply software engineering practices including modular design, automated testing, code review, git-based delivery, ci/cd, documentation, and production support.
* partner with business teams to frame opportunities, prototype quickly, translate ambiguity into a delivery plan, and guide adoption of solutions that are useful and trusted.
* contribute reusable patterns, standards, and guardrails that help other teams and ai champions build responsibly.
* continuously evaluate new models and capabilities, separating durable value from short-lived hype.

**what we're looking for**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in ai/ml engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or data science, including evidence of delivering at least one ai-enabled solution beyond a one-off prototype.
* strong python and sql skills, plus experience with apis, source control, testing, and maintainable application or pipeline development.
* hands-on experience with one or more of the following: llm applications, rag, tool-using agents, natural-language analytics, ml pipelines, or intelligent automation.
* understanding of data modeling, identity and access control, privacy, secure development, and responsible ai principles.
* ability to evaluate ai system quality systematically and diagnose failure modes rather than relying on anecdotal testing.
* strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to both technical and business partners.

**preferred qualifications**

* snowflake ai/ml experience, especially cortex agents, cortex search, semantic views, snowpark, model registry, feature store, or related capabilities.
* n8n or comparable workflow/agent orchestration experience such as workato, langgraph, semantic kernel, or similar tools.
* mcp, function/tool calling, structured outputs, event-driven integrations, containers, serverless services, or cloud application delivery.
* llmops/mlops practices, evaluation frameworks, observability, model/prompt versioning, docker, ci/cd, or mlflow.
* enterprise knowledge and productivity integrations involving microsoft 365, sharepoint, teams, or governed data catalogs such as alation.
* experience applying ai in manufacturing, supply chain, finance, operations, or another industrial domain.

**team and collaboration context**

you will join the corporate it – data, analytics & ai team and partner with data engineering, analytics, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business functions. we value curiosity, sound judgment, disciplined experimentation, and people who enjoy turning difficult business problems into simple, reliable experiences.

**why worthington?**

worthington is applying modern ai inside a real operating business, where better data, smarter automation, and trusted decision support can improve how work gets done every day. this role offers the opportunity to build enterprise ai products that move beyond demos and become part of the way employees ask questions, automate tasks, and make decisions.

**benefits**

* health, dental, and vision insurance starting on the first day, including employer hsa contribution.
* on-site medical center, pharmacy, barbershop, and fitness center.
* 401(k) match plus employer contribution.
* employee assistance program.
* flexible work schedule.
* quarterly profit sharing, with no cap.

our company is proud to have a dynamic and inclusive workforce where employees are empowered to innovate, thrive and grow. we believe that each employee’s unique strengths contribute to the success of our organization. this belief extends to how we consider our job applicants. your talents may align with this position or other opportunities within our organization. apply today to start unlocking your career potential with worthington enterprises.

we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in the application and hiring process. if you are interested in employment with worthington enterprises and need an accommodation or assistance using the careers website, please contact careers@wthg.com.

worthington enterprises (nyse: wor) is a designer and manufacturer of market-leading brands that help improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences. the company operates with two primary business units: building products and consumer products.

the building products segment includes cooking, heating, cooling and water solutions, architectural and acoustical grid ceilings and metal framing and accessories. the consumer products segment provides solutions for the tools, outdoor living and celebrations categories. product brands within the worthington enterprises portfolio include balloon time®, bernzomatic®, coleman® (propane cylinders), comet®, elgen, garden weasel®, general®, halo™, hawkeye™, level5 tools®, mag torch®, nexi™, pactool international®, powercore™, ragasco®, well-x-trol® and xlite™, among others.

founded in 1955 as worthington industries, worthington enterprises follows a people-first philosophy with earning money for its shareholders as its first corporate goal. headquartered in columbus, ohio, worthington enterprises and its joint ventures employ approximately 6,000 people throughout north america and europe.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**who we are**

digicert is a global leader in intelligent trust. we protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. our ai-powered digicert one platform unifies pki, dns, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, ai content and agents. learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the fortune 500, choose digicert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**job summary**

**this position is for the ssl store, powered by digicert**

we are hiring a senior software engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, tls and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. the platform is a typescript monorepo: fastify and express services, next.js and react frontends, mysql and redis, queues and workers on aws, deployed to kubernetes through terraform, helm, and azure devops pipelines. it also carries a legacy .net estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of ai-assisted features and internal tooling.

you will own features end to end, from schema and api through ui, pipeline, and production. we work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

  

**what you will do**

* design, build, and ship features across the full stack: fastify or express apis, next.js and react frontends, mysql schemas and migrations, sqs-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
* own services in production: observability with sentry and grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
* build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
* maintain and incrementally retire legacy .net and python components, moving behavior into the typescript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
* extend ci/cd and infrastructure: azure devops pipelines, docker images, helm charts, and terraform for eks, rds, sqs, and related aws services.
* integrate third-party and partner apis (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* use ai-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build ai-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.

* developed and implemented project plans that met or exceeded expectations.

* master’s degree in machine learning or big data analytics preferred**.**

open competitive - emergency

hh1762b-ea

  

the la county board of supervisors recently declared a local state of emergency for homelessness, and the county is working to revise and expand our response to help all who are affected. we are looking for qualified and passionate individuals to help us in the mission of addressing issues like housing, mental health, and substance use. if you are looking for a new career that will directly benefit the population of la county, this may be the opportunity for you.

  

the department of homeless services and housing (hsh) is seeking qualified candidates to fill emergency health program analyst iii vacancies related to the homelessness crisis.

during your initial work period, you will be assessed on your work performance. this assessment will be weighted 100%.

  

those who successfully pass the assessment will be considered for permanent appointment to predictive data analyst.

**essential job functions**
---------------------------

* assists department stakeholders to define data needs and requirements to ensure data science projects meet business needs at the community, regional, divisional, departmental, or county-wide level.
* collaborates with other department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal and external data sources.
* collaborates with data administrators and other it staff to develop data pipelines and ensure the availability of quality data.
* uses statistical programming languages and packages, computer scripting languages, and/or domain-specific languages to digest, manipulate, prepare, augment, evaluate, analyze, summarize, and visualize data.
* conducts end-to-end predictive data modeling projects that include basic exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, deployment of models into production environments, and visualization of findings.
* uses advanced data visualization techniques to create data dashboards and reports to be used by varying levels of the enterprise and business managers.
* uses supervised machine learning techniques on less complex business problems, with an understanding of algorithms, feature selection, variable importance, hyper parameter tuning, and optimization.
* performs data management and manipulation, including the writing of data queries of departmental databases and data marts, data cleaning, and joining of multiple and disparate data sets.
* extracts and organizes data and applies quality-control techniques to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all data; researches source documents and coordinates with others to resolve missing or conflicting data and other anomalies.
* assists in planning, designing, and managing experiments, consumer surveys, and other data collection projects to augment existing sources of data as necessary to solve business problems.
* works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making.
* assists in coordinating with various functional teams to develop and implement products, services, tools, or business process changes resulting from the analysis.
* accesses ongoing training and professional development to maintain familiarity with current industry and academic research to apply the latest and most useful statistical learning techniques to help extract patterns and trends from data.

**requirements**
----------------

**requirements to qualify**

**option i:** a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis -and- two (2) years of experience in the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs leading to actionable findings and recommendations -or- a master’s or doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health.

  
  

**option ii:** four (4) years of experience with responsibility for planning, designing, conducting, and evaluating research projects involving the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and/or hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs leading to actionable findings and recommendations.

at amd, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. from advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering ai and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at amd is shaping the future.

whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling ai breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at amd contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

responsibilities:

**the role:**

amd's software and solutions team is seeking a **solution engineering technical leader** to accelerate the integration and adoption of amd technology across the open software ecosystem. this role will define and deliver production-oriented solutions that connect amd cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, memory, and software platforms with the operating systems, databases, runtimes, apis, developer frameworks, and cloud-native services customers use to build and operate modern infrastructure.

the role will bridge amd architecture and the broader open ecosystem by creating reference architectures, upstream integrations, reusable software components, validated deployment patterns, and early customer proof-of-concepts. primary focus areas include linux and other operating-system kernels, runtime and system services, database and data-platform enablement, api layers, model context protocol (mcp) integrations, container and orchestration environments, observability, security, and performance engineering.

working across amd + amd (a+a) and amd + nvidia (a+n) environments and leveraging **rocm™, amd zen software studio, amd enterprise ai,** open-source projects, industry standards, and upstream communities, this leader will make amd platforms easier to adopt, integrate, operate, and optimize. ai is one supported workload domain—particularly inference, retrieval, developer tooling, and data-intensive services—but the role is fundamentally centered on open systems integration and solution engineering.

as a recognized technical authority, this individual will collaborate with silicon architecture, product engineering, software organizations, customers, hyperscalers, isvs, standards bodies, and open-source communities. the role will influence amd hardware and software roadmaps through implementation evidence, workload analysis, ecosystem gaps, customer requirements, and measurable improvements in compatibility, performance, scalability, security, manageability, and developer experience.

this is a highly technical, hands-on individual contributor role focused on architecture, integration, implementation, performance engineering, and ecosystem leadership. it is not a people management, program management, or alliance management position.

**the person:**

a deeply technical solution engineer and systems architect with broad expertise across operating systems, kernel and driver interfaces, runtime services, databases, distributed systems, apis, cloud-native infrastructure, heterogeneous computing, networking, storage, virtualization, security, and performance engineering. this individual has a record of turning platform capabilities into integrated, supportable solutions that customers and open-source communities can deploy at scale.

the ideal candidate understands how applications move through api, middleware, runtime, kernel, driver, firmware, and hardware layers, and how data moves across transactional databases, analytical platforms, caches, object stores, and retrieval systems. they can diagnose integration barriers, contribute production-quality code, shape stable interfaces, and optimize end-to-end behavior across amd and third-party components. familiarity with practical ai infrastructure, model serving, vector search, and mcp-enabled tools is valuable where these technologies intersect with broader platform solutions.

this individual thrives in customer-facing and community-facing environments where long-term technical direction must be grounded in working code, benchmarks, upstream collaboration, and repeatable deployment outcomes. they lead through technical excellence and influence while partnering across engineering organizations and engaging directly with strategic customers, cloud providers, oems, isvs, database vendors, operating-system communities, and standards organizations.

**key responsibilities:**

* define and execute amd's solution engineering strategy for integrating amd hardware and software into open-source, commercial, enterprise, cloud, and edge ecosystems, creating end-to-end reference architectures, reusable components, integration guides, validated configurations, and customer proof-of-concepts spanning amd cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, memory, storage, and accelerators.
* drive enablement and upstream collaboration across linux kernels, device drivers, firmware interfaces, system libraries, package ecosystems, container runtimes, kubernetes, schedulers, service meshes, and observability platforms, and optimize runtime services—including language runtimes, compilers, libraries, inference and data-processing frameworks, communication stacks, and background system services—for amd architectures.
* integrate and optimize relational, nosql, analytical, vector, graph, and distributed database platforms on amd systems, addressing query execution, concurrency, memory hierarchy, storage i/o, networking, resiliency, and scale-out performance.
* design stable, secure, high-performance apis and sdk integration patterns that expose amd platform capabilities while simplifying application portability and developer adoption, and develop mcp servers, connectors, and reference patterns where mcp provides a practical interface between developer tools, enterprise data, platform services, and selected ai-assisted workflows.
* support both **amd + amd (a+a) and amd + nvidia (a+n)** deployment models, improving interoperability, workload portability, operational consistency, and customer choice.
* apply rigorous profiling, benchmarking, tracing, and systems analysis to improve latency, throughput, scalability, availability, energy efficiency, total cost of ownership, and quality of service.
* build security into solution architectures through confidential computing, trusted execution, attestation, identity, secure boot, software supply-chain controls, cryptography, data protection, governance, and auditability.
* enable practical ai workloads where relevant, including model serving, retrieval, vector search, data pipelines, and developer productivity, without making ai the sole focus of the platform solution.
* partner directly with strategic customers, hyperscalers, oems, isvs, database and platform vendors, and open-source maintainers to resolve integration barriers and validate production readiness, translating implementation findings and ecosystem requirements into actionable feedback for amd silicon, firmware, compiler, operating-system, runtime, library, and product roadmaps.
* represent amd through technical publications, conferences, standards bodies, upstream contributions, architecture reviews, and executive customer engagements, and mentor senior engineers and architects in systems integration, open-source engagement, performance engineering, and production solution design.

**preferred experience:**

* extensive experience delivering systems software, platform integration, solution architecture, or customer engineering for large-scale enterprise, cloud, data-center, or edge environments, with deep expertise in heterogeneous computing across cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, storage, memory subsystems, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure.
* strong knowledge of linux kernel architecture, drivers, system calls, memory management, i/o, networking stacks, security mechanisms, performance tooling, and upstream development practices, plus hands-on experience with runtime services, compilers, language runtimes, system libraries, containers, kubernetes, distributed schedulers, observability, ci/cd, and software supply chains.
* strong database and data-platform expertise spanning relational, nosql, analytical, vector, graph, caching, messaging, and distributed storage technologies, including performance and scale-out optimization.
* experience designing and integrating rest, grpc, event-driven, and systems-level apis, with attention to compatibility, security, observability, versioning, and developer experience, along with working knowledge of model context protocol (mcp), including server, client, tool, resource, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns.
* strong programming skills in c, c++, python, go, rust, or comparable systems languages, with comfort in performance-critical paths, profiling, debugging, and production-quality open-source development.
* experience with **rocm™, amd zen software studio, amd enterprise ai**, or comparable accelerator, compiler, runtime, and developer-tool ecosystems is desirable; practical familiarity with ai infrastructure, model serving, retrieval-augmented applications, vector databases, and inference performance is beneficial, but broad systems integration depth is more important than specialization in ai.
* demonstrated technical leadership with customers, hyperscalers, oems, isvs, standards groups, and open-source communities, supported by shipped solutions, upstream contributions, patents, publications, or conference presentations.

**academic credentials:**

* master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent advanced industry experience may be considered.

**alternate location:**

* santa clara ca

description:
$175,000 - $210,000 + bonus

our fast-paced and collaborative environment inspires us to create, think, and challenge each other in ways that make our solutions and our teams better. whether you’re interested in engineering or development, marketing or sales, or something else – if this sounds like you, then we’d love to hear from you!

**$175,000 + $210,000 + bonus**

the insurance industry runs on vertafore. we equip agencies, mgas, and carriers with the core digital systems, specialized ai, and data-driven foundation to eliminate distribution drag across the insurance lifecycle, spanning sales, servicing, and back-office operations.

underpinned by unmatched speed and performance power, we are the trusted backbone that’s taking the insurance industry from friction to flow with distribution velocity – speed, performance, and trust - to drive growth at scale.

with over 95% of the top agencies and insurers and 50% of industry compliance transactions running through vertafore, we lead at the intersection of innovation and trust, giving insurance professionals the confidence to transform and win in the ai era.

our reach is global, with headquarters in denver, colorado, and offices across the u.s., canada, and india.

**about the role**

as a **senior ai engineer**, you will design, build, and operate the ai systems behind vertafore’s next generation of products for agencies, mgas, and carriers. you will build production-grade agents that can reason through complex, multi-step insurance workflows, and you will be responsible for making those systems reliable, measurable, and safe in a highly regulated industry.

you will work in small pods with complete agency to build end to end products. this role is hands-on. you’ll be expected to directly contribute to the successful implementation and launch of critical features and empowered to make the decisions needed to get there. vertafore designs these pods as end to end development teams so fluidity going up and down the stack is expected.

we are looking for an engineer who is strong in software and systems engineering, understands machine learning well, and has a habit of shipping. you use the latest agentic coding tools to work faster, and you hold yourself fully accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of what you ship.

**core requirements and responsibilities:**

**essential job functions included but are not limited to the following:**

* design, build, and deploy complex reasoning agents and multi-agent systems for production workloads using langgraph and related python orchestration frameworks

* architect agent workflows, including state management, tool use, memory, planning, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, error recovery, and fallback behavior

* design and build clean, well-documented, versioned apis that expose ai capabilities to vertafore products and to external partners

* define and own evaluation strategy for ai systems. this includes building eval datasets, writing graders (programmatic, model-based, and human review), running offline and online evaluations, and turning results into concrete improvements

* set up regression testing for prompts, models, and agent behavior so that changes ship with measurable confidence

* instrument ai systems for observability, including tracing, latency, cost, token usage, failure modes, and quality metrics in production

* build retrieval and context pipelines (rag, document processing, structured extraction) over insurance data such as policies, submissions, and compliance documents

* troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the ai stack, from model behavior to infrastructure

**knowledge, skills and abilities:**

* expert-level python, including writing idiomatic, typed, tested, production-quality code and using async programming

* solid understanding of ml fundamentals, including model training and generalization, overfitting, bias and variance, embeddings, classification and ranking metrics, and statistical significance

* deep understanding of how large language models behave in practice, including failure modes, non-determinism, context limits, and strategies for reliable outputs

* rigorous, experimental mindset; you form hypotheses, measure, and let data drive decisions rather than intuition about model output

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building backend services and systems in python

* 2+ years building and shipping llm-powered applications or agentic systems to production

* hands-on production experience with langgraph (or comparable agent orchestration frameworks such as langchain, llamaindex, or custom orchestration)

* 5+ years designing and building restful apis (experience with fastapi or similar frameworks preferred)

* demonstrated experience designing and running evaluations for ml or llm systems, and using results to drive measurable quality improvements

* experience with cloud platforms (aws preferred), docker, and ci/cd pipelines

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience with llm observability and evaluation tooling (such as langsmith, langfuse, braintrust, or similar)

* experience with fine-tuning, embedding model selection, or classical ml pipelines

* experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry

* experience with model context protocol (mcp) or building tool integrations for agents

* open-source contributions or public writing on ai engineering

title: Solution Architect, AI & Cloud
description:
**about us**
============

advantage investigations is a national claims investigation company. we build and run the software behind the investigation lifecycle: claim intake, case management, secure video, and ai-assisted analysis. the platforms run on aws.

**the role**
============

this is an individual-contributor role with a clear path to broader player-coach leadership. you will keep writing production code while you set direction, improve engineering practices, and coach the engineers you work with.

in the first six months you take hands-on ownership of our newest ai platform: a python and fastapi service on amazon bedrock, with a react and typescript front end and aws serverless infrastructure. it turns claim referrals, including pdfs, scanned images, and email, into structured cases and recommended investigative services.

as you establish context, your scope expands to architectural ownership and technical leadership across the other two production systems. case management is .net 8 and asp.net core, sql server, and vue 3, covering investigators, scheduling, documents, billing, and client communication. video is a .net api, an angular front end, and a python gpu service, on aws media services, for upload, processing, playback, archive, and ai-assisted search.

you work with our development partners and report to the cto. the work is remote. candidates in north carolina, or able to be in charlotte occasionally, are preferred.

**what you will do**
====================

**own the ai platform**
-----------------------

* own the api, infrastructure, and user interface across development, qa, and production.
* build and operate python and fastapi services that use amazon bedrock, including multimodal models, for document extraction and service recommendations.
* maintain the aws infrastructure, built with sam and cloudformation: api gateway, lambda, aurora postgresql serverless, s3, sqs, dynamodb, and ecs.
* guide the react and typescript front end, including single sign-on with the case-management platform.
* make early ai behavior reliable, measurable, and cost-aware. a person reviews every ai output before it is used.

**architecture across case management and video**
-------------------------------------------------

* architect the .net 8 case-management back end and vue 3 front end, including sql server, authentication, and bedrock-enabled features.
* modernize a large, business-critical platform in increments, without disrupting daily operations.
* guide the video api, angular front end, and python gpu search service.
* shape media workflows on s3, dynamodb, cloudfront, mediaconvert, step functions, lambda, and websockets, including storage lifecycle and cost.

**engineering direction**
-------------------------

* set reference patterns, coding standards, security baselines, observability, and ci/cd practice across azure devops and github.
* lead architecture reviews and write the design notes and decision records the work needs.

* coach engineers, support hiring and onboarding, and raise delivery judgment on the team.

**what success looks like**
===========================

* first 90 days: own the ai platform, ship features and fixes independently, make deployments predictable and documented, and address open security-review items.
* first 6 months: that platform is stable in production, engineering standards are in writing, and you are in regular architecture reviews on the case-management and video systems.
* first 12 months: you are the technical lead across all three, with a cross-platform roadmap and measurable gains in reliability and delivery.

**required**
============

* 12 or more years of professional software engineering, including technical ownership of production systems, not design-only work.
* a player-coach record: substantial production delivery, plus technical leadership and mentoring.
* strong production experience with c# / .net and asp.net core, and with python and fastapi or a comparable framework.
* strong typescript experience and at least one of react, vue, or angular, with the ability to review work in the others.
* deep aws experience, including ecs, lambda, api gateway, s3, dynamodb, rds or aurora, cloudfront, sqs, step functions, iam, and vpc networking.
* infrastructure as code, containerized deployment, and performance tuning in sql server and postgresql.
* oidc and oauth2, jwt, cross-application single sign-on, least-privilege iam, and secure file handling.
* proven modernization of a legacy system without stopping the business.

* video or media pipelines, hls, mediaconvert, cloudfront signed access, and s3 lifecycle or archival strategies.

title: Senior Solution Engineer (Expansion)
description:
at snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. to usher in this new era, we seek ai-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. you don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating ai as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. we look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. at snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. with a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. for every enterprise ready to harness the power of the ai data cloud, there lies a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. we believe generative ai is the key — we are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.

we are seeking a manager, frontier engineering (migrations) to sit at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. this is a unique hybrid role: you will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migration projects while simultaneously driving the development of ai-powered migration tools and products. your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation — turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

**as a manager, migrations you will:**

**team leadership & people management**

* manage and mentor a team of forward deployed engineers, providing clear feedback, identifying strengths, and developing growth paths
* recruit, hire, and onboard future team members, setting them up for success in both customer-facing delivery and engineering contributions
* foster a culture of creativity, innovation, and practical decision-making across delivery and engineering workstreams
* support engineers in their career development, growing both technical delivery leads and engineering leaders

**customer delivery & project execution**

* provide strategic oversight for migration projects, ensuring alignment with customer objectives and company goals
* lead teams executing complex migrations from legacy systems (oracle, teradata, netezza, sql server, etc.) to the snowflake platform
* act as the primary escalation point for delivery concerns, working closely with customers and system integrators
* maintain a hands-on presence on strategic projects, leveraging your technical expertise to assess quality and unblock teams
* collaborate with sales teams to scope opportunities, develop proposals, and ensure effective account strategy execution

**engineering & product build**

* drive the design, development, and iteration of ai-powered migration tools and products based on real-world customer needs
* guide the team through an evolving ai ecosystem to build ai-first products — including code translation, developer co-pilots, and semantic validation
* translate field insights and customer requirements into engineering roadmap items and product improvements
* collaborate with engineering and product management organizations to align on priorities and deliver high-quality solutions
* encourage the development and sharing of best practices, utilities, and accelerators that streamline migrations and feed back into product

**cross-functional impact**

* work with organizational leaders to influence gtm strategies, leading initiatives and improvements across sales and engineering
* facilitate knowledge sharing and cross-team learning between field engineers and product engineering teams
* present to both technical and executive audiences, articulating migration strategies, product vision, and business outcomes

**our ideal candidate will have:**

* university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields (or equivalent experience)
* 7+ years of experience in technical roles involving customer-facing delivery, engineering
* 5+ years of people management experience — mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams
* 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, particularly involving ai/ml or developer tools
* demonstrated success leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformation projects
* strong foundation in databases, data warehouses, and data processing — hands-on experience with large-scale systems (oracle, teradata, netezza, sql server, greenplum, hadoop)
* deep understanding of cloud platforms (aws, azure, gcp) and the complete data analytics stack (etl, data platform design, bi/analytics tools)
* familiarity with data integration/transformation tools (informatica, datastage, talend, matillion, dbt) and bi tools (tableau, microstrategy, business objects)
* extensive hands-on expertise with sql, sql analytics, and scripting (python, perl, bash)
* resourceful, data-driven, strong partners, and able to step in as pm, program manager, or architect when needed
* hiring and growing the team, technical leadership (including for staff+ engineers), driving projects from idea to production, and partnering across teams and with customers
* strong experience scoping engagements — developing delivery estimates, proposals, and project plans
* outstanding presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences

title: Copy of Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. we use the best cloud-native and ai-enabled tools, and apply a battle-tested combination of agile, lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges - and do it right the first time. we often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies ai to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more.

**the role**
============

as a senior full stack developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. you will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using python and aws serverless technologies (lambda, dynamodb, sqs, eventbridge), developing event-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability.

a critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern ai/ml development tools (e.g., github copilot, claude code, agentic coding tools, large language models). we are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession.

**key responsibilities**
========================

* **design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost-efficient backend services using python and aws (lambda, api gateway, rds, dynamodb, sqs, eventbridge).
* **architect and build** event-sourced systems and event-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services.
* **collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code.
* **implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., terraform or cloudformation).
* **perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team.
* **actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance.
* **clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate ai tools into the software development lifecycle.

**qualifications**
==================

**required**
------------

* **5+ years** of professional experience in full-stack software development.
* **expert-level proficiency** in python for backend development (including django).
* **strong** working proficiency with vue.js (and typescript).
* **deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably aws lambda, api gateway, and managed services).
* **proficiency** with sql, preferably postgresql.
* **solid understanding** of event sourcing and event-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., sqs, sns, eventbridge, or kinesis).
* **experience** with ci/cd pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
* **demonstrated fluency in ai-assisted development**: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands-on experience using ai-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, ip concerns).

**nice to have**
----------------

* **experience** with advanced aws services (e.g., step functions, kinesis, sagemaker).
* **experience** working in a regulated or compliance-focused environment.
* **a bachelor's or master's degree** in computer science or a related technical field.

**ai and the evolution of software engineering & ops**
======================================================

all candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process:

* **practical ai tool usage:** specific examples of ai tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. if you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share!
* **understanding of ai limitations:** a clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern ai tools in the engineering context.
* **strategic ai opportunity:** a viewpoint on how ai tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem-solving or architectural design.
* **evolution of the engineering role:** a well-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of ai and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in ai tools and technologies.

**application process**
=======================

to apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. your cover letter should be informed by the "ai and forward-looking requirements" section above.

the hiring process includes:

* **initial** **screening email**
* **technical** **assessment interview**
* **a panel interview**

**salary range $140,000 - $175,000**
====================================

**benefits for full-time employees**

excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance  
excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%
