title: Platform Engineer
description:
platform engineer

remote [within the us]

**about the role:**

we are seeking a platform engineer to take ownership of deploying, managing, and evolving our multi-prem platform architecture across diverse customer environments, from bare-metal data centers to commercial and il5, il6, and il6+ environments. you'll play a critical role in bridging our continuously deployed saas platform with shrink-wrapped customer-hosted releases, ensuring alignment, consistency, and operational excellence across all footprints. this is a deeply technical role that sits at the intersection of infrastructure, networking, kubernetes, and secure automation, ideal for engineers who thrive in complex, regulated, and hybrid environments.

**who we are:**

hiddenlayer protects the world's most valuable technologies from adversarial ai attacks. we were founded by ai professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial ai attacks can be to detect and defend against. determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of ai securely.

our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as rsa's innovation sandbox winner, cb insights ai 100, cybertech 100, and sc's most promising early-stage start-up.

**what you'll do:**

* lead deployment and lifecycle management of our multi-prem platform across commercial cloud, bare-metal, air-gapped, and il4+ environments.
* build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (terraform, helm, argocd, etc.) to automate consistent deployments across customer sites.
* ensure our customer-hosted builds ("shrink-wrapped" software) remain closely aligned with our continuously deployed saas platform.
* maintain and optimize kubernetes clusters and container build pipelines (eks, k0s, aks, or on-prem distributions).
* implement secure and reproducible container image build pipelines, aligned with our internal release processes.
* collaborate with engineering teams to harden deployments for regulated, classified, and air-gapped customer systems.
* document and version deployment patterns, templates, and procedures to support both automation and accreditation workflows.
* support incident response, troubleshooting, and upgrade cycles across multiple platform footprints.
* contribute to the overall architecture and evolution of the multi-prem reference design, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security parity with saas.

**who you are (required):**

* u.s. citizen (required) and eligible for u.s. government clearance (secret or higher preferred).
* proven success deploying and operating complex systems across multi-cloud and on-prem environments.
* deep hands-on expertise with kubernetes orchestration, container pipelines, and infrastructure automation (terraform, helm, argocd).
* strong foundation in networking concepts: dns, routing, vpc design, vpns, firewalls, and service meshes.
* proficient with secure ci/cd pipelines (github actions).
* experience maintaining linux systems, observability stacks (prometheus, grafana, loki, opensearch), and automation tooling.
* familiarity with compliance frameworks such as fedramp, dod srg, or nist 800-53.

**who you are (preferred):**

* 5+ years of experience in platform, devops, or infrastructure engineering.
* experience deploying workloads into aws govcloud, azure government, or other regulated cloud environments.
* experience deploying and maintaining software in classified, air-gapped, or disconnected environments.
* knowledge of supply chain security (slsa, sbom, image signing, provenance).
* background in ai/ml or data-centric security platforms is a plus.
* familiarity with temporal, kafka, or distributed systems architecture.
* experience maintaining multi-tenant platform parity between saas and customer-hosted versions.

**why hiddenlayer?**

we just raised $100m in series b funding led by delta-v capital, with backing from morgan stanley, microsoft's venture arm, booz allen hamilton, and others. it's a validation of what we've built: 10x revenue growth, 50+ new enterprise customers, and deployments across defense, finance, and the world's largest ai platforms. this funding goes straight into expanding our platform and gtm capabilities, and into growing our team globally.

attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. that's why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

* **fully remote:** we are a completely remote global team. though we're distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together a couple of times a year. we offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.
* **comprehensive health & wellness benefits:** better than your average startup healthcare benefits. with five options to choose from, of which are fully subsidized by hiddenlayer, we offer a variety of options to fit each person's needs. we also offer vision, dental, and 401k offerings.
* **flexible time off:** enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
* **commitment to learning and development:** we support personal growth and education through a dedicated l&d fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
* **diversity, equity, and inclusion:** we are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

to learn more about hiddenlayer visit hiddenlayer and follow us on linkedin or twitter.

hiddenlayer is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. we are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
description:
appfolio is more than a company. we’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. at every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. one in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. we show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

**realm-x** is appfolio's ai-native platform powering this transformation. it enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including realm-x assistant (copilot), flows (ai agentic workflows) and performers (autonomous ai agents). realm-x serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale ai-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high-impact experiences directly to our customers**.

at its core, realm-x is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable ai systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. this foundation allows us to build **context-aware, action-oriented ai systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision-making.

**who we are looking for**

we're hiring a senior machine learning engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational ai agents within realm-x. this role helps define appfolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of llm agent frameworks, real-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure.

you will work with product, voice channel, and ml platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

**your impact**

* **ship voice & text agents:** architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real-time, multi-turn customer interactions.
* **reasoning vs. latency:** make principled trade-offs between reasoning depth and latency across frontier llms, smaller models, and routing strategies.
* **lead a pod:** lead a small pod of ml and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response.
* **define quality:** partner with product and voice channel teams to define kpis, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality.
* **optimize for voice:** drive selective small language model (slm) fine-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost.

**qualifications**

* you have 5+ years of experience developing and scaling web-based applications, preferably in a saas environment.
* you have shipped production ai agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels.
* you think in pipelines and systems, not just models.
* you move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment.
* you are humble, collaborative, and low-ego, and you elevate those around you.
* you value work-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance.

**must have**

* **agent frameworks:** deep, shipped experience with langchain, langgraph, langsmith, and langchain deep agents (or equivalent agent frameworks).
* **voice stack:** hands-on with voice-to-voice models and traditional tts / stt pipelines; understands the trade-offs between end-to-end voice models and modular stt llm tts architectures.
* **llm fluency:** strong grasp of llm reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning-vs-latency trade-offs across providers.
* **telephony & cloud:** production experience with twilio (or comparable telephony) and aws.
* **engineering:** expert python, async programming, and websockets for real-time, bidirectional streaming.
* **ml fundamentals:** solid foundation in deep learning, model evaluation, and inference optimization; able to deploy with docker on aws.
* **leadership:** demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with product and design.

**nice to have**

* bachelor’s, master’s, or ph.d. in computer science or related technical discipline.
* experience fine-tuning small language models for domain-specific voice applications.
* familiarity with rag over structured business data and tool-using agents over api surfaces.
* prior experience in regulated or customer-facing industries with strict reliability requirements.
* publicly verifiable work on github, in open-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions.

**location**

find out more about our locations by visiting our site.

all late-stage candidates complete an in-person meeting with an appfolian as part of our hiring process.

**compensation & benefits**

the compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $167,200 - $229,900 base pay. the actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.

please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive total rewards package. the compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type.  
  
regular full-time employees are eligible for benefits - see here.

**about appfolio**  
appfolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. for more information about appfolio, visit appfolio.com.

**why appfolio**

**grow** | we enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves.

**learn** | we partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. we're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best-in-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills.

**impact** | we are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. we do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. we learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities.

**connect** | we excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. we create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed.

title: Senior Software Engineer - HMI & AI Systems
description:
fairmount technologies (ft) is a growing advanced manufacturing company developing **tooling-free cnc systems** for aerospace and defense applications. our mission is to integrate real-time automation directly onto the factory floor, ensuring unprecedented precision, safety, and efficiency in aerospace component production.

**recent milestone:** ft was selected for a u.s. department of defense **apfit award**, supporting deployment of our systems across multiple air force maintenance depots. as we scale production and system capability, we’re expanding our software team.

we are seeking a versatile **senior software engineer** to bridge the gap between robust industrial hardware and advanced artificial intelligence.

**position overview**

in this role, you will build and modernize **human-machine interface (hmi)** desktop applications that control and monitor complex cnc machining systems. you will use **c#** to drive high-performance, real-time desktop uis and **python** to deploy predictive machine learning models at the edge. this role is critical to transforming raw machine telemetry into actionable, intelligent automation on the shop floor.

**core responsibilities**

* **next-gen hmi development:** design, scale, and optimize high-performance desktop interfaces that connect operator control systems directly with cnc machinery.
* **ui modernization:** maintain and enhance legacy **winforms** developed on **wpf** applications, while actively pioneering migrations to modern, fluent architectures like **wpf** or **winui** and cross-platform ecosystems like **avalonia**.
* **edge machine learning integration:** deploy, test, train, and optimize pytorch and **tensorflow** models inside production environments to handle anomalies, predict tool wear, and automate vision-based quality control in addition to predicting part deviations.
* **hybrid data architecture:** build and manage data layers that combine structured configuration/part logs with scalable nosql (**mongodb**) for high-frequency time-series sensor data.
* **hardware-software synthesis:** collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and automation engineers to ingest cnc controller data seamlessly into your application workflows.

**technical requirements**

**desktop & hmi frameworks (c#)**

description:

you will work with product, voice channel, and ml platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

* experience fine-tuning small language models for domain-specific voice applications.
* familiarity with rag over structured business data and tool-using agents over api surfaces.

title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
description:
appfolio is more than a company. we’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. at every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. one in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. we show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

**realm-x** is appfolio's ai-native platform powering this transformation. it enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including realm-x assistant (copilot), flows (ai agentic workflows) and performers (autonomous ai agents). realm-x serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale ai-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high-impact experiences directly to our customers**.

at its core, realm-x is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable ai systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. this foundation allows us to build **context-aware, action-oriented ai systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision-making.

**who we are looking for**

we're hiring a senior machine learning engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational ai agents within realm-x. this role helps define appfolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of llm agent frameworks, real-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure.

you will work with product, voice channel, and ml platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

**your impact**

* **ship voice & text agents:** architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real-time, multi-turn customer interactions.
* **reasoning vs. latency:** make principled trade-offs between reasoning depth and latency across frontier llms, smaller models, and routing strategies.
* **lead a pod:** lead a small pod of ml and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response.
* **define quality:** partner with product and voice channel teams to define kpis, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality.
* **optimize for voice:** drive selective small language model (slm) fine-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost.

**qualifications**

* you have 5+ years of experience developing and scaling web-based applications, preferably in a saas environment.
* you have shipped production ai agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels.
* you think in pipelines and systems, not just models.
* you move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment.
* you are humble, collaborative, and low-ego, and you elevate those around you.
* you value work-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance.

**must have**

* **agent frameworks:** deep, shipped experience with langchain, langgraph, langsmith, and langchain deep agents (or equivalent agent frameworks).
* **voice stack:** hands-on with voice-to-voice models and traditional tts / stt pipelines; understands the trade-offs between end-to-end voice models and modular stt llm tts architectures.
* **llm fluency:** strong grasp of llm reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning-vs-latency trade-offs across providers.
* **telephony & cloud:** production experience with twilio (or comparable telephony) and aws.
* **engineering:** expert python, async programming, and websockets for real-time, bidirectional streaming.
* **ml fundamentals:** solid foundation in deep learning, model evaluation, and inference optimization; able to deploy with docker on aws.
* **leadership:** demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with product and design.

**nice to have**

* bachelor’s, master’s, or ph.d. in computer science or related technical discipline.
* experience fine-tuning small language models for domain-specific voice applications.
* familiarity with rag over structured business data and tool-using agents over api surfaces.
* prior experience in regulated or customer-facing industries with strict reliability requirements.
* publicly verifiable work on github, in open-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions.

title: DATA SCIENTIST - EMERGENCY APPOINTMENT
description:
**type of recruitment**
  
open competitive - emergency

  

**filing dates**

applications will be accepted from thursday, october 15, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. (pt) until thursday, october 22, 2026, 5:00 p.m. (pt). all applications must be received **before** 5:00 p.m. (pt) on thursday, october 22, 2026, to be accepted.

  

**exam number**

hh1763b-ea

  

the la county board of supervisors recently declared a local state of emergency for homelessness, and the county is working to revise and expand our response to help all who are affected. we are looking for qualified and passionate individuals to help us in the mission of addressing issues like housing, mental health, and substance use. if you are looking for a new career that will directly benefit the population of la county, this may be the opportunity for you.

  

the department of homeless services and housing (hsh) is seeking qualified candidates to fill emergency health program analyst iii vacancies related to the homelessness crisis.

  

under the emergency order, applicants who meet the requirements may be hired for an initial period of up to 90 days, with an opportunity for permanent county employment.

  

during your initial work period, you will be assessed on your work performance. this assessment will be weighted 100%.

  

those who successfully pass the assessment will be considered for permanent appointment to data scientist.

**essential job functions**
---------------------------

* collaborates with division, department, and countywide stakeholders to solicit, define, and manage data science projects from conception through implementation, including identifying and developing statements of business problems; conducting exploratory data analysis and data mining; developing model specification requirements; and conducting advanced statistical analyses.
* develops and presents visualizations of findings and recommendations that can be used to support business decisions and allocate resources.
* works with departmental stakeholders to document business requirements and helps frame business problems so that appropriate corresponding data science techniques can be identified and applied.
* collaborates with department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal, external, structured, and unstructured data sources.
* works with departmental information technology organization to support collection, integration, and retention requirements for large sets of structured and unstructured data from various sources and consults with data engineers and architects on the design and architecture of relevant data systems and processes.
* collaborates with other data scientists, analysts, and it staff to select, evaluate, improve, and document tools and systems in order to strengthen divisional and departmental analytic capacity.
* independently conducts advanced analytical studies for the resolution of business problems and transfigures data into critical information by selecting and deploying appropriate advanced statistical techniques such as machine learning, bivariate and multivariate analyses, predictive/prescriptive analytics, and optimization.
* uses statistical computer scripting, domain-specific, and programming languages and other software and tools to digest, manipulate, prepare, augment, evaluate, analyze, summarize, and visualize data.
* plans, designs, and manages experiments, consumer surveys, and other data collection projects to augment existing sources of data as necessary to solve business problems.
* reviews the work of predictive data analysts and other lower-level analysts assigned to project for quality-control purposes.
* conveys findings and conclusions of work orally, in writing, visually, in presentations, and by developing interactive tools as appropriate to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences, including technical and nontechnical staff, stakeholders, and members of the public.
* works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making.
* assists in implementing recommended business process changes in ways that both retain fidelity to best practices identified through the analysis and recognize the operational realities underlying existing business processes.
* works with functional teams to develop and implement products, services, and tools, such as dashboards and reports, emerging from the analysis.
* contributes to advanced analytic products (e.g., recommender engines, auto classification algorithms, predictive scoring, geo-spatial clustering, nlp classifier, etc.) and helps place them in production.
* recommends ongoing improvements to methods and algorithms that lead to findings, including new information.
* provides business metrics for departmental projects to show improvements both initially and over multiple iterations. provides ongoing tracking and monitoring of performance of decision systems and statistical models and troubleshoots and implements enhancements and fixes to systems as needed.
* accesses ongoing training and professional development to maintain familiarity with current industry and academic research to apply the latest and most useful statistical learning techniques to help extract pattern and trends from data.
* develops relationships with local academic data science programs to foster recruitment of data science interns and is responsible for overseeing their work on departmental data science projects.

**requirements**
----------------

**requirements to qualify**

**option i:** two (2) years of experience applying advanced statistical analyses, including predictive analytics, to produce actionable recommendations to support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making, at a level equivalent to the los angeles county class of predictive data analyst.

  
  

**option ii:** a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a field of applied research such as data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis -and- four (4) years of experience applying machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to produce actionable recommendations to support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making. a master’s or doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health may substitute for up to two (2) years of experience.

  
  

you must meet the above requirement(s) in order to be appointed to fill any vacancies related to this recruitment.

  

**special requirement information**

* experience at the level of predictive data analyst is defined as using machine learning techniques to analyze complex data sets and find statistically significant, meaningful predictive patterns, relevant to program goals, that human intelligence could not identify on its own.

  

to receive credit for your education, include a copy of your official diploma or letter/certificate **-and-** official transcript from an accredited institution within seven (7) calendar days of the end of the filing period. please submit documentation to satajanyan@hsh.lacounty.gov and indicate your name, the exam name, and the exam number. the document should show the date the degree was conferred and be in english; if it is in a foreign language, it must be translated and evaluated for equivalency to u.s. standards. for more information on our standards for educational documents, please visit:
  
  
https://file.lacounty.gov/sdsinter/dhr/070812\_ppg123.pdfandhttps://file.lacounty.gov/sdsinter/dhr/205105\_ppg\_123\_ace\_resource\_guide.pdf ;
  
we do not accept password-protected documents. ensure documents are unlocked before attaching to your application or sending to the exam analyst.

**license**

a valid california class c driver license or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions.
  
  
**physical class**

ii - light: this class includes administrative and clerical positions requiring light physical effort that may include occasional light lifting to a 10-pound limit and some bending, stooping, or squatting. considerable ambulation may be involved.

  

**desirable qualifications**

one (1) year of experience within the last four (4) years in one or more of the following:
working with large, fragmented administrative datasets

* + - including individual-level records from social services, healthcare, or government programs.
  + selecting and applying statistical or machine learning models appropriate to the business problem, including model assumptions and limitations.
  + producing recurring reports or dashboards from administrative data systems using tools such as tableau, looker, power bi, databricks dashboards, sparks, azure synapse, or equivalent platforms.
  + developing dashboards or automated reports that translate analytic outputs into actionable information for program managers or operational staff.
  + collaborating with data engineers or it staff to scope data needs, provide feedback on data systems, and integrate analytic workflows into data pipelines.
  + applying version control (e.g., git) and basic software development practices, such as code documentation and reproducibility standards.
  + working on an extract, transform, and load (etl) process using data input tools to clean and combine datasets.
* experience presenting data analysis findings to non-technical stakeholders including homeless service program staff, leadership, and external bodies.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**job posting title:**

forward deployed engineer

**-**

**hiring department:**

et - ai platforms and innovation

**-**

**position open to:**

all applicants

**-**

**weekly scheduled hours:**

40

**-**

**flsa status:**

exempt from flsa

**-**

**earliest start date:**

immediately

**-**

**position duration:**

expected to continue until oct 31, 2029

**-**

**location:**

austin, tx

**-**

**job details:**

**general notes**
-----------------

this is a fixed term position that ends three years from the employee’s start date.

flexible work arrangements are available for this position, including the ability to work remotely at least 50% of the time within the united states. in-person meetings will be required when applicable. we prefer a candidate located in the greater austin area as travel to campus for occasional in-person events, training, team meetings, activities, etc., will be required.

this position provides a balance of life/work with typically a 40-hour work week, and travel limited to training (e.g., conferences/courses).

enterprise technology is dedicated to supporting the mission of the university of texas at austin of unlocking potential and preparing future leaders of the state.

**your skills will make a difference.**

you’ll be working for a university that is internationally recognized for research and the work you do will make a difference in the lives of our students, faculty and staff. if you’re the type of person that wants to know your work has meaning and impact, you’ll like working for our campus.

the university of texas at austin and enterprise technology provide an outstanding benefits package to our staff. those benefits include:

  

* competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
* vision, dental, life, and disability insurance options
* paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* teachers retirement system of texas (a defined benefit retirement plan)
* additional voluntary retirement programs: tax sheltered annuity 403(b) and a deferred compensation program 457(b)
* flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses
* training and conference opportunities
* tuition assistance
* athletic ticket discounts
* access to ut austin's libraries and museums
* free rides on all ut shuttle and capital metro buses with staff id card

for more details, please see: https://hr.utexas.edu/prospective/benefits and https://hr.utexas.edu/current/services/my-total-rewards

must be authorized to work in the united states on a full-time basis for any employer without sponsorship.

this position requires you to maintain internet service and a mobile phone with voice and data plans to be used when required for work.

**purpose**
-----------

enterprise technology's ai studio serves as the central hub for the university of texas at austin's artificial intelligence initiatives and works to expand access to ai tools, services, and expertise across campus. the forward deployed engineer designs, develops, and implements ai-powered applications and solutions that address the evolving needs of the university community.

this position works directly with faculty, staff, researchers, and campus partners to identify opportunities for ai integration and transform ideas into functional, production-ready software. the forward deployed engineer combines full-stack software development, ai application engineering, and technical collaboration to deliver solutions that improve teaching, research, and institutional operations.

working closely with ai engineers, ai educators, campus it teams, and student innovators, this role helps bridge the gap between emerging ai capabilities and practical implementation. the position contributes to the development of reusable applications, shared engineering resources, and technical practices that support sustainable ai adoption across the university.

**responsibilities**
--------------------

### **ai application development and engineering:**

* design, develop, test, and deploy ai-powered applications that address academic, research, and administrative needs across the university.
* build full-stack software solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks, including python, javascript/typescript, and related technologies.
* develop backend services, rest apis, user-facing applications, and integrations that incorporate large language models (llms), generative ai, and other emerging ai capabilities.
* integrate ai models and services from providers such as openai, anthropic, microsoft azure, google, and other platforms into applications and institutional workflows.
* develop applications incorporating ai capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (rag), agentic workflows, tool calling, and structured data processing.
* design software architectures that prioritize reliability, maintainability, security, and scalability.
* implement authentication, authorization, and secure data-handling practices when integrating applications with university systems and services.
* develop automated tests, participate in code reviews, and apply software engineering best practices to maintain application quality.
* troubleshoot application issues, investigate unexpected ai model behavior, and implement improvements to enhance functionality and reliability.
* create reusable software components, development templates, and shared libraries that accelerate future ai application development.

### **campus ai solutions and technical collaboration:**

* partner with faculty, staff, researchers, and academic and administrative units to identify challenges that may benefit from ai-powered solutions.
* gather requirements, evaluate technical feasibility, and recommend implementation approaches that align with stakeholder needs and available resources.
* translate conceptual ideas and early-stage use cases into working prototypes, proof-of-concept applications, and production-ready solutions.
* collaborate with stakeholders throughout the development process to incorporate feedback and ensure applications meet functional expectations.
* provide technical guidance on ai application design, model integration, and software development approaches.
* support ai studio workshops, demonstrations, and technical sessions that introduce campus communities to ai application development and emerging technologies.
* work with student developers and innovators to support experimentation, prototyping, and the development of ai-enabled applications.
* help lower barriers to ai adoption by building accessible tools, creating practical examples, and sharing engineering knowledge with campus partners.
* coordinate with campus it teams and other technical stakeholders when solutions require integration with existing institutional systems.

### **ai solution delivery and continuous improvement:**

* manage the technical development of assigned projects from initial exploration and planning through implementation, deployment, and ongoing refinement.
* break down complex technical challenges into manageable development tasks and establish practical implementation approaches.
* evaluate potential technologies, frameworks, and architectures based on project requirements, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.
* assess ai application performance, model outputs, and user feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* develop and maintain technical documentation, application architecture diagrams, implementation guides, and operational resources.
* collaborate with ai studio engineering teams to establish common development patterns and improve consistency across applications.
* monitor application behavior, investigate defects, and implement enhancements that improve reliability and user experience.
* explore emerging ai models, development frameworks, and engineering practices to identify opportunities for new solutions.
* contribute technical findings and implementation insights that inform the continued development of ai studio platforms, services, and capabilities.

### **perform other related functions as assigned:**

* contribute to cross-functional initiatives related to ai governance, responsible ai practices, application security, and institutional technology strategy.
* participate in technical planning sessions, project reviews, and collaboration with enterprise technology teams.
* support the development and maintenance of internal engineering standards, documentation, and development workflows.
* stay informed about advancements in generative ai, software engineering, and emerging ai application architectures.
* assist with the creation of educational materials, demonstrations, and technical resources that support ai literacy and adoption across campus

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field. relevant work experience may substitute for education.
* two or more years of professional experience in software engineering, application development, solutions engineering, or a related technical field.
* strong programming proficiency in python, javascript/typescript, or comparable programming languages, with demonstrated experience developing and maintaining production-quality software.
* experience developing full-stack applications, including backend services, rest apis, database integrations, and web-based user interfaces.
* hands-on experience developing applications that integrate large language models (llms), generative ai services, or machine learning apis.
* understanding of software architecture principles, including application scalability, maintainability, reliability, and security.
* experience integrating applications with external apis, databases, authentication services, or enterprise systems.
* familiarity with modern software development practices, including git-based version control, automated testing, code reviews, and technical documentation.
* demonstrated ability to independently investigate technical challenges, evaluate potential solutions, and implement effective approaches.
* experience translating stakeholder requirements into functional software applications and delivering projects through the development lifecycle.
* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate evolving technical requirements and unfamiliar technologies.
* excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
* demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

*equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.*

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* experience using and configuring enterprise ai assistants such as chatgpt and claude, including advanced capabilities for research, software development, workflow automation, and task execution.
* familiarity with chatgpt and claude extensibility features, including skills, plugins, connectors, custom gpts, claude projects, and other capabilities for tailoring ai assistants to specific workflows and organizational needs.
* experience developing or configuring custom ai skills, tools, and integrations that extend the functionality of ai assistants and connect them to external applications, apis, and institutional data sources.
* familiarity with model context protocol (mcp) and related standards for connecting ai assistants and agents with enterprise systems, tools, and services.
* experience using ai-assisted development tools, such as claude code, codex, or similar agentic coding environments, to accelerate application development, testing, and deployment.
* understanding of ai agent workflows and orchestration, including tool use, multi-step task execution, context management, and human-in-the-loop approval processes.
* experience developing and deploying applications on cloud infrastructure platforms, including amazon web services (aws), microsoft azure, and google cloud platform (gcp), with familiarity in cloud services, containerized deployments, api management, and infrastructure automation.
* experience developing, deploying, and maintaining model context protocol (mcp) servers, including locally hosted and docker-containerized mcp services, integrating external tools and apis, and configuring related tooling for secure communication between ai assistants, applications, and enterprise systems.

**salary range**
----------------

$95,000 - $110,000

**working conditions**
----------------------

* may work around standard office conditions
* repetitive use of a keyboard at a workstation
* use of manual dexterity

--------------

title: Assoc. Dir, DSCS Digital Technologies, Decision Intelligence (m/f/d)
description:
job description
  
  
position overview - basic functions & responsibility
  
  
digital is the multiplier that will allow development sciences and clinical supply (dscs) to deliver better experiments faster, efficient filing and launch, more robust supply chains and higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. the dscs digital technologies (ddt) organization is tasked with the mission to pioneer and deploy innovative digital technologies that drive the acquisition, automation and utilization of data to enhance insights, efficiency, and quality of dscs processes and methods.
  
the dscs digital technologies (ddt) organization within the research team is accountable for driving the digital transformation, data architecture, and technology solutions that enable execution and operations within the dscs organization.
  
  
the associate director, decision intelligence is a technical role responsible for developing advanced analytics and operations research capabilities to enable data-driven decision making and inform dscs business operations. this role will focus on modeling, simulation and optimization frameworks to solve complex business problems.
  
  
**the associate director, decision intelligence will:**  

* translate business problems into mathematical models/frameworks for business process simulation and optimization.
* design robust and sustainable analytics that can be seamlessly integrated with webapps and/or agents to streamline user interaction.
* develop and implement probabilistic forecasting and stochastic optimization techniques to enable strategic decision making given uncertainty.
* serve as a business analyst to develop business cases for new digital capabilities. define and track kpis aligned with the value proposition for digital transformation within dscs.
* contribute to designing, building, and implementing modern data foundations and pipelines.
* contribute to the development of custom web applications (webapps) that allow business users to seamlessly interact with data products and model outputs.
* work strategically with change management and dscs functional area smes to design and implement ai-enabled business processes.
* contribute to the advancement of the ddt decision intelligence strategic roadmap, developing reusable methods and components that support decision intelligence capabilities across business domains.

primary activities
  
  

* requirements translation: translate business processes and/or stakeholder requirements into accurate mathematical representations and technical specifications for corresponding models, agents and data products.
* decision intelligence strategy: provide expertise in translating data and model outputs into clear, concise and interpretable business insights. collaborate with digital operations change management and functional area smes to define and implement ai-enabled decision making processes across dscs.
* business case development: in collaboration with dscs smes, develop the business case and articulate the value proposition for new digital capabilities.
* performance monitoring: define and track kpis to monitor the value realized through digital transformation within the dscs organization.
* modeling & simulation: develop mathematical models to simulate and/or optimize business processes using techniques including but not limited to machine learning, discrete event simulation and optimization.
* data engineering: in collaboration with the digital operations shared services team, design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging databricks, python, dataverse, and advanced sql. transform raw data into contextualized, ai-ready data products.
* agentic ai: in collaboration with agentic intelligence team, design, test, and implement agentic ai workflows using tools like copilot studio to automate decision-making processes and generate proactive business insights.

title: Product Support Solutions Developer
description:
with 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, recorded future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

the **product support solutions developer** designs, builds, and maintains the technical infrastructure, tools, and automated workflows that power the customer support function. combining technical development expertise with support operations and enablement, this role is responsible for architecting scalable internal tooling, engineering custom integrations, and leveraging ai agents/automations to drive operational efficiency, reduce resolution times, and elevate customer satisfaction.

### **what you'll do:**

#### **1. custom tooling & integration development**

* design, build, and maintain custom applications, scripts, and webhook integrations across core support systems (e.g., zendesk, jira, salesforce service cloud, domo, statuspage).
* architect and optimize api connections, custom middleware, and automated workflows to streamline ticket routing, data syncs, and escalations.
* build custom ui components, apps, and macros within support platforms to enhance agent efficiency and desktop experience.
* determines methods and procedures for new or undefined assignments, considering company objectives—not only functional needs—to shape solutions

#### **2. ai agent & automation implementation**

* lead the evaluation, development, and deployment of ai agents, llm-powered assistants, and chatbots to automate tier-1 support interactions and internal agent assistance.
* fine-tune ai agent prompt workflows, knowledge ingestion pipelines, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) models to improve self-service resolution rates.
* monitor and continuously optimize ai agent performance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

#### **3. support operations & tool management**

* administer, configure, and optimize support systems, maintaining slas, routing rules, triggers, and automated workflows.
* conduct regular quality, tag, and compliance audits across systems to ensure high data integrity and adherence to support processes.
* assist platform operations and support leadership with outage communication tooling, incident escalation paths, and client updates.

#### **4. data engineering, analytics & reporting**

* build and maintain complex analytics dashboards and data pipelines (e.g., zendesk explore, domo, sql) to track kpis like ticket volume, mttr, csat, and backlog trends.
* partner with product analytics to build unified data reporting layers across disparate platforms.
* perform root-cause analysis on platform trends and negative csat ratings to identify automation opportunities and systemic fixes.

#### **5. technical enablement & process improvement**

* collaborate with support leadership to design and deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for support staff.
* digest complex product handoffs from product and engineering teams, translating them into technical documentation, live training modules, and internal knowledge base resources.
* partner with documentation and training teams to create client-facing self-service e-learnings and articles that reduce inbound ticket volume.
* continuously audit support workflows to identify operational bottlenecks, create documented procedures to improve them, and develop automated solutions as necessary to eliminate them.
* maintains key relationships outside their area of expertise to bolster unified process improvement where necessary

### **what you'll bring:**

#### **required:**

* **experience:** 3+ years of experience in product support engineering, support operations, technical support, or developer relations.
* **development & scripting:** hands-on programming experience (e.g., python, javascript/node.js, rest apis, webhooks, json) to build custom tooling and integrations.
* **platform expertise:** deep administrator/developer experience with customer support ecosystems (e.g., zendesk api/apps framework, jira service management, salesforce, freshdesk).
* **data & analytics:** strong sql skills and experience building dashboards in bi tools (e.g., domo, tableau, looker) or native reporting engines (zendesk explore).
* **operations & enablement:** proven ability to document sops, lead technical training, and optimize operational support workflows.
* **communication:** strong cross-functional collaboration skills to liaise effectively between engineering, product, and support teams.

#### **preferred:**

* **ai & automation experience:** hands-on experience developing or implementing ai agents, llm apis (e.g., openai, anthropic), conversational ai frameworks, or agentic frameworks (e.g., langchain, autogen).
* **knowledge management for ai:** experience with vector databases, prompt engineering, or managing knowledge bases optimized for ai search/rag architectures.
* **best practices:** familiarity with itil framework, agile methodology, or devops deployment practices.

title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
description:
**role overview**

the ai engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with client teams to design, build, and ship production ai solutions on microsoft 365 copilot, copilot studio, and azure ai foundry (now microsoft foundry). this is an individual contributor role. you will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

you will work inside a collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. you will partner directly with client business and it stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working ai solution, then harden it for production.

**key responsibilities**

**copilot solutions**

* build declarative agents, copilot connectors, and plugins that extend microsoft 365 copilot with client data and workflows
* build copilot studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes
* connect copilot to sharepoint, teams, microsoft graph, dataverse, and line-of-business systems
* write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback

**azure ai foundry solutions**

* build custom agents and ai applications in azure ai foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box copilot
* select, deploy, and configure models from the foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency
* implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls
* integrate ai solutions with enterprise systems through apis, azure functions, power automate, and logic apps

**retrieval and data foundations**

* build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (rag) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding
* use azure ai search and azure ai document intelligence to index and extract knowledge from client content
* partner with collectiv data engineers to connect ai solutions to microsoft fabric, databricks, and other enterprise data platforms

**evaluation and production readiness**

* build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
* implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models
* apply security, identity, and governance controls using microsoft entra id, microsoft purview, and azure ai content safety
* use version control, ci/cd, and code review standards for all ai solution code and configuration

**consulting and collaboration**

* work directly with client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
* translate business problems into scoped, buildable ai use cases with clear success metrics
* train client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
* contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to collectiv's ai practice

**eligibility for this engagement**

* this engagement requires us citizenship under the client's contract terms. this is a condition of the specific client project, not a collectiv policy; collectiv regularly hires non-us citizens and people based outside the us for other roles.
* you must be physically located in the united states for the duration of the engagement.
* if you do not meet these two conditions, please still apply: we will keep your application active for ai engineer roles that do not carry this requirement and contact you directly when one opens.

**required qualifications**

* bachelor's degree from an accredited university in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or microsoft 365 and power platform development
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative ai or llm-powered solutions in production or client environments
* hands-on experience with microsoft 365 copilot extensibility and copilot studio
* hands-on experience with azure ai foundry or azure openai
* experience building rag solutions with azure ai search
* strong python or c# skills
* experience working in azure (storage, compute, identity, networking)
* ability to work independently in a client-facing consulting role

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with microsoft agent framework, semantic kernel, or autogen
* experience with power platform, dataverse, and power automate
* experience with microsoft fabric, databricks, or power bi
* experience with llmops practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
* familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for ai in regulated industries
* consulting experience across multiple clients or industries
* relevant certifications such as azure ai engineer associate, copilot studio or power platform certifications, or fabric (dp-600, dp-700)

**what success looks like in this role**

* ai solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed
* clients trust you as the engineer who knows how to make copilot and foundry work in their environment
* your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff
* you contribute patterns and accelerators that make collectiv's next ai engagement faster

**why collectiv**

join collectiv for a rewarding career in a fully remote work environment with quarterly in-person team experiences and competitive compensation. we provide a clear growth trajectory with professional development opportunities and a top-shelf benefits package. enjoy unlimited time off and 100% covered health insurance, encompassing medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. our comprehensive offerings, from a competitive 401(k) with a 4% match to educational assistance, tech stipend, and discounts on various goods and services, demonstrate our commitment to your well-being and success.

collectiv is the leading boutique consulting and strategy firm specializing in analytics, planning, and ai with power bi and the microsoft data stack.

our mission at collectiv is simple: we help enterprises break free from stagnation and make better decisions.

our core values:

* **growth mindset:** bring solutions, not problems.
* **excel with humility:** be humbly brilliant.
* **communicate actively and empathetically:** listen, ask, understand, help.
* **work hard, play hard:** results are proportional to effort.
* **keep calm and carry on:** stay cool, calm, and collectiv.

adoption and business impact

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
**compensation:** $130,000-$160,000 per year  
**location:** united states – remote or omaha, ne - hybrid

**the job:**

as a senior data engineer-data platform at buildertrend, you'll lead the migration of our data platform onto a modern databricks lakehouse built on dbt, replacing today's patchwork of legacy systems with a single, reliable source of truth. you'll design the pipelines that bring in data from tools like salesforce, sql server and gong, turning it into curated, trustworthy datasets that teams across the business, and the ai tools built on top of them, can rely on without double-checking the numbers. your work directly cuts down on the manual firefighting that eats into engineering time today, and sets the technical standards other engineers will build on for years.

**what you will do:**

* design, build and maintain buildertrend's databricks lakehouse using a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture in dbt, and set the layer standards, naming conventions and build rules other engineers follow.
* build elt pipelines with databricks, dbt and fivetran that bring in data from sql server, salesforce, mongodb, gong, opentelemetry and vendors like zonda, turning it into curated, analytics- and ai-ready datasets.
* lead the exit from legacy systems like bigquery, data fusion and cloud fusion by refactoring pipelines rather than copying them over as-is, untangling circular dependencies, and repointing tools like tableau to the new platform with clear owners and deadlines.
* strengthen reliability by improving sql server log-ship replication and fivetran ingestion, and by building automation like auto-recovery, full-refresh jobs and watchdog orchestration that cuts down on manual fixes and outages.
* build data quality checks, freshness monitoring and quality metrics using dbt tests, unity catalog and fivetran metadata, so stakeholders can trust the numbers without double-checking them.
* design access controls for large datasets, including permission models, per-team clusters, service principals and scoped access for ai tools, and handle privacy requests through tools like datagrail to meet ccpa requirements.
* set up data contracts with product engineering so upstream schema changes don't silently break the warehouse, and write documentation (data dictionary, erds, spec docs, column notes) clear enough for people and ai tools to use.
* build and improve the curated data products that let stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions.
* partner with data science, machine learning and ai teams to build and curate the datasets their models and experiments depend on, alongside the broader data products that help stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions.
* partner with engineers, analysts, business leaders and other stakeholders to prioritize work, manage dependencies and deliver meaningful platform improvements.
* mentor other engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies and grow toward a technical leadership role while using ai thoughtfully to improve productivity and engineering outcomes.

**who you are and what you need:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field is required.
* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data science or data analytics.
* previous experience at a b2b saas company is preferred.
* hands-on, production-level experience with databricks, including building and orchestrating pipelines, managing jobs and clusters, and using unity catalog for governance is required.
* hands-on, production-level experience with dbt, including building and maintaining models, tests and macros in a real production environment is required.
* proven experience leading a data platform migration, such as moving off a legacy warehouse onto a modern lakehouse, from planning through delivery, including setting deadlines and owning the outcome.
* experience partnering with data science, machine learning, or ai teams to build and curate datasets to support model development and experimentation.
* strong proficiency in sql, microsoft sql server, python and working with apis and large, complex datasets. bigquery or fivetran experience is a plus!
* deep understanding of data modeling, etl and elt pipelines, medallion architecture and building analytics and machine learning-ready datasets.
* experience writing data tests, setting up freshness and alerting monitors, and building access controls or governance policies in a live production environment (not just in a sandbox or one-off project).
* strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, especially during a system migration where people need clear, direct answers about what's changing and when.
* demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical work and influencing engineering standards.

**we are giving you:**

* exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short- and long-term disability benefits
* a 401(k) plan with buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future
* generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge
* parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments
* volunteer time off – because giving back matters
* wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best
* opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need
* technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home
* free daily lunches when you're at our hq office, plus monthly events to connect with your team

**who we are:**

great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. that’s where buildertrend comes in. as the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. no more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. with nearly two decades of industry expertise, buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. if you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/

**working at buildertrend:**

at buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. what makes buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. in short: we want you to be who you are, love what you do, and build your best life.
